m300111.――ああッ！？\nほら、あそこじゃ！\nピカピカ光っておるじゃろう！？: —Ah! Look, over there! It's shining brightly, isn't it!?
m300111.――ウぅッ……グ、はぁ……ハァ……。\nそんな……バカ、な……。\n竜人族が……: ――Ugh… ha… ha… This… how foolish… the draconians losing to humans…?
m300111.……あれ、貴方たち物質界の人間……ね……？\nここで何をしているの？: …Huh, you folks from the Material World…? What are you doing here?
m300111.……こうしてはいられません！\nもっともっと私達も強くならないと、\n王子を守れ: …We can't just stand around like this! We have to get a lot stronger if we're ever going to protect the Prince!
m300111.……そう、カ……ありがとう……人間達よ。\n……サラバだ……帝国の勇士達よ。: …Yes… thank you… humans. …Farewell… brave warriors of the Empire.
m300111.……なんじゃ？ 襲ってくるかと思ったが、\nピカピカは、帰っていった様じゃな。\: …What's that? I thought they'd attack, but the shiny ones seem to have gone back. Wasted my worry. Let's head back—
m300111.……他ノ竜人達は……、\nこれまで通り、帝国ノ戦士として……、\n重用してほしい: …I want the other draconians to keep serving as Imperial soldiers… please, count on me.
m300111.……好きにすればいいよ。全部を相手にするのは\n無理だけど、出来るだけわたしが倒: …Do whatever you want. I can't take them all on, but I'll try to beat it for you. You protect yourselves.
m300111.……断る。\n……貴様は既に帝国の戦士ではない。\nさっさと失せろ。: …I refuse. …You are no longer an Imperial soldier. Leave at once.
m300111.……王子。\nあなたには皆を率いることのできる素質と\nそして困難にも負けない勇:
...Prince.
You have the quality to lead everyone
and the courage that won't bow to hardship.
m300111.……逃げられたようですね。\nそれにしても、手強い相手でした。: …It looks like they got away. Still, they were a tough opponent.
m300111.…さて、わしは酒呑童子の元へ行くことにするか。\n人間どもよ！ 肩慣らしには丁度: …Well then, I'll head back to Shuten-Dōji. Humans! That was a good warm-up. Next time, we'll meet for real!
m300111.あ……行ってしまいました。\nいったい何者だったのでしょうか？: Ah… she's gone. Who on earth was that?
m300111.あ、あの……本当に王子に内緒で\n魔界に来てしまってよかったのでしょうか……？: Um… are we really okay having come here without the Prince knowing?
m300111.あ、あの～…、メトゥスさん…？\n王子たち行っちゃうよ…？: Um, uh… Metus-san…? The Prince and the others are leaving…?
m300111.あっ！ 王子、向かってきます！\n戦いは避けられそうにありません。: Ah! Prince, they're coming! There's no way to avoid the battle.
m300111.あての名は鬼刃姫。\n次に会う時は、必ず勝ってみせる……。: My name is Kibahime. The next time we meet, I'll be sure to win…
m300111.あなたが立派な王となるまで、\n私達はずっと御側にいますから！:
Until you become a fine king,
we'll always stand by your side!
m300111.あの……エルンさん。\n大天使長はなぜ、先程の天使と共に\n私達に襲いかかってこ: Um… Erun-san. Why didn't the Archangel attack us together with that angel earlier?
m300111.あのクロノデーモンと名乗った魔物の来襲以来、\n王子の顔つきは以前よりもずっと\:
Since that monster calling itself the Chrono Demon attacked,
your expression, Prince, has become much more steadfast than before.
m300111.あの様子ですと、\nいずれまた襲ってくる可能性が高いですね……。: From the looks of it, they're likely to strike again sometime later…
m300111.あら、ごめんなさいね。\n少しぼーっとしちゃってたわ。\nそれじゃ、私たちもダー: Ah, sorry. I was spacing out a bit. Well then, let's head home together with Darling!
m300111.あれは……鬼刃衆！？\nまさか、待ち伏せしていたというのですか？:
That... the Oni Blade Squad!?
Could they have been lying in ambush?
m300111.いい加減、王子に頼りすぎるのも悪いじゃろう。\n少しは魔界のことをわしらで調査し: Honestly, relying on the Prince all the time isn't good. We should investigate the Demon Realm ourselves and get some useful intel.
m300111.いよいよ私達だけで魔界に来ちゃいましたね！: At last, it's just us in the Demon Realm!
m300111.お願いします。\n私も過去の文献を見てみる事にします。\nでは王子、一度帰還しま: Please. I'll also dig through the old records. Well then, Prince, let's head back. Good work.
m300111.かつて竜人達が棲んでいた地に還ル……。\nそこで、我らは再ビ偉大なる種の誇りを取: We'll return to the lands where dragonfolk once dwelled… there, we'll reclaim the pride of our great race.
m300111.くそ……なぜだ。なぜ帝国に反逆する！？\n白の帝国は、貴様ら竜人を誇りある戦士と:
Damn… why? Why rebel against the Empire!?
The White Empire gave you dragon warriors honor, granting you status and rights equal to humans.
m300111.この世にある土や水、火、風なんかの\n自然物にはそれぞれ小さなエネルギーが\n宿: You know how every natural thing—soil, water, fire, wind—has a little bit of energy inside it, right?
m300111.この国を守る為には、自らが強くならねばと\nこうして王子が我らに教えを請うている:
To protect this country, we must become stronger ourselves,
and that's why the Prince is seeking guidance from us.
We must do our utmost to answer him!
m300111.これで、魔物は全部倒せたみてぇだな……。: Looks like we've taken out all the monsters…
m300111.これは……聞いていた以上の数ですね……。\n何故これほどまでに鬼が出現しているの: This… is more than I heard… Why are so many demons appearing?
m300111.これほどまでに力の差があるとはね……。\n今一度、鬼刃衆を鍛え直さなくては、\n: To think there's such a gap in power… If we don't retrain the Oni Blade Squad, I don't think we can defeat my father.
m300111.さすがにゴブリン達を見逃すわけにはいきませんね。\n王子、ここで討伐しましょう！: We can't just let those goblins get away. Prince, let's take them down here!
m300111.さすがは酒呑童子の四天王\nといったところですね……。: As expected of Shuten-Dōji's Four Heavenly King…
m300111.さて、私も帰る事にしましょう。: Well then, I shall be heading back as well.
m300111.すごいです、王子！\nまさかこの訓練を乗り切るとは……。:
Incredible, Prince!
I never imagined you'd get through this training...
m300111.そうじゃな、と……あいたた……。\nそれにしても、体が随分重いのぅ……。\nまた: That's right… ouch… My body feels so heavy… If another demon shows up, it'll be terrible.
m300111.そうですね、皆さんも疲れていますし、\n今日の所はここで調査を終了して、\n王子: Indeed, everyone's tired, so let's end the investigation here for today and return to the Prince.
m300111.そこまでは流石に分かりませんが、\n大天使長が意味も無く行動してるとは思えません: I can't say for sure, but I doubt the Archangel is acting without reason.
m300111.そこまでは私も分からないです……。: I don't really know that part…
m300111.それじゃあ、わたし行かなくちゃ。\nやらないといけない事があるから……。: Then I have to go. I have something I must do…
m300111.それでは、城へ戻りましょうか……。\n今日はお疲れでしょう。しっかりとお身体を休:
Then, shall we return to the castle...?
You must be tired today. Rest well,
and tomorrow, let's train together again!
m300111.それでは王子、\n今回は少しだけ厳しくいきますよ？\nさあ、訓練開始です！:
Alright then, Prince,
this time we'll be a bit tougher, okay?
Now, the training begins!
m300111.それにしても、どうして急に\nアースエレメンタルがあんなに大量に\n発生してしま: Still, why did Earth Elementals suddenly appear in such huge numbers…?
m300111.それにしても、魔界の瘴気の影響でしょうか。\n魔力がいつもの半分程しか沸いてきま: Still, could it be the miasma? Our magic only feels about half as strong…
m300111.それをエレメンタルって呼んでいるの。\n世の中には、自然物と交信して意図的に\n: We call that an Elemental. Some people can communicate with nature and deliberately manifest them, it seems.
m300111.そんな……やはり我らでは勝てないのか……。: No… So we really can't win…?
m300111.そんなに不安そうな顔を\nなさらないでください王子。: Don't wear such an anxious face, Prince.
m300111.そんな事よりも、\nあのデーモンは私を追ってきてるの。\n早く逃げた方が良いよ。: More importantly, that demon's after me. We should get out quickly.
m300111.そんな自然物に宿るエネルギーが何かのきっかけで\n異常に集まると、ある限界点に達: When that energy suddenly gathers, it reaches a limit and then it materializes—just like that.
m300111.ただね、こっちから危害を加えなければ、\nエレメンタルは危険なものじゃないの。\: But as long as we don't attack them, Elementals aren't dangerous. So we don't have to force them away right now.
m300111.だから、裁かれるべきは己のみ……という訳か。\n都合の良い話だな。: So only I should be judged… is that it? What a convenient story.
m300111.だが、此度ノ反乱は、全てオレの罪ダ……。\n他ノ仲間達はオレが煽動し、この戦場に: …But this rebellion is all my fault. I incited the others and put them on this battlefield… that's all I want you to understand.
m300111.ちょ、ちょ、ちょっと！\nどうするのゼンメルさん！\n逃げるの！？ 戦うの！？: Wait, wait, wait! What are you doing, Zenmel! Run? Fight!?
m300111.ったく、アースエレメンタルなんか居なけりゃ\nもっと楽に勝てたのによぉ……。\n: Honestly, if those Earth Elementals weren't here, we could've won much easier. This took twice the effort…
m300111.って、あの～……。\nそのデーモンが向かって来ていますよ……。: Uh… that demon's heading straight for us…
m300111.ですが、少しも動かないですね……。\nどういう事なのでしょうか……。: But it isn't moving at all… What does that mean?
m300111.でも、確かにあんなに沢山の\nアースエレメンタルが具象化するのは\nちょっと普通: But it's definitely odd for that many Earth Elementals to materialize at once.
m300111.どうか、その力と心を、大切に育んでください。: Please, nurture that strength and heart with care.
m300111.なんと！ 魔界の住民じゃと\n瘴気の影響はないのか！ 魔界の住民にとって、\n瘴: So the residents aren't affected? For them the miasma is like air…
m300111.はぁぁ～…。\nや～っとビフロンス支配下のアンデッドを\nぜぇ～んぶ倒したわぁ～: Haaah… Finally took down all the undead under Bifrons' control…
m300111.ふむ……何とか退けられたようじゃ。\nしかし、魔界の瘴気というものは厄介じゃのぅ: Hmm… we managed to push it back. Still, that miasma is a pain. Can't draw our usual power.
m300111.ふーん。\nわたしは魔界に棲んでいるから平気だけど、\n物質界の住人は魔界の瘴気: I see. I'm fine since I live here, but you material folk are affected by the miasma.
m300111.ほう……なかなかどうしてやりよるのう。\nわしが眠っている間に、\n人間もずいぶ: Hmm… Not bad at all. While I was sleeping, humans have become quite strong.
m300111.ほら、アレだよアレ！ あの岩の塊みたいなのが\n大量発生しちまってるんだ。\nゴ: Look, that thing! Those massive rock-like lumps are spawning everywhere. They're rolling around like crazy—dangerous as hell.
m300111.まあいいでしょう。\n結果として封印されていた上位の天使を\n見つける事が出来た: Well, that's fine. As a result we managed to locate a sealed higher-ranking angel… hmm?
m300111.まだ本調子ではないが、肩慣らしには丁度良い。\n特別におぬしらの相手をしてやろう: I'm not at full strength yet, but it's perfect for a warm-up. I'll take on you specially.
m300111.まだ続けると仰るのですね。\nさすがは王子にございます！\n王国の未来を背負おう:
So you say you want to continue.
As expected of a prince!
I can feel your resolve to bear the kingdom's future!
m300111.も、もちろん知ってるに決まってんだろ！\n(初めて知ったぜ……): Of course I know that! (First time I actually learned it…)
m300111.やっぱり王子を頼らずに魔界に来るなんて\n危なかったかな……？\n私も、もうこれ:
I guess coming to the Demon World without relying on the Prince was dangerous…?
I don't think I can move any further.
m300111.わしは酒呑童子の配下たる四天王のひとりじゃ。: I am one of the Four Heavenly Kings, a subordinate of Shuten-Dōji.
m300111.わしらは魔界の調査に来たのじゃが、\n見ての通り、ピンチでな。\n体も思うように: We came to scout the Demon Realm, but as you can see, we're in a bind. My body won't cooperate.
m300111.アイギス様はあの神器を、\n王子にまだ託されてはないのかしら……。\n女神様の御: I wonder if Aegis has yet to entrust that sacred relic to the Prince… I can't gauge the goddess's will, but…
m300111.ギャギャッ！\nニンゲン、見ツケタ！ タオセ！ タオセッ！！: Gya-gya! Humans, we've spotted you! Attack! Attack!!
m300111.ゲハハハハ！\n理由は単純じゃ、人間どもよ……。\n封印から目覚めたわしを出迎え: Gehahahaha! The reason is simple, humans… It's to welcome me, who has awakened from the seal.
m300111.チッ……何て間の悪い時に現れやがんだ。\nアースエレメンタルの間を縫って進んでき: Damn… why do you have to show up at the worst possible moment. They're slipping through the Earth Elementals!
m300111.バルバス爺なら何か分かるかもしれないから、\n帰ったらすぐに聞きに行ってみるね。: If old Barbas knows anything, I'll go ask him as soon as we get back.
m300111.リッチ…見ていてくれた…？\nあなたの仇は取ったわ…。: Rich… were you watching…? I've taken your revenge…
m300111.丁度良い。\n先ほど見つけたこの上位天使の封印を解き、\n不浄な人間の浄化を行う: Perfect. I'll break the seal on this higher angel we just found and purify these impure humans.
m300111.不浄なる人間に与する堕天使のお前には、\n何も伝える事などない。\nそして、ここ: To a fallen angel like you, who consorts with impure humans, I have nothing to say. And I have no time to deal with you here.
m300111.人間と遜色無い地位……カ。\nそれが思い上がりだということを解さぬからこそ、\n:
Status equal to humans… huh.
Because you can't understand that such pride is arrogance, we've turned our fangs on the Empire!
m300111.先ほどの言葉から察するに、\n大天使長は、この上位天使の封印を\n解いたようです: From what you just said, it looks like the Archangel has broken that angel's seal.
m300111.分からないのか？\n陛下は貴様を見逃すと言っているのだ。: Don't you get it? His Highness says he'll let you go.
m300111.別の、目的……？\nいったいどんな目的なんじゃ？: Another purpose…? What could it be?
m300111.力を求めて、一体何をしようというのでしょうか。\n今後は彼らの対策も立てておきま: What are they after, power? What are they planning to do? We should start preparing a countermeasure. Prince.
m300111.勝負あったな。\nこれでもまだ我らに刃向かうか……？: That was a worthy fight. Still you keep daring to oppose us…?
m300111.千年戦争の頃からの封印なので、\n完全に封印が解除されるには、\nもう少し時間が: It's been sealed since the Millennium War, so fully releasing it will take a little more time.
m300111.国に脅威が訪れた時、\n皆を導くのは、あなたの役目なのですから。:
When a threat comes to the nation,
it will be your duty to guide everyone.
m300111.地上に眠る神獣を探す為に、\nかつての千年戦争にて封印された地を回って\nいると: We're traveling the sealed lands from the old millennium war to find the sleeping divine beasts, and all we keep finding are angels…
m300111.大丈夫ですか、王子？\n苦しいようでしたら、\n今日の訓練はここで終わりとします:
Are you alright, Prince?
If you're struggling,
we can end today's training here, okay?
m300111.天使にかかった封印を完全に解く前に\n他の地へと向かったということは、恐らく、\: Since the seal on the angel wasn't completely broken before heading elsewhere, perhaps they had some other purpose…
m300111.如何にも！\n王子よ、今一度我らと兵刃を交わす事を願う！:
Indeed!
Prince, we wish to clash swords with you once more!
m300111.完璧なネクロマンサーとして、\n私も少しは成長出来たかな…？: As a perfect necromancer, maybe I've grown a little…?
m300111.封印から、目覚めた……？\nあ、あなたは何者ですか！？: Awakened from a seal…? W-who are you?!
m300111.小娘を見捨てて逃げられるわけないじゃろうに。\n老いたとはいえ、わしも魔術師の端: I wouldn't abandon a little girl. Even old, I'm still a mage. Let me at least help.
m300111.少し私の方でも天使達の動向を探ってみます。\n王子も警戒を怠らないようにしてくだ: I'll keep investigating the angels' movements. Prince, stay on guard.
m300111.幸い、反乱による帝都の被害も僅かだ。\nそれに、現在の帝国軍における竜人種の重要: Fortunately, the damage to the capital from the rebellion was minimal. Moreover, given the draconians' importance to the current Imperial army, the punishment should be light.
m300111.待っていたぞ、王子！: We've been waiting for you, Prince!
m300111.待ってください！\nあの鎖で繋がれている者……、\nあれは、封印された上位天使で: Wait! The one chained there… that's a sealed higher-ranking angel.
m300111.我ら竜人族は、神と並ぶ存在である神竜ノ血を\n宿す種族ダ！ そんな我らが人間ども:
We, the dragonfolk, carry the blood of the Divine Dragon, a lineage beside the gods!
It's only natural we resent being treated on the same level as humans.
m300111.戻ったら、すぐに訓練しましょう！\n王子も、もちろん付き合って下さいね？: When we get back, let's start training right away! Prince, you'll join me, won't you?
m300111.挑発にお乗りにならぬよう、陛下……。\nここは我々だけで充分です。: Your Majesty, please don't take the bait… This is enough for us alone.
m300111.武勇に優れた王子と戦う事で、\n我らはさらに強くなる！\nそして、頭目たる鬼刃姫:
By battling a brave Prince like you,
we become even stronger!
And we will fulfill the ambition of our leader, the Oni Blade Princess...!
m300111.無事、王子の元に帰ったようね。\nまさか王子に内緒で、魔界に来るなんて。:
We made it back to the Prince safely.
I can't believe you came to the Demon World without his knowledge.
m300111.照れることはありません。むしろ誇るべきです！\n何故なら、あなたは先代にも引けを:
No need to be embarrassed. In fact, you should be proud!
Because you possess talent that rivals even the previous generation.
m300111.王子、あの天使の封印が解除される前に、\n無力化しましょう。このまま放っておくと: Prince, before that angel's seal is fully broken, we need to neutralize it. If we let it be, it'll be unleashed onto the surface!
m300111.王子、ご覧下さい！\n報告通り、この地にて鬼が暴れているようです。: Prince, look! As reported, demons are rampaging in this area.
m300111.王子、分かってると思うけど、\nアースエレメンタルには、\n絶対に手を出しちゃダ: Prince, you know this, right? Never lay a hand on an Earth Elemental!
m300111.王子、魔神が後退していきます！: Prince, the demon god is retreating!
m300111.王子！ こっちの洞窟じゃ！\n身体がピカピカ光った\n怪しいヤツが現れたんじゃ…: Prince! Over here in the cave! A shady guy whose body is shining brightly appeared…!
m300111.現れたな、帝国ノ皇帝……。\n反旗ヲ翻したのは、貴様と戦う為でもあったのダ。:
So the Emperor of the Empire finally appears…
We raised the banner of rebellion also to fight you.
m300111.皆さん、お疲れ様でした。\nそれにしても、本当に手強い相手でした。: Everyone, good work. That was truly a tough opponent.
m300111.確かに、そうですね……。\nもし、今デーモンが現れたら……。: That's true… If a demon showed up now…
m300111.確かに岩の塊のような見た目ですね。\n……いったいあれは何なのでしょうか？: They do look like chunks of rock… What on earth could that be?
m300111.私はダーリン…いえ、仲間達のおかげで、\n人間として前に進む事が出来たわ…。: Thanks to my darling… no, my comrades, I can move forward as a human…
m300111.私達は無益な戦いはしません！\nなぜ、こんなに執拗に王子を付け狙うのですか！？:
We won't fight a pointless battle!
Why are you so obsessively targeting the Prince?!
m300111.臆するのなら退くも良シ……。\nだが、真に我らを従えていたと自負するならば、\n:
If you're scared, you may retreat…
But if you truly believe you command us, then face me in an honorable duel!
m300111.自分も同感であります！\n幼くしてこれほどの軍略を駆使するとは……。\n王国の未:
I feel the same way!
To wield such strategy at such a young age...
The kingdom's future looks bright!
m300111.要するに帝国に収まる器ではないと\n言いたいのだな。……だが、ここを出てどうする:
In short, you're saying you're not meant to be confined by the Empire…
But what will you do after you leave? Do you even have anywhere to go?
m300111.誇リ高き竜人族ノ戦士達ヨ！\n我らは神竜ノ血を引く優れた種族ダ！\n今コソ人間に:
Behold, proud warriors of the Dragonfolk!
We are a noble race bearing the blood of the Divine Dragon!
Now we'll show those lowly humans our power!
m300111.貴方は……大天使長！？\nいえ、それよりも何故このようなところに！？\nまた、物: You are… the Archangel!? No, more importantly, why are you here?! Are you trying to intervene in the material world again…?
m300111.身体から光を……？\n本当にそのような者がいるのでしょうか？: His body is glowing…? Could such a person really exist?
m300111.酒呑童子の配下の四天王……！？\nかなりの強敵であることは間違いありませんね…。: A Four Heavenly King, subordinate of Shuten-Dōji…? No doubt they're a formidable foe. Prince, please command carefully.
m300111.陛下……！？ そう、ですか。\n奴等と真っ向から戦うというのですね。\n分かりま:
Your Majesty…! I see. So we'll confront them head-on.
Understood. We'll give them our full support.
m300111.頭目？ 鬼刃姫……？\n一体どういう事ですか？: Head? Kibahime...? What on earth does this mean?
m300111.鬼刃姫、ですか……。\nなぜか自分達の鍛錬の相手に\n王子を選んでいた様ですが…: Kibahime, huh… Somehow they chose the Prince as their training partner…
m300111.鬼刃衆！ いつまで倒れてるつもり？\nさっさと退くよ。: Oni Blade Squad! How long do you plan on lying there? Get out of the way already.
m300111.魔界のネクロマンサーなら\n魔界で大人しくしていなさいよね！\nまた来てもダーリ: If you're a necromancer of the demon realm, you should stay put there! If they come back, Darling and I will drive them away!
m300111.魔界の人なのに、優しく綺麗な眼だったね。\n悪い事をする人には見えないけど……。:
Even though you're from the Demon World, you had kind, beautiful eyes.
They don't show on those who do evil…
m300111.魔神ビフロンスを撃退出来て本当に良かったです。\nそれでは帰還するとしましょう。: I'm really glad we repelled Bifrons. Let's head back then.

m300158.――この辺りになります。\n新種の魔物の報告があったというのは。: ――This is the area. They said there were reports of a new kind of monster nearby.
m300158.――まったく、男同士で交流を深める会、\nと聞いていましたが……。: —Really, a gathering for men to deepen their bonds, they said…
m300158.――王子、こちらになります。\nシノさんからお誘いのあった、\n妖怪のお祭りと言: —Prince, this is it: the yokai festival that Shino invited us to.
m300158.――王子、交流会の会場はこの先です。\n皆さん先に向かわれるとの事でしたが……。: —Prince, the venue for the gathering is just ahead. I heard everyone's heading there first…
m300158.……そうですね。指導については、\n目が覚めてから行うとしましょうか。: …Indeed. As for the instruction, shall we do it after we wake up?
m300158.……で、でけぇ！ \nなんでぇこりゃ！！:
…It's huge!
What on earth is this!!
m300158.……どうやら魚人のようだね。\n狙いはこの船みたいだ、\n真っすぐこっちに向かっ: …Looks like a merman. It's targeting this ship, heading straight for us.
m300158.……イブキさんと砲術隊の皆さん、\nすっかり意気投合したみたいで何よりです。\n: …It looks like you and the artillery crew have really hit it off, which is great. Prince, thank you for your efforts.
m300158.……予想以上に妖怪が集まりましたね。\nそれだけ、お姉……シノ様を総大将と慕う妖: …More yokai gathered than we expected. That just shows how many now look up to you, Sister… General Shino, as their leader.
m300158.……既にしっかり盛り上がってるようです。\nそれでは、自分も混ざらせて頂きます。: …Looks like the party's already in full swing. Then, allow me to join in.
m300158.……流石は王子。歴戦の手腕、見せてもらったよ。\nそして砲術隊の皆もありがとう。: …As expected of the Prince. You showed the skill of a veteran. And thanks to the artillery crew as well. We were defeated, but it was a fight with no regrets.
m300158.……神が指令を与えさえすれば、\n真の姿を現し、その絶対的な力を以て\n種の殲滅: …If the god issues a command, it reveals its true form and, with absolute power, eradicates a species…
m300158.……神獣だと？ 獅子の体躯を模した巨像……\n……まさかアレは『神獣スフィンクス:
…A divine beast? A statue modeled after a lion's form…
…Could it be the ‘Divine Beast Sphinx'!?
m300158.……程々にお願いするわね。\nそれじゃ王子、戻りましょ。: …Don't overdo it. Well then, Prince, let's head back.
m300158.あ、なんか夏らしい話だな。\n謎の飛行物体が夜な夜な家畜を襲って、\n内臓や血だ: Ah, sounds like a summer tale. Rumor has it that a strange flying thing swoops in at night, attacking livestock and draining only their organs and blood.
m300158.ああ、もちろん把握している。\nこれなら怪我の心配もないし、\n気兼ねなく全力で: Of course, I'm aware. That means no risk of injury, and we can go all-out without holding back!
m300158.あの、イブキさん？\n弾は水風船を使った船上演習ですからね？: Um, Ibuki-san? The shells are just water-balloon drills on the ship, right?
m300158.ありがとうございます、\nぜひそうさせて頂きますね。: Thank you—I'll be sure to do just that.
m300158.いつか、魔物退治が普段通りでなくなる時代がくれば\n良いのですけどね……。: I'd love to see a day when monster-hunting isn't just routine…
m300158.いやいやいや、男と言えばやはり筋肉。\nこの鍛え抜かれし肉体を見て下され。\n…: No, no, no—when it comes to men, it's all about the muscles. Behold this honed physique! …Hmph!
m300158.うぅ、飲みすぎた……ぜ……。\n頭の中でドラが鳴り響いてやがる……。: Ugh, I overdid it… My head's pounding like a drum…
m300158.うーん、もう飲めませんよ……ぐぅ。: Hmm, I can't drink any more… *groan*
m300158.えぇ……ですが、我々は負ける訳にはいきません。: Yes… but we can't afford to lose.
m300158.おう野郎ども、こっちだぜ！\nこの先の屋台が俺の店だ。\n美味い酒と料理を楽しん: Hey, you bastards, over here! This stall ahead is my shop. Enjoy some tasty booze and grub.
m300158.おぉ、いい考えじゃねーか！ 酒もある事だし\nアレを見せる事も出来そうだ……。\: Oh, great idea! We've got the booze, and we can show it off… Prince, it's been a while—let's go all-out in a duel!
m300158.おぉっと、宴もたけなわみたいだね。今回はシノさんの\nご指名だからな、ご主人には: Whoa, the party's really in full swing. Since Shino chose us, sorry guys, but you'll be hearing the “Grudge Cat Shamisen” today.
m300158.おぉ！ 王子殿ではありませんか！\nちょうどよかった！ 今皆で誰が一番男らしいか: Oh! Isn't it the Prince himself! Perfect timing! We were just debating who's the most manly!
m300158.お祭りなんて初めて……だけど、楽しいな。\nすごい賑やか。こんな感じなんだ。: It's my first festival… but it's so much fun. So lively—this is what it's like.
m300158.ここの酒は城で飲む酒とは違うなぁ。\n凄いアルコールが強い感じがするけど、\n口: The booze here's nothing like what we drink back at the castle. It hits hard, but it's so smooth I could keep going forever!
m300158.この前はお宝を探しながら、ふと領地の外を見てみると、\nふよふよ浮かびながら、遠: The other day, while searching for treasure, I glanced beyond the borders and saw a floating shadow drifting away…
m300158.この程度、まだまだ父上には及ばないがな。\nだが、私は私なりの道を歩み、\nいつ: It's still nothing compared to Father, but I'll walk my own path and someday become the true Grand General of the yokai.
m300158.ご主人、見事な大立ち回りを魅せて貰ったよ。\nお陰様で祭りの盛り上がりも最高潮さ: Master, that was an impressive showdown. Thanks to you, the festival's excitement has reached its peak.
m300158.しかし、未確認飛行物体もその正体は魔物でしたね。\n不気味な噂話も、中身は案外、: Still, those UFOs turned out to be monsters, didn't they? Even the creepy rumors might just be ordinary happenings after all.
m300158.すみませんダニエラさん、\n今日は非番だったというのに\nご協力頂いてしまって。: I'm sorry, Daniela. You weren't even on duty today, yet you're helping us.
m300158.そうだぜ！ 男同士、\n同じ釜の飯を食い、酒を酌み交わす！\nまさに友情だぜ！: That's right! Men sharing a pot of rice, passing around drinks—that's true friendship!
m300158.そうだ！ イブキさんも砲術隊に入りませんか！\nイブキさんが入ってくれれば、\n: That's right! Ibuki, would you join the artillery unit? If you do, our firepower will definitely go up!
m300158.そうね。だったら次はここをこうしたら……。: Right. Then, next time we could do it like this…
m300158.そうね。負けたのは残念だけど、\n全力を尽くす、悔いの無い戦いができたわ。: Indeed. It's a shame we lost, but we gave it our all and have no regrets.
m300158.その意気です！ 今後の戦いに備え、\n今は英気を養いましょう。\n王子、此度の激: That's the spirit! Let's recover our strength for the battles ahead. Prince, thank you for your efforts in this fierce fight!
m300158.それじゃ、次の曲にいかせてもらうよ。\nお次の曲は『妖怪音頭』\nご主人達も、陽: Then, onto the next song. Up next is “Yokai Ondo.” Everyone, dance merrily along!
m300158.それにその大砲を使いこなす技術……\nイブキさんでしたら、砲術士としても\nやっ: And the skill to wield that cannon… I think you could hold your own as an artillery specialist, Ibuki-san.
m300158.そんな下らない噂を否定する為、調査に来たのです。\n噂で済むなら良いですが、その: We're here to investigate and put those baseless rumors to rest. If it's just a rumor, fine, but there's also a chance it's a flying monster.
m300158.ぞろぞろと隊列を組んで……まるで、\n辺りを埋め尽くす侵略者って感じだな。: They're forming ranks, moving together… like an invading force filling the area.
m300158.ちょっと、\n幾らなんでも気が抜けすぎなんじゃないの。\nいつ敵が現れるか――…: Hey, this is getting way too lax. We never know when the enemy will appear——!
m300158.でも、目の前まで敵が迫るピンチにこそ、\nチャンスもあるものじゃないかな。\n敵: Still, when the enemy gets that close, that's when opportunities arise. Striking from within the enemy's ranks—that's the thief's creed.
m300158.どうでしょうダニエラさん、\n何か見えますか？: How about it, Daniela? Do you see anything?
m300158.どうにか片付いたみたいだね。: Looks like we managed to clear it up.
m300158.どうやら敵は去ったようです。: It looks like the enemy has retreated.
m300158.なんという重圧……。\nあれが神獣の持つ力……ですか。\n未だに体が震えています: What a pressure... Is that the power the divine beast possesses? My body is still trembling.
m300158.にゃふふ、人間に演奏するのも好きだけど、\nこれだけ聴衆がいると\n妖怪相手の演: Nyahaha, I love performing for humans, but with a crowd this big, playing for monsters isn't so bad either.
m300158.はぁ……な、なんとかなったわね……。\nまさか、こんな状況で戦う事になるなんて\: Ha… we somehow made it… I never imagined we'd end up fighting in a situation like this.
m300158.はい……ですが、激戦の日々の中、\n皆さん良い息抜きになったようで何よりです。: Yes... but amidst these days of fierce battles, I'm glad it served as a good break for everyone.
m300158.はい、それがよさそうです。\n皆さん今はしっかりと疲れを癒されて下さいね。\nお: Yes, that sounds best. Please take the time to properly recover your fatigue now. Good work, everyone.
m300158.はい。またいつ人魚が現れても問題なきよう、\n今後は海上を想定した戦闘訓練も、\: Yes. We'll need to incorporate sea-combat training so we're ready if a siren appears again.
m300158.はい。人が生きるこの世界を守るため、\n私たちは勝たねばなりません。\n……そう: Right. To protect this world where people live, we must win. …That's right, Prince!
m300158.はい！ お誘いの手紙にも書いてありましたので、\n準備は万端です。妖怪百鬼夜行の: Yes! The invitation mentioned it, so we're ready. We'll be your partners for the Yokai Night Parade!
m300158.ふふ……まさか演習に熱中しすぎて船が座礁、\n難破する事になるとは……。\n……: Heh… I never imagined we'd get so caught up in the drills that the ship would run aground and start to break apart… …Sorry about that; I guess we got a bit carried away.
m300158.ふふ、ありがとう。……王子、良ければもう少し、\n私たちで演習を続けさせてくれな: Heh, thanks. …Prince, if you don't mind, could we keep training a little longer? I think we could achieve even better coordination now.
m300158.ふふっ、まさか王子軍を相手に戦う日がくるとは。\n英雄率いる歴戦の強者との戦い…: Heh, I never imagined the day I'd face the Prince's forces. A battle against seasoned heroes led by a legend… No shortage of challenge, I'm truly looking forward to it.
m300158.ふわぁ……凄く綺麗な歌声ですね。\n思わず聞き入ってしまいます……それに何だか…: Wow… What a beautiful voice. I can't help but get drawn in… and somehow… I feel my strength just… slipping away…
m300158.へへー、楽しいよね。\nフーコと久しぶりに一緒に遊べて、\nわたし、すっごい嬉し: Hehe, it's fun, right? I'm so happy to be playing with Fuuko again after so long!
m300158.ほ、報告！\n天使達が攻撃をしかけてきました！:
Re-report!
The angels have launched an attack!
m300158.まぁそう慌てなさんな。\nお酒も料理も逃げませんぞ。: Hey, no need to rush. The drinks and food aren't going anywhere.
m300158.まぁロイ殿、楽しみに歩が軽くなるのは人として当然の事。\n武を極め、酒をたしなむ: Indeed, Roy, it's only natural for a man to feel lighter when he looks forward to a feast. Master the sword, savor the drink—it's what a man should do. All that's missing is a bit of flair.
m300158.まったく、厄介な能力を備えた魔物が現れたわね。\n海上をチョロチョロして、ほんと: Good grief, a monster with such a troublesome ability shows up. Skittering around the sea—so annoying.
m300158.もちろんだ。\n新参者に指揮を執らせて頂き感謝している。\n采配、号令を以て私の: Naturally. I'm grateful to have a newcomer take the reins. With my orders and commands, I'll demonstrate my true skill.
m300158.やっぱ男なら酒は強くなくっちゃな！\n見ろよ、この豪快な飲みっぷりを！\n……ゲ: A real man has to hold his liquor! Look at this wild drinking! …Ughhh.
m300158.ゆっくりとコチラに近づいてくるのが不気味ですね……。\n王子、応戦の準備をお願い: It's eerie how they slowly drift closer… Prince, please prepare to respond. Since they're floating, ranged troops will likely take the lead.
m300158.エレインさん、まだまだ元気いっぱいですね。\n帰り着いたら、皆で遊ぶですよ。: Elaine, you're still full of energy. When we get back, we'll all have fun together.
m300158.ハープを持った魔物……成程そういう事か。\nこの歌は、どうやら人魚の使う呪歌のよ: A monster with a harp… I see. This song must be a siren's chant.
m300158.下手に攻撃を加えると、速度が増して\n手が付けられなくなる。攻撃するタイミングは: If we attack recklessly, they'll speed up and become uncontrollable. We should choose our attack timing carefully.
m300158.予想外のハプニングもこれで終わりね。\n港についたら思いっきり遊ぶんだから！: Unexpected hiccups are finally over. Once we reach the port, we're going to have a blast!
m300158.争う力を奪う恨みの一曲。\n本来の力が出ない状態でご主人たちが\nどうやって窮地: A grudge-filled tune that strips away fighting power. It'll show how you cope when you can't use your true strength.
m300158.人である私達が相手では、\n水を差してしまうのではとも思いましたが。\n盛り上が: As humans, we feared we might dampen the mood, but if everyone enjoyed it, that's all that matters.
m300158.人を滅ぼすべく、神が作り出した\n禁断の兵器……また一つ、\n新たな脅威が増えて: A forbidden weapon the gods created to wipe out humanity… another new threat has emerged.
m300158.人魚の呪歌……そういう事ですか。男性の方々は、\n前線に出るのは危険やもしれませ: Siren's chant… I get it. It's dangerous to send the men to the front line. Let's handle this ourselves, the women.
m300158.人魚の歌声は、男性を魅了し力を出せなくする。\n人魚がいる間、男連中は\n全く使: Siren songs enchant men and drain their power. While a siren's present, the men are completely useless, so we'd better keep that in mind.
m300158.今回は男だけの交流会、\n女性が居ないのは仕方ないさ。: This one's a men-only gathering, after all. No women, but that's how it goes.
m300158.何にせよ、不穏な影の正体を突き止め、\n領地を守る事ができました。一件落着ですね: In any case, we've uncovered the source of that ominous shadow and protected the territory. Case closed. Well then, Prince, let's return.
m300158.先日まで、このような像はなかったのですが。\n気づいたら、いつの間にか……。:
Until recently there were no statues like this.
Then, before we knew it… it was there.
m300158.報告ありがとうございます。\n……これですか、報告にあった\nピラミッドに現れた:
Thank you for the report.
…Is this it, the colossal statue that appeared at the pyramid mentioned in the report?
m300158.奴の放つ圧倒的な威光の前には、\n歴戦の勇者でさえ畏怖し、すくみ、\n立っている: In the overwhelming radiance it emits, even veteran heroes are said to tremble, freeze, and find it impossible to even stand.
m300158.妖怪総大将として、妖怪の交流を深めるべく、\n妖怪の祭りを呼びかけてはみたが……: As the Grand General of the yokai, I've been trying to call for a yokai festival to deepen our ties…
m300158.妖怪達の祭り……人間の祭りと、\nほとんど変わらないようですね。: A yokai festival… seems almost the same as a human one.
m300158.山賊王さんの作られる山賊料理、\nすっごく楽しみです！ \nよぉっし、お腹いっぱ: I'm really looking forward to the Bandit King's specialty dishes! Alright, let's eat till we're stuffed!
m300158.帰り次第、新たな特訓メニューを考案せねばなりません。\nまずは浜辺での行軍をスム: Once we get back, we'll have to devise a new training regimen. First, we need to smooth out our beach marches—maybe a 10-kilometer… no, 100-kilometer drill on sand.
m300158.感動の瞬間を見せてくれ、ご主人。\nそれじゃあ一曲、ご清聴あれ。: Give us a moving moment, masters. Then, enjoy the performance.
m300158.折角の祭りに人も妖怪も関係ないさ。\n王子達も、ぜひ祭りを楽しんで行ってくれ。: Whether it's people or yokai, it doesn't matter at a festival like this. Prince, please enjoy the celebrations.
m300158.折角水着を着てるっていうのに、なんだか暇ねぇ。\n……王子達が来るまで、ひと泳ぎ: I finally got to wear my swimsuit, and now I'm bored. …Until the Prince arrives, I think I'll go for a swim. Paula, want to join me?
m300158.敵の動きをしっかり読んで\n動く必要がありそうね。\nみんな、行くわよ！: We'll need to read the enemy's movements carefully and act. Everyone, let's go!
m300158.新種の魔物ねぇ……見る限り、\n特にそれらしいのは\n見当たらないみたいだけど…: A new monster, huh… From what I can see, there's nothing that looks like it…
m300158.来て早々ではあるのですが、血の気多きが妖怪の性。\nあれがなければ始まらないとの: It's a bit early, but it's in a yokai's nature to be hot-blooded. Many say nothing starts without that… So, sorry to be forward, but may we have a match?
m300158.死中に活を求める、とは言いますけど……。\nキュテリさんも他の方も、無理はしない: They say you seek life within death… but please, you and everyone else, don't push yourselves too hard.
m300158.気にしないで頂戴、弓兵の目がないと\n海上の魔物を探すなんて出来ないでしょ。\n: Don't worry about it. Without the archers' eyes, we couldn't even spot sea monsters. …Huh? Did you hear something?
m300158.流石は王子、本来の数に届かないとは言え、\nより強くなった私の百鬼夜行をあっさり: As expected of the Prince—though you couldn't quite match my true numbers, you still easily repelled my Hundred Night Parade, now even stronger.
m300158.浮いたり沈んだり不安定ね……\n……けど、それしか道もないみたい。: It's unstable, bobbing up and down… …but it seems that's our only option.
m300158.浮き沈みしている船の残骸を使えば、\nなんとか足場に出来そうだけど……。: If we use the wreckage of the bobbing ships, we might be able to make a makeshift platform.
m300158.海を楽しむのは、あれを倒してからに\nするしかなさそうです……ただ、\n迎撃しよ: Looks like we'll have to deal with it before we can enjoy the sea… Though there's hardly any footing for us to launch a counter.
m300158.港が近くだったのが不幸中の幸いだね。\n王子たちが助けを呼びに行ってるから、\n: It's a blessing in disguise that the harbor's nearby. Since the Prince is going to call for help, we'll just hold position for now.
m300158.演習と言っても、\nやるからには負けるつもりはありません。\n海軍元帥の采配、期: Even if it's a drill, I have no intention of losing. I'll be counting on the Admiral's command.
m300158.演習部隊に砲術隊を選ぶなんてわかってるじゃない。\n王子には悪いけど、手加減はな: Choosing the artillery unit for a drill—how predictable. Sorry to the Prince, but I won't be going easy on you!
m300158.王子、ここが謎の飛行物体が目撃された場所だ。: Prince, this is where the mysterious flying object was sighted.
m300158.王子、スフィンクスはまだ動いてはいない。\n今は不用意な攻撃は避けた方が良い、\: Prince, the Sphinx isn't moving yet. It's best to avoid reckless attacks now; it's not an opponent we can win against!
m300158.王子、戦闘のご指示をお願いします。\n王子も男性です、前線に立つような無茶は\n: Prince, please give us your battle orders. You're a man too, so don't do anything reckless like charging the front.
m300158.王子たちの強さと指揮が一枚上手だったわね。\n……でも、イブキの指揮も流石だった: The Prince's strength and command were a cut above. …But Ibuki's leadership was impressive too.
m300158.王子軍たるもの、訓練や風紀は当然の事、\n礼節にも通じて貰わねばなりません。\n: As members of the Prince's forces, training, discipline, and proper conduct are a given. We must also uphold etiquette. Looks like we need another lesson.
m300158.男らしさと言えば、やはり\n隙のない剣技につきるだろう。\n全てにおいて、俺に隙: When you talk manliness, it's all about flawless swordsmanship. I've got no gaps in anything!
m300158.皆さん、来てくださったのですね！\nこのような所までご足労頂き、\nありがとうご: Everyone, you came! Thank you for making the effort to come all the way here.
m300158.目玉の魔物が、\nこちらに接近して来るようですね。\n……かなりの数に見受けられ: It looks like a monster with an eye is approaching us. There seem to be quite a few of them.
m300158.砲の専門家である皆にお墨付きを頂けるとは光栄だ。\nだが、やはり私はこの海を守る: I'm honored to receive the seal of approval from all the artillery experts. Still, I see myself as one who protects these seas, and I'll keep devoting myself to everyone.
m300158.砲術士では無いけれど、\nイブキさんの大砲も良い武器ですね！: I'm not an artilleryman, but your cannon, Ibuki-san, is a fine weapon!
m300158.砲術士の皆、配置についたようだな。\nよし、私も出撃する！ 『一斉射撃』開始！\: Artillerymen, you're in position, I see. Alright, I'm moving out! Commencing ‘simultaneous fire'! Prince… this is it!
m300158.神の意思……ですか。\nでは、神が人間を滅ぼすという指令を\nもし与えたとしたら:
The will of the gods…
So, if the god were to order humanity's destruction—
m300158.神の意思により動く存在だ。\n普段は巨像となりて黙し、ただ人の行く末を\n見据え:
It moves only by the will of the gods.
Usually it remains a silent statue, merely watching humanity's fate…
m300158.神より仰せつかりしこの地での命は\n既に果たされました……見つかった所で、\n支: By divine command, my purpose here has already been fulfilled… Now that we've been found, is there any problem?
m300158.神獣の卵の力を使い、新たなる神獣を生成する\n計画は成功……しかし、やはり神獣の: Using the power of the divine-beast's egg, the plan to create a new divine beast succeeded… Yet it seems we still can't fully replicate the divine-beast's power.
m300158.私の号令に合わせ、皆存分に\nその全力を発揮して貰えればと思う。\nそれでは……: If everyone can give it their all in sync with my command, that'd be great. Now then… let the drill begin!
m300158.私もちょっと熱くなりすぎたわ。\n面目ないわね……。: I got a little too heated as well. I'm sorry about that…
m300158.私も負けてられないわね。\n砲術士の学校で学んだ成果を見せてあげるわ。: I can't afford to lose either. I'll show you the results of my training at the artillery school.
m300158.終わったみたいですね。魔物が目前まで\n迫ってきた際はどうなる事かと思いましたが: Looks like it's over. I was worried when the monsters closed in on us, but we managed to intercept them safely.
m300158.船影がこっちに来るのが見えるです。\n王子達の助けが来たみたいです。: I can see the ship's shadow coming this way. Looks like the Prince and his allies are coming to help.
m300158.見つけた……かな。アレ。: I… think I found it. That thing.
m300158.言ってる傍から敵襲みたいね！\n向こうの方角から魚人の群れが接近中、\n……それ: It sounds like an ambush! A school of merfolk is approaching from that direction… and there's a new monster wielding a harp, too.
m300158.誘いの申し出は嬉しいが、\nその誘いは謹んで断らせて頂こう。: I appreciate the invitation, but I must respectfully decline.
m300158.謎の飛行物体……未確認飛行物体、ですね。: A mysterious flying object… an unidentified flying object, right?
m300158.賛成です……と言いたいですが、\n今はやめた方が良さそうです。\nあっちを見るで: I'd agree… but it seems best to skip it for now. Let's keep an eye out over there.
m300158.酒の強さと腕の強さ……男子たるものどちらも備えていて\n当然のもの。ここはひとつ: Strength of drink and strength of arm—both are essential for a true man. So, let's drink and see who can stand up to the Prince; that's what makes a man, right?
m300158.青い目玉の魔物は、\n以前にも見た事がありますね。: I've seen those blue-eyed monsters before.

m300333.――いや待て。先に伝えることがある。\n助手君、きみには容疑者の\n証言をしっか:
—No, wait. There's something I need to tell you first.
Assistant, I'm going to need you to carefully scrutinize the
suspects' testimonies.
m300333.――おっと、違うぞ助手君。\nリュティエは犯人をかばっている！:
――Ah, no, that's not it, Assistant.
Luthier is covering up for the real culprit!
m300333.――こうして、ひとつの事件が終わる。\n次の事件は東か西か、北か南か！\n名探偵:
――And so, one case comes to a close.
Will the next case be in the east, the west, the north, or the south?
Detective Anabella's mystery drama continues!
m300333.――ここが通報のあった、邪教徒の隠れ家ですか。\n街の中に潜伏しているとは、大胆:
――So this is the hideout of the cultists we were called to investigate.
Hiding in plain sight in the middle of town… quite bold of them.
m300333.――そこまで！\nこの戦い、勝者は……ッ！:
――That's enough!
The winner of this battle is…!
m300333.――どんどん、ぱふぱふ、にゃんにゃかにゃーん♪\n第１回、王国紅白大合戦、開催だ:
――Dun-dun, puff-puff, nya-nya-nya-nyaaan♪
The 1st Kingdom Red-and-White Grand Melee is about to begin~♪
m300333.――ゆえに、どうしても第三勢力になりたいなら、\nどちらも選ばず制限時間を待つと:
――Therefore, if you absolutely must remain a third party,
you can choose neither and simply wait for the time limit!
m300333.――ツー、お前だったか。\nこちらの動向に気付いていたのか。\nここまでの仕込み:
—So it was you, Two.
You were aware of our movements.
Our preparations up to this point have been ruined.
m300333.――仁義、仁義か。\nならばその仁義とやらで、\n私の武技に打ち勝ってみせるがい:
—Honor, is it?
Then let that honor of yours
try to overcome my martial arts.
m300333.――待て待て待て！\n王子、降伏する！ お前たちも落ち着け！:
――Wait, wait, wait!
Prince, I surrender! Everyone, calm down!
m300333.――新年の王城、盗まれたデシウス人形、\n４人の容疑者、そこに現れるは名探偵！:
—The New Year's Royal Palace, the stolen Desius doll,
four suspects, and then, the great detective makes her appearance!
m300333.…………いや、気のせいだろう。\nともかく、このアジトの捜索を始めよう。\n何か:
…No, it's probably just my imagination.
Anyway, let's begin searching this hideout.
Hopefully, some evidence is still here.
m300333.…………吾輩、サボってていいかのう？: …………Do you think I can just slake off here?
m300333.……この慌てよう、大当たりみたいね。\n王子、ガサイレ開始よ！:
……Judging by the panic, we must have hit the mark.
Prince, let's begin the search!
m300333.……そこに吾輩も巻き込まれたと？: ……And I've been dragged into it as well, you say?
m300333.……なんじゃ？\nすごい足音が聞こえてくるんじゃが……。:
……What is that?
I can hear the sound of heavy footsteps approaching…
m300333.……もう、隠すことはできないでしょう。\n我々は魔王ガリウス様の人形を作っていた:
……There's no point in hiding it anymore.
We were making figures of Demon Lord Galius.
m300333.……堂々と、ヒットリストに\n加えると宣言していきやがった。:
……He boldly declared that he would
add us to his hit list.
m300333.……大変そうだな、王子。: ……Looks like you're in for it, Prince.
m300333.……組織は変わらねばならなかった。\nはぐれ者の互助組織など、長続きするはずもな:
……The organization had to change.
A mutual aid group for outcasts could never last.
You must have understood that, Irene.
m300333.……魔王だって？\n魔王ガリウスの信奉者ってことかしら。:
……The Demon Lord?
Are you followers of Demon Lord Galius?
m300333.──悪ふざけはそこまでだ、占星術師。\nお前がお年玉を知らん訳がないだろうが。:
──Enough with the prank, Astronomer.
There's no way you wouldn't know what otoshidama means.
m300333.──破魔矢を射ってたんですか？ 何故？: ──So you were shooting the hamaya? Why?
m300333.「にゃはは、私は犯人じゃないですよ」\n疑うなんて酷いです！:
“Nyahaha, I'm not the culprit!”
How could you even suspect me? That's so mean!
m300333.「バシラは絶対に犯人じゃないです」\n当然ですよね？:
“Bashira is definitely not the culprit.”
That's only natural, right?
m300333.「リュティエは犯人ではありません」\n真犯人をかばっているんです。:
“Luthier is not the culprit.”
He's covering up for the real one.
m300333.ああ。お前はまだ、失うには惜しい男だからな。\n金の稼ぎ方というものがよく分かっ:
Ah. You are still a man too valuable to lose.
You know how to make money well.
Now, hurry and run.
m300333.あっ……夢が静かになっていきますね。\nどうやら、激戦の振り返りが終わったようで:
Ah… the dream is growing quiet.
It seems the replay of the fierce battles has come to an end.
m300333.あの御方の側近自ら、か……。\n伝説の戦い方を見られないのが心残りだが、\n先に:
The Prince's own aide……
I regret not getting to see that legendary fighting style,
but I'll be taking my leave.
m300333.ありがたきお言葉……。\nこれで魔王様の威光を、\n物質界に広めることができるで:
I'm deeply grateful for your kind words…
With this, we can surely spread the Demon Lord's glory
into the material world.
m300333.いえ、こちらも調査不足でしたから。\n双方けが人がいなくて何よりです。:
No, no. Our investigation was lacking, too.
It's a good thing nobody got hurt.
m300333.いずれは激突する相手だ、気にするなセブン。\n――しかし、何か引っかかるな……。:
We will clash with him eventually, so don't worry, Seven.
—But, something is bothering me…….
m300333.いやいや、怪しまれることをしたのはこちらだから――: No, no, we're the ones who made you suspicious—
m300333.うぅ……バレていましたか。\n閃いた瞬間は王子くんっぽくて、\n面白いかなーと思:
Uu… so it was obvious, huh.
The moment the idea hit me, it felt so like the Prince,
I thought it might be fun.
m300333.うぅぅぅ、仕方ない！ おーい！ 皆の者ー！！\n王子の悪夢を蹴散らすのじゃー！！:
Uuuuugh, I suppose I have no choice!
Hey, everyone—!!
Let's smash the Prince's nightmare to pieces—!!
m300333.うむ。助手君、焦ってしまったんだろうね。\nリエーフは犯人ではない。:
Yes. You must have panicked, Assistant.
Lev is not the culprit.
m300333.うむっ、解説のガオレオンであるッ！\n熱く激しく輝きに満ちた戦いを期待するッ！！:
Um! I am Gaoleon, your commentator!
I look forward to a hot, fierce, and dazzling battle!!
m300333.うむっ。\nでは吾輩たちも、夢から覚めるとしようかの♪:
Mm.
Then let us all wake from this dream, shall we?♪
m300333.うむむ、これは迷ってしまうな……。\nどちらとも戦いたいッ、その気持ちは分かるぞ:
Um, um, this is a tough choice…
I want to fight both of them! I understand that feeling!
m300333.うん……絶対に勝ちましょう。\n王子と一緒に、目指せ優勝です。:
Yes… we absolutely have to win.
With the Prince by our side, let's aim for the championship!
m300333.えぇ、頼りにしています！\nそれではさっそく、容疑者の証言を――:
Yes, we're counting on you!
Then, let's get right to it and hear the suspects' testimonies—
m300333.えぇっ、それはさすがに悪いような……。: E-eh? That seems a bit too much…
m300333.ええ、おとし弾だそうです。\n東の国に古くから伝わる文化で、\n厄除けの意味があ:
Yes, it's called an otoshidama.
It's a tradition from the Eastern lands,
supposedly meant to ward off bad luck.
m300333.ええ、皆さんお疲れさまでした。\n後片付けはこちらで担当しますので、\n皆さん体:
Yes, everyone did a great job.
I'll take care of the cleanup, so please make sure not to catch a cold.
m300333.えっと……それでは、全力でいきますね？: Um… well then, I'm going to give it my all, okay?
m300333.えっと、私たちも一緒に行っても……？: Um, can we come along too…?
m300333.お、王子まで……。\nうむっ、それでは手早く片付けてしまおう！\n終わったら全員: Oh, even the Prince… Alright, let's finish this quickly! When it's done, everyone gets a special bonus!
m300333.おい王子、約束は覚えているな。\nさっさとお年玉を寄越すがいい。: Hey, Prince. Don't forget our deal. Hand over that New Year's money, will you?
m300333.おお、来てくれましたか名探偵アナベラ！\nしかし今回の事件は難しいですよ……。\:
Oh, you've arrived, Detective Anabella!
But this case is a tricky one…….
After all, there are four suspects……!
m300333.おっと、なんじゃレーヴではないか。\nいったいこの珍妙な場所は何なのじゃ。:
Oh my, isn't that Reve?
Just what is this peculiar place, I wonder.
m300333.おっと、違うぞ助手君。\n焦ってしまったのかな？:
Ah, no, that's not it, Assistant.
Did you get flustered?
m300333.おや、思ったより悩んでいるな……。: Oh, you're more troubled than I thought…
m300333.くっ、怪盗サバルが逃走する！\n追え！ 追えーっ！！:
Curses! Phantasm Saval is escaping!
After them! After them!!
m300333.こういう戦いも悪くない、かな。\nいつもは命をかけた戦いばかりだけれど、\nこれ:
Battles like this aren't bad, I suppose.
Usually, it's always life-or-death combat, but
this way, we can actually have some fun.
m300333.ここが怪盗サバルの犯行現場か……。\nまさかあの至宝、デシウス人形を盗み出すとは:
So this is Phantom Thief Sabar's crime scene…….
To think he would steal that treasure, the Desius doll.
m300333.こちらが今回の容疑者、\nリュティエ殿、リエーフ殿、テティス殿、バシラ殿だ。:
These are the suspects in this case:
Lord Luthier, Lord Lev, Lady Tethys, and Lady Bashira.
m300333.こちらを選んで良かったの？\nふふっ。だって、\nこのチームなら負ける気がしない:
I'm glad you chose this side.
Heh. After all,
I have no intention of losing with this team.
m300333.この剣技……こいつ、何者だ……！: This swordsmanship…… Who is this person……!
m300333.これはますます、勝たねばなりませんね。\nカッコイイところ、見せてあげるとしまし:
Well, that just means we have to win.
Let's show them a truly dazzling performance.
m300333.こんな取り調べ必要なんてないよ！\nだって「ボクが犯人」なんだから！！:
I don't need to be interrogated!
Because “I'm the culprit”!!
m300333.さて、逮捕はアンナ警部にまかせておこうか。\nもし捕まっても、また脱走するだろう:
Now then, I'll leave the arrest to Inspector Anna.
Even if she catches them, they'll probably escape again.
m300333.しかし、中々に愉快なひとときだった。\n王国軍の戦士たちよ、その顔は覚えておこう:
However, it was quite an entertaining time.
Soldiers of the Kingdom's army, remember my face.
m300333.しかし、魔王様は人間にとっては侵略者。\nそんなフィギュアを堂々と並べては、\n:
However, the Demon Lord is an invader to humans.
If we displayed such figures openly,
we would surely frighten the citizens.
m300333.しかしここで捕まるわけにはいかない。\n名探偵アナベラ、そして助手王子！\nお前:
But I can't let myself be caught here.
Detective Anabella, and Assistant Prince!
I'll make sure to remember your faces!
m300333.すっかり自分が王国軍の常識に\n染まってしまったのを実感するな……。: I can feel it now… I've completely absorbed the Kingdom's way of thinking.
m300333.そう、怪盗サバルは……バシラに変装しているぞ！！: That's right, Phantasm Saval is… disguised as Bashira!!
m300333.そう、怪盗サバルは……バシラに変装しているのだ！！: That's right, Phantasm Saval is… disguised as Bashira!!
m300333.そうね。それじゃあ行くわよ……。\n――全員動くな！ 強制捜査だッ！！:
I agree. Well then, let's go…
――Nobody move! This is a forced search!!
m300333.その声は……なんだ、ツーじゃないか。\nいったい何の用だ？\n今回の作戦に、ツー:
That voice…… Who is it? Two?
What do you want?
You weren't supposed to be involved in this operation.
m300333.その選択が吉と出るか凶と出るか。\n王国紅白大合戦は、三つ巴の戦いとなってしまっ:
Whether that choice proves to be lucky or unlucky…
The Kingdom's Red and White Grand Tournament has turned into a three-way battle!
m300333.そら、早く備えろ。星の雨が降ってくるぞ……！: There, get ready. The star rain is coming…!
m300333.それじゃ、荒らしちゃったし\n片付けを手伝ってから帰ろうかしら。:
Well, since we made such a mess,
I suppose we should help clean up before we head home.
m300333.それじゃあ早速ルール説明だよ。\n聞き流してると大変なことになるから、\nちゃー:
So, let's get right into the rules.
If you zone out, things will get messy,
so pay close attention, okay~?
m300333.それじゃあ選択タイム、行ってみよう♪: Well then, let's get started on the selection time♪
m300333.それでは、私は「読み返し」を担当しましょう。\n条件や証言をもう一度お伝えします:
In that case, I'll handle the “replay.”
I'll go over the conditions and testimonies again.
m300333.それと、配置する兵は\nちゃんと姿が見える子じゃないとだめだぞ～？\n隠れるのが:
Also, the troops you place
have to be ones that are clearly visible, okay~?
If they're good at hiding, you won't be able to see them!
m300333.それなら私がお教えしましょうか。\n友人にその道の有識者がいましてね、\nおしる: If it's that, I can recommend one. A friend of mine is quite the expert in that field, and she knows a shop with delicious oshiruko.
m300333.それにしてもお前たち、\n捜査に対して、慌てて品物を隠したら\n怪しまれるに決ま:
That said, you two!
Panic and hiding the goods in the middle of an investigation?
That was bound to make you look suspicious!
m300333.そろそろ分が悪い、か。\n悪党は悪党らしく、尻尾を巻いて逃げるとしよう。:
It seems the odds are turning against me.
A villain should act like one and flee with his tail between his legs.
m300333.そんな同胞たちに、\n懐かしき魔界を思い出すアイテムを与えられたら、と。:
We wanted to provide our fellow demons
with an item that would remind them of their nostalgic demon realm.
m300333.ただし、配置するユニットは\n「姿が見える者」でなければならないぞ！\n隠れてい:
However, the unit you place must be
“visible to the eye”!
If they're hiding, we won't be able to see them either!
m300333.ただの執事、ではなさそうね……。\nあの太刀筋、付け焼き刃のそれではないわ。:
They don't seem like just a butler……
That sword technique isn't something picked up in a hurry.
m300333.だが、闇ギルドは必要な組織だった。\nお前たちは、金に目がくらんで仁義を捨てたの:
But the Dark Guild was a necessary organization.
You were blinded by money and abandoned your honor.
m300333.ちっ……仕方ない。今回は助けられた。\n後で礼はさせてもらうとしよう。:
Tch…… I guess I have no choice. I was saved this time.
I'll make sure to repay you later.
m300333.ついでにオススメの甘味屋も教えろ。\n可能なら若い女に人気な店が好ましい。\n参: And while you're at it, recommend a good sweets shop. Preferably one that's popular with young women. Just for reference, though. If you read too much into it, I'll kill you.
m300333.で、でーと……！\nそれでは……私もご一緒しますっ！:
A d-d-d-date…!
Then… I'd be honored to join you!
m300333.で、デーモンシェフ！？\nいったいどういうこと？:
Wait, the Demon Chef!?
What exactly is going on here?
m300333.であれば、代金は私持ちだな。\nなに、私からの迷惑料兼お年玉さ。: In that case, I'll cover the bill. It's nothing; consider it my apology for the trouble, plus my New Year's gift.
m300333.では、さらばだ諸君！\nにゃーっはっは、にゃーっはっはっは！！:
So, farewell, you all!
Nyee-ha-ha, nyee-ha-ha-ha!!
m300333.では助手君、犯人が分かったら、\n「犯人の前に近接ユニットを配置」して、\n犯人:
So, Assistant, once you've identified the culprit,
“place a melee unit in front of them”
to accuse them of the crime!
m300333.では王子よ、あちらの戦士たちを見るがよいッ！: Then, Prince, behold the warriors over there!
m300333.では行くぞ、助手君。\n次の事件が、ぼくらを待っているからね。:
Let's go, Assistant.
The next case is waiting for us.
m300333.と、いうことだと思います……。\nただ困ったことに、例年この夢に来ると……。:
That is what I believe…
However, the trouble is, every time I come to this dream…
m300333.と、いうわけだ王子。\n今年は例年以上の破魔矢を用意している。\n射手の希望者も: So that's the situation, Prince. We've prepared more hamaya than usual this year. The number of volunteers to shoot them keeps increasing every year, too.
m300333.どうやら王子が今年の激戦を夢で思い出しているらしく、\nその記憶の激しさと、\n:
It seems the Prince is recalling this year's fierce battles in a dream,
