m320304.それは不明です。\n私は冥界の門が閉じるより前に、\n物質界側へ帰還しましたので: That is unknown. I returned to the material world before the underworld gates closed.
m320304.なんというのか……。\nふふっ、まっすぐなところは王子とそっくりなのかしら？: How should I put it… Heh, maybe his straightforwardness is just like yours, Prince.
m320304.はじめまして、オリジナルの王子様。\n対人類用戦闘自動人形のルインです。: Nice to meet you, Original Prince. I am Ruin, a combat automaton designed for humans.
m320304.ダークアンナさんとは、\n魔王ガリウスとの決戦の時にお会いしましたけど……。: I met Dark Anna during the final battle against Demon Lord Garius…
m320304.トラムさま！\nあれ……？ 休暇中だったのでは……？: Lord Tram! Huh...? Weren't you on vacation…?
m320304.不明です。\n私にはどちらの表情も、よく読み取れません。\nですが――: I can't say. I can't quite read either expression. But—
m320304.休暇先で大変な事件に巻き込まれちゃってね。\nさぁ王子、新たな仲間の紹介と、\n: I got caught up in a serious incident while on vacation. Now, Prince, I'm here to introduce a new ally and report on the incident involving the Dark Prince.
m320304.同意します。\n旅の道中、王子殿下のことばかり聞かされましたので。: I agree. I've heard nothing but about Your Highness throughout the journey.
m320304.新たな、仲間と……えっ、えぇっ！？\nダーク王子さんにまつわる事件！？\n彼はま: A new ally… what? An incident about the Dark Prince!? Is he still alive!?

m400201.――悪いね王子、時間とってもらって。\n実は昔の知り合いから、不穏な噂を聞いてさ: — Sorry to take up your time, Prince. Actually, I heard some unsettling rumors from an old acquaintance...
m400201.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ人や、ワルキューレを\n出撃メンバーに入れることを忘れ: Make sure you have someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and a Valkyrie on your deployment team.
m400201.あっと、今回は普段よりも大規模な戦いになるから、\nいくつか重要なことを伝えてお: Oh, and this time the battle will be larger than usual, so I need to go over a few important points...
m400201.あとは、ライフが０になってもクリアになって、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウントされ: Even if your life hits zero, the mission still counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain gets tallied toward your record.
m400201.えーっと、大討伐ミッションでは、\n『多くの敵を撃破すること』が唯一の目的。: In a Grand Extermination Mission, the sole objective is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400201.おっと、出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も、\nしっかり覚えておいて。: Oh, and remember the deployment cost doesn't recover over time.
m400201.このまま見過ごしたら、連中のことだから、\n次はどんな暴挙に出るか分からない……: If we just turn a blind eye, you know how they are—who knows what they'll do next... We have to stop them before that happens.
m400201.それから敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできないよ: Also, you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops from the enemies you defeat—I'm not stealing them, I swear!
m400201.それじゃあ王子、頼りにしてるよ。\n『大討伐ミッション』開始だ！: Alright, Prince, I'm counting on you. Let the Grand Extermination Mission begin!
m400201.だから、ま、前みたいに騙したりしないから！\nアンタの力を、アタシに貸してくれな: So, I won't pull any tricks like before! Could you lend me your strength?
m400201.だから、傷つくことを恐れるよりも、\n少しでも多くの相手を倒すことを考えた方がい: So it's better to focus on racking up kills than worrying about taking damage.
m400201.でも、アタシひとりじゃ、\n厳重な『見張り』を突破するのも正直難しい……。: But on my own, breaking through their heavy “watch” is honestly going to be tough...
m400201.どうやら、闇の組織に新たな幹部が台頭して、\nその勢力を急速に伸ばしてるらしいん: Apparently a new commander is rising within that group, and they're rapidly expanding their influence.
m400201.今回の戦いは普段の魔物討伐とは違う、\n『大討伐ミッション』って形になるんだ。: This fight isn't a regular monster hunt; it's a “Grand Extermination Mission.”
m400201.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれが一番重要ってことらしい。: In short, the more foes you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400201.組織でも有力な、\n数字のコードネームを持つ連中も集まって、\nアジトの防衛戦力: Even the big players with numeric code names have joined, and they've bolstered the base's defenses by a huge margin.
m400201.闇の組織って覚えてる？\nアタシが昔いた闇ギルドの、\n残党たちが作った組織のこ: Remember the dark organization? The remnants of the Dark Guild I used to be part of formed a new group...
m400201.闇の組織のアジトは多数の防衛戦力だけじゃなくて、\n遠目の利く見張りがいるはずだ: The dark organization's base isn't just packed with defenses; there are long-range scouts too. Keep an eye on troop placement so you don't get spotted.

m400327.――王子、此度は白の帝国、王国共同で行う\n軍事演習への申し入れに快諾頂いたこと: ――Prince, I want to express my gratitude once more for your gracious acceptance of the joint military exercise between the White Empire and the Kingdom.
m400327.そうだな、形式としては普段の\n魔物討伐の任とは違い『大討伐ミッション』\nとい: Right, as a format this will differ from our usual monster-hunting quests; we'll call it a “Grand Hunt Mission.”
m400327.それでは『大討伐ミッション』開始とさせて頂く！: Now then, let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400327.たとえライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した数はカウントされ\n: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you defeated will be tallied as your battle record.
m400327.つまり、自軍の被害を恐れるよりも\n少しでも多くの相手を打ち倒す事に\n専念する: In other words, rather than worrying about your own casualties, you should focus on slaying as many foes as possible.
m400327.まず大討伐ミッションでは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれのみが唯一の目的となる。: First, the sole objective is simple: defeat the enemy.
m400327.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできない。\n: And defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or item drops, so remember that.
m400327.今回の演習は帝国と王国、互いの戦力を知り\n共闘を学ぶ良い機会だ、貴公の国の兵も: This exercise is a great opportunity for the Empire and the Kingdom to learn each other's strengths and to fight side-by-side. Your country's troops will also take part.
m400327.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれこそが最も重要だ。: The more opponents you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400327.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も留意しておけ。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ: Also note that deployment cost does not recover over time. Make sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400327.場所については当帝国の領土内、\n新設した防衛拠点にて行う事になる。: The location will be within our Imperial territory, at a newly-established defensive outpost.
m400327.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションとは違い\n幾つか異なる点がある事に注意して: Keep in mind that a Grand Hunt Mission has several differences from a normal mission.
m400327.有事の際には貴国の力を借りる事もあるだろう。\nその際に互いの力を知らない、\n: In times of crisis we may call upon your nation's aid. It would be problematic if we didn't know each other's capabilities or couldn't coordinate.
m400327.此度の演習、王国帝国双方にとって\n意義のある演習となることを願っているぞ。: I hope this exercise proves meaningful for both the Kingdom and the Empire.
m400327.此度の演習の目的は、我が帝国軍の\n軍力向上、並びに貴国との連携の強化にある。: The purpose of this exercise is to improve our Imperial forces and to strengthen cooperation with your nation.
m400327.演習とは言え、こちらとしても拠点の効果の程を試す\n絶好の機会だ。全力で当たらせ: Even though it's a drill, it's a perfect chance for us to test the outpost's effectiveness. We'll give it our all—don't let your guard down either.

m400477.――失礼します。\n王子、緊急事態です。: ――Excuse me. Prince, we have an emergency.
m400477.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵や、ワルキューレを\n出撃メンバーに入れることを忘れ: Be sure to include troops with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and a Valkyrie in your deployment team.
m400477.ことは緊急を要するため、\nこちらの被害が発生したとしても、\n少しでも多くの敵: Because time is of the essence, prioritize killing as many enemies as you can, even if we suffer some losses.
m400477.このままではどんな被害が発生するか分かりません。\n急ぎ出撃の準備をお願いいたし: We have no idea what damage could occur if we do nothing. Please prepare for deployment immediately!
m400477.これらの勢力が激突寸前となっている、\nその理由は不明なままです。: These forces are about to clash, but we don't know why.
m400477.さらに、出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も、\nしっかり覚えておいてください。: Also, remember that deployment costs do not recover over time.
m400477.しかし、現地では竜将クロコの姿も確認されています。\nこの異常事態が魔王軍の企み: However, sightings of the dragon general Croco have also been confirmed on site. If this crisis is the Demon King's scheme, we can't just turn a blind eye.
m400477.それから、詳細は不明ですが、\nゴブリンによる見慣れない兵器があった、\nとの報: Additionally, there are reports of an unfamiliar weapon used by goblins, though details are scarce.
m400477.また、ライフが０となってもクリアしたことになり、\nそれまでに倒した数が、戦果に: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of foes you've slain will be recorded as your result.
m400477.また、今回の討伐戦は、\n普段以上に大規模な戦いとなります。\nそのため、いくつ: Also, this extermination will be larger than usual, so I'll go over a few important points.
m400477.今回の戦いは普段の魔物討伐とは違う、\n『大討伐ミッション』という形をとります。: This battle isn't a regular monster hunt—it's a “Grand Extermination Mission.”
m400477.周辺地域への被害を抑える為に、\nとにかく敵の数を減らすことに終始してください。: To minimize collateral damage, focus on cutting down enemy numbers above all else.
m400477.大討伐ミッションでは、\n『多くの敵を撃破すること』が最大の目的。: In a Grand Extermination Mission, the primary goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400477.如何なる事態にも対応出来るよう、\n万全のご準備をお願いします。\nそれでは『大: Prepare thoroughly for any eventuality. Let's begin the Grand Extermination Mission!
m400477.最後に、この大討伐では、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れる: Finally, during this Grand Extermination you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops from defeated enemies. The safety of the people comes before any reward.
m400477.現状では睨み合いの状況とのことですが、\n戦闘が始まり、激化した際には、\n間違: At the moment they're just staring each other down, but if combat breaks out and escalates, it will inevitably cause civilian casualties in the surrounding area.
m400477.警ら中の兵士より、\nダークエルフ、オーク、そしてゴブリンが集結し、\n一触即発: Our patrol reports that dark elves, orcs, and goblins have gathered, and the situation is on the brink of eruption.

m400482.……ううん、変なこと聞いちゃってごめんなさい。: …No, I'm sorry for asking something weird.
m400482.……と、その前に。\n王子はちゃんと王子……だよね？: …Before that, you're still the Prince, right?
m400482.……今回は雪山での戦いになるから、\n戦闘中『吹雪』で視界が悪くなる事があるかも: …Since this battle takes place in the snow mountains, the blizzard may reduce visibility during combat.
m400482.──と、討伐に向かう前に\n今回の戦いで重要なことを\n説明しておくね。: —Before we head out on the hunt, let me explain what's important about this battle.
m400482.これ以上騙される人達が増える前に、\nドッペルゲンガーをやっつけにいっちゃおう！: Before more people get fooled, let's go take down those doppelgängers!
m400482.それと、凍った地面の上では戦いにくくて\n近接クラスの皆は戦える場所が\n限られ: Also, fighting on frozen ground is tricky, so melee units will have a hard time finding places to fight.
m400482.それと出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないから、\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ人や、: Also, deployment cost doesn't recover over time, so make sure you have someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and include a Valkyrie in your deployment team!
m400482.そんな凍った地面を利用して、\n滑って駆け抜けてくる敵もいそうだから\nくれぐれ: Enemies might use that icy surface to slide right through, so be extra careful.
m400482.だから傷つく事を恐れないで、\n一体でも多く魔物を倒す事を優先してね！: So don't fear getting hurt—focus on taking down as many monsters as you can!
m400482.だから自分達の被害を抑えるより、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を倒せるかが\n一番重要: So instead of minimizing our own losses, the key is how many foes we can slay!
m400482.でも、王子なら絶対に勝てるって\n私信じてるから！: But I'm sure you'll win, Prince—I believe in you!
m400482.でも雪山での戦いだったら私に任せて。\n王子の力になってみせるから！:
But if it's a battle in the snow mountains, leave it to me.
I'll prove I've got your back, Prince!
m400482.なんでも王子と魔物の連合軍が、\n各地を侵攻して回ってるだなんて、\nそんな噂が: Rumor has it that you and a coalition of monsters have been marching across the lands.
m400482.ドッペルゲンガーに連れてこられた魔物や人達、\nそれに慣れない雪山での戦いは\n: The monsters and people the doppelganger brings, plus fighting in unfamiliar snowy mountains, will make things tougher than usual.
m400482.ドッペルゲンガーの変身能力にも個体差があって、\n強い人の姿に化けたからってその: Doppelgangers' transformation abilities vary—just because they take on the form of a strong person doesn't mean they can copy that person's power.
m400482.中には何人もの王子を見かけたなんて報告も……。\n……きっと、王子に化けたドッペ: Some reports even say they've seen multiple Princes… It must be those doppelgängers impersonating you.
m400482.人を騙すなんて卑怯なこと、\nそんなの私許せないよ！: Deceiving people is cowardly, and I can't stand that!
m400482.今回の戦いは、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒すことを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』: This fight is a “Grand Hunt Mission,” where the goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400482.以上が今回の戦いの説明だよ。: That's the rundown for this fight.
m400482.偉い人や魔物に化けたドッペルゲンガーが、\n部下を騙して戦力を集めていってるんだ: I think doppelgängers disguised as nobles or monsters are tricking their subordinates and gathering forces.
m400482.北の雪山で沢山の人や魔物を見かけた\n話もあるみたい。多分、魔物や\n騙された人: There's also talk of many people and monsters spotted in the northern snow mountains. Probably the monsters and the duped folks are gathering there.
m400482.大討伐ミッションでは、\nライフが0になってもクリア扱いになって、\n倒した敵の: Even if your life drops to zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you defeat is recorded as your battle result.
m400482.大討伐ミッションでは普段のミッションと違って\n『敵を撃破すること』だけが目的に: In a Grand Hunt Mission, unlike regular missions, the only objective is to crush the enemies.
m400482.急に執務室に入ってきたりしてごめんね！\nでもとっても大事な話があるの！: Sorry for barging into the office like this! But I have something really important to tell you!
m400482.敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品が手に入ったりはしないから\nその点: Defeating enemies won't give you EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400482.早く戦いを終わらせて、折角の雪景色を楽しも！\nそれじゃ王子『大討伐ミッション』:
Let's finish the battle quickly and enjoy the beautiful snow scenery!
Alright, Prince, the “Great Hunt Mission” starts now!
m400482.王子がひどい事するなんて、\nそんなこと絶対あるわけないのにね。: There's no way you'd do something terrible, of course.
m400482.逆に力を持ったドッペルゲンガーなら、\n強大な魔物に化ける事もできちゃうみたい。: On the flip side, a doppelganger that does have power can even turn into a mighty monster.

m500155.……あの大盾を持った敵。\n警戒した方が良さそうだな。:
...That enemy with the big shield.
We should keep an eye on it.
m500155.……やはり、通常の武器では\n効果が見込めませんか。: …so, as expected, conventional weapons won't be effective.
m500155.……黒鎧の魔神、キメリエス。\n彼の魔神が再び地上に現れたと見て\n間違いないで: …the black-armored demon god, Kimeries. I'm certain his demon has resurfaced on the surface.
m500155.『その漆黒の槍の前には如何なる堅固な盾も、\n魔法の護りも無意味である』と。: “Before that jet-black spear, no shield, however sturdy, nor any magical protection, will matter.”
m500155.あのような盾から攻撃を受けては、\n意識を保つ事も困難でしょう。: Getting hit by a shield like that would make it hard to stay conscious.
m500155.あれだけの痛手を負わせたのです。\nしばらく魔界から動くことはできないでしょう。:
We've inflicted such a grievous wound.
They won't be able to move from the demon realm for a while.
m500155.いざという時は、\n私達付与魔術師の力も使うと良いわ。\n皆の武器に、魔法の力を: When the time comes, we can also use our enchantment magic. We'll imbue everyone's weapons with magical power.
m500155.この言葉の意味する所はまだ判りません……ですが、\n微塵の油断もならない相手であ: I don't fully understand the meaning yet… but there's no doubt this opponent allows no margin for error. Please remain vigilant.
m500155.そう願いたいものじゃの。\nあんな怪物が暴れまわっては\nおちおち余生も過ごせん:
I hope that's the case.
We can't have that monster running amok and ruining our peaceful retirement.
m500155.た、助かりました……キメリエス、\nそれにその眷属の能力下にある鎧の硬さは、\n: We… we were saved… Kimeries, and the armor hardened by his minions' abilities, is far beyond normal.
m500155.はい……皆さんが無事で、\n本当に良かった。: Yes... I'm so glad everyone is safe.
m500155.はい、皆さんよろしくお願いします。\n王子、戦闘のご指示をお願いします！: Yes, everyone, thank you. Prince, please give us your battle orders!
m500155.また文献には、\n『真の脅威は魔の軍馬を駆り、槍を振るう姿にある』\nとの記載も: The texts also mention, “The true threat lies in the figure wielding demonic warhorses and spears.”
m500155.やはりここは、\n我々魔法を使える者の出番のようですな。\n魔法の力を侮らないこ: It seems this is the moment for those of us who can use magic. Never underestimate magical power!
m500155.キメリエス……更には\nその眷属の力までもが加わった鎧の前には、\n並大抵の物理: Kimeries… moreover, with his minions' strength added to his armor, ordinary physical attacks would be virtually useless.
m500155.キメリエスが退いていくようだ。\nひとまず、危機は去ったと言えるだろう。: It looks like Kimeries is retreating. For now, we can say the crisis has passed.
m500155.兵士の鍛錬、チーム編成の見直し、\n可能な限りの準備を行った上で、\n戦いへと臨: Train the soldiers, rethink team composition, prepare as much as possible, and then go into battle.
m500155.報告によれば、軍勢を率いている魔神は、\n黒き鎧を身に纏った、\n騎士のような姿: According to the report, the demon god leading the army is clad in black armor and looks like a knight.
m500155.奴が何度蘇ろうと問題ないよう、\n我々ももっと力をつけねばなりませんね。\n……:
No matter how many times it resurrects, we need to become stronger ourselves.
...But for now, let's celebrate this victory.
m500155.幾ら剣で攻撃しようと、ただ刃が欠けるばかり。\n有効打を与えられているとは、\n: No matter how we strike with swords, the blades just chip away. I don't think we can land any effective hits…
m500155.文献によれば、キメリエスの力は自身に与する\n鎧の力を引き上げ、その硬度を高める: Texts say Kimeries can amplify the power of his armor, increasing its hardness, and that this power also extends to his minions.
m500155.王子、正面から受けるのは危険かと。\n慎重なご采配をお願いします。:
Prince, taking it head-on would be dangerous.
Please act cautiously.
m500155.王子、此度の戦いにおいては魔法を主体とした\n皆様の力が有効かと思われます。しっ: Prince, in this battle you'll need to rely on magic. Your forces' magical power should be effective. We must devise solid countermeasures and face the fight.
m500155.王子、緊急の事態です。魔界より、\n鎧の軍勢を率いた魔神が出現したとの\n報告が: Prince, we have an emergency. Reports have come in that a demon god leading an armored army has appeared from the demon realm.
m500155.王子も、此度の激戦でさぞお疲れでしょう。\n城へと戻りゆっくり休まれて下さい。:
Prince, you must be exhausted after that fierce battle.
Return to the castle and rest.
m500155.皆、我々が来るまで良く耐えてくれました。\n戦況はどうなっていますか？: Everyone held out well until we arrived. What's the current situation?
m500155.見た処、武器のような物も持っていない。\n恐らくあの盾自体が、\n武器のような物:
From what I saw, it didn't have any weapon.
I think the shield itself is its weapon.

m900184.――……報告！ \n天使達が魔法陣へと消えていきます！: ——…Report! The angels are vanishing into the magic circle!
m900184.――あの姿……間違いない、\nあれは神獣ベヒモスだよ。: —That form… no doubt about it, that's the divine beast Behemoth.
m900184.……しかし、その全貌を掴もうと接近を試みたところ、\n辺り一面を包み込んだ光によ: …But when we tried to get closer to grasp its full shape, a light engulfed the area, blinding us, and we were suddenly flung far away.
m900184.……そういう事なら、ここの見張りはワシに任せい。\nさっきの戦いで、そこら中ベヒ:
…If that's the case, I'll take over guard duty here.
The whole area's covered in fragments of Behemoth's claws and fangs from the fight earlier.
m900184.……でもね、その努力の甲斐もあって、\nすっごい装備に仕上がったんだから♪: …but thanks to all that effort, it turned out into an amazing set!♪
m900184.……どうやら敵は退いたようですね。: …It looks like the enemy has retreated.
m900184.……仕方がありません。\n邪魔者は排除せよとの神の命。\n……これより遂行いたし: …there's no helping it. By God's command, eliminate the obstacles. …We will carry this out now.
m900184.……堕天使の方々によれば、神獣ベヒモスは\n巨体に見合う底知れない体力、強靭な牙: …According to the fallen angels, Behemoth possesses endless stamina to match its massive size, and its mighty fangs grant tremendous attack power.
m900184.……天界と物質界を繋ぐゲートみたいなものだよ。\nあれを通る事で、天使達は天界と: …It's like a gate linking the celestial realm and the material world. By passing through it, angels can freely travel between them!
m900184.……想定以上に被害が出ています。\nこのままでは使命の遂行に支障が……。: …The damage is exceeding our estimates. If this continues, it'll hinder our mission…
m900184.……承知いたしました。\n全ては神の御心のままに……。: …Understood. All shall follow the will of God…
m900184.……準備は整いました。神より仰せつかりし\n人類浄化の使命……絶大なる神獣の力を: …Preparations are complete. By God's decree, we shall fulfill the mission of purifying humanity, using the immense power of the divine beast.
m900184.……目覚めた神獣の力を行使すれば、\n新たな門を作り出す事も可能です……もっとも: …If we wield the awakened beast's power, we could create a new gate… though certain conditions would be required.
m900184.……辺り一面を包む光に、遠方へと\n飛ばされる事象……恐らくは神獣の力、\n『神: …A light that wraps everything and sends you flying far off… It's probably the beast's power, the “Divine Radiance.”
m900184.……隠しようのない神獣ベヒモスの巨躯。\n見つかる事も想定の内……とはいえ、\n: …the massive, unmistakable form of the divine beast Behemoth. We expected it might be discovered… but it was sooner than we thought.
m900184.あ、そうだ。ベヒモスの武具を着用して戦う時は、\n称号を『巨獣の大牙を砕きし者』: Oh, right—when you equip the Behemoth gear, change your title to “Crusher of the Great Beast's Fang.”
m900184.あの時の王子様、本当にカッコよかったなぁ……。\n……って違う違う！\n今日はそ: You were so cool back then, Prince… …wait, that's not it! I didn't come here to talk about that!
m900184.あの様子であれば、またすぐに動き出すという事は\nなさそうです……ですが、いつこ: From how they're acting, they probably won't move again right away… but we can't tell when they'll use this gate again and the angels will launch an attack…
m900184.あの見た目……身体は何かの鉱物のようですね。\n矢での攻撃はあまり通用しそうにあ: Its appearance… its body seems like some kind of mineral. Arrows won't do much. Prince, perhaps you could employ magic?
m900184.あの魔法陣は……まさか、\n天界への門！？\nそんな、どうしてここに……！: That magic circle… could it be a gate to the heavens?! How could it be here…!
m900184.お二人ともありがとうございます。\n頼りにさせて頂きますね。:
Thank you both.
We'll be counting on you.
m900184.お邪魔しまーす♪ どう、王子様？\nベヒモスとの激闘の疲れは取れた？: Here I come♪ How are you, Prince? Feeling rested after that fierce battle with Behemoth?
m900184.けど、本来こんな所にあるものじゃ……。: But something like this shouldn't be here…
m900184.このまま捨て置く訳にはいきません。\n急ぎ出撃の準備を……といきたいものですが、: We can't just ignore this. I'd like to say we should rush to prepare for deployment, but our opponent is a divine beast—far too reckless to face unprepared.
m900184.この地で与えられし使命は\n既に果たされました。: Our purpose here has already been fulfilled.
m900184.この間の戦いは本当に大変だったね。\n巨大なベヒモス相手に切った張ったの大立ち回: That fight was really something. A huge showdown with Behemoth, dodging those massive tusks with style, then landing the finishing blow!
m900184.そうです！ あなた方の企みは、\nここで阻止させて頂きます！: Exactly! We'll stop your scheme right here!
m900184.そこで此度の戦いでは、部隊を複数に分けることで\n神の威光の影響を小規模に抑える: Therefore, I propose we split our forces into multiple units, limiting the radiance's impact—a “Grand Total War” strategy.
m900184.それと、神獣の爪牙から作り出した武具だからかな？\nなんだか不思議な力が宿ってい: Maybe it's because they're made from the beast's own claws and fangs, but there's a strange power in them. The beast-folk say they feel invigorated just by looking at the armor.
m900184.な、なんですかあれ。\nお……おっきすぎます！！: W-what is that? It… it's huge!!
m900184.やがて人は知る事になるでしょう、神の御心に逆らう\nその愚かさを……ですが、今は: In time, humanity will come to understand the folly of defying the divine will… but that time has not yet come. We must withdraw and prepare for what's to come.
m900184.わしはこの天界の門とやらを調べてみるとするかの。\n門を封ずる手立ても、何か見つ:
I'll go investigate that celestial gate.
There might be a way to seal it, or at least find something useful.
Prince, I'll let you know as soon as I find anything.
m900184.アイギス様の加護を強く受ける王子には、\n威光の影響も小さく、戦線への復帰も可能: You, Prince, who are strongly protected by Aegis's blessing, will be less affected by the radiance and can return to the front lines. However, we can't leave you alone on the battlefield.
m900184.ニエルさん、あの魔法陣は一体……？: Niel-san, what exactly is that magic circle…?
m900184.一体何の目的であのような地に……いえ、\nそれがなんにせよ、我々人類にとって、\: Whatever its purpose for being in that place… whatever it is, it's certainly not a good thing for humanity.
m900184.不用意な攻撃を受けないよう、\n遠距離の攻撃に徹する等の戦術も\n時には有効とな: To avoid careless strikes, tactics like focusing on long-range attacks might sometimes be effective.
m900184.何を企んでいるかは判りませんが、\nやすやすと好きにさせる訳にはいきません！: We don't know what they're plotting, but we can't just let them do as they please!
m900184.僕が今日ここに来たのは……じゃーん！\n王子様の新しい武具を届けにきたんだ♪: I came here today to… ta-da! I've brought you your new gear, Prince♪
m900184.僕たち鍛冶職人の魂を打ち込んで作った鎧だから、\n絶対に王子様を守ってくれるはず: We blacksmiths poured our souls into this armor, so it'll definitely protect you. Put it to good use in battle!♪
m900184.光に触れた敵対者、全てを遥か遠方へと転移させる\n『神の威光』への対策なくして、: Without a countermeasure against the “Divine Radiance,” which teleports any foe it touches far away, victory seems impossible.
m900184.堕天使の方々に獣の特徴をお伝えしたところ、\n特徴が一致する神獣に心当たりがある: When I relayed the beast's traits to the fallen angels, they mentioned a divine beast that matches… They think it must be the “Divine Beast Behemoth.”
m900184.実はあの闘いのあと、ベヒモスの落とした爪牙から、\n王子様の新たな武具を作れない: Actually, after that battle we've been working with the blacksmiths to forge new equipment from Behemoth's shed claws and fangs for you.
m900184.敵の力は強大です。くれぐれも、\n油断なさらぬよう……それではこれより\n『大総: The enemy's power is immense. Please stay vigilant… With that, let's commence the Grand Total War!
m900184.敵の正体はやはり神獣でしたか。\n……対策を練ってきて正解でしたね。: So the enemy's true form was indeed a divine beast… Good thing we prepared countermeasures.
m900184.普段よりも多くの兵力が必要となる戦いとなります。\n万全の準備を整えた上で、戦い: It will require more troops than usual. Let's prepare thoroughly and then face the battle.
m900184.本当に加工が難しい素材だったんだよ。\nあまりの硬度に、一体どれだけの\n工具が: The material was insanely tough—so many tools broke just trying to shape it…
m900184.来るよ王子！ \nあのラッパを持った天使の持つ笛の音は、\n敵の士気を高める効果: Here it comes, Prince! The trumpet-bearing angel's horn boosts enemy morale, so watch out!
m900184.武具は装備しないと意味がないんだから。\n持ってるだけじゃダメなんだからね？: Gear's useless unless you actually equip it. Just holding it won't do anything, okay?
m900184.獣を目撃した兵によれば、遠目からにも見える\n丘のような巨体に、大木のような爪牙: The soldier who saw it says the creature had a hill-sized body and claws and fangs as big as trees.
m900184.王子、この場は皆さんに任せ、\n私達は帰還致しましょうか。\n此度の激闘お疲れ様:
Prince, let's leave this to everyone else and head back.
Thank you for the fierce battle.
m900184.王子、失礼いたします。\n領内の渓谷にて巨大な獣の姿を見たと、\n巡回を行ってい:
Prince, excuse me.
We've received a report from patrol soldiers who saw a gigantic beast in the valley of our lands.
m900184.王子様の為の武具を打つ夢、なんだか早くも\n叶っちゃったかな……ううん、もっとも: I guess the dream of crafting gear just for you has already come true… No, I'll forge even more incredible weapons for you. Look forward to it!
m900184.神の意に背くその愚かさ……\n……それこそが、粛清すべき\n人の罪だと言うのに…: The folly of defying the will of the gods… that itself is the sin that must be purged…
m900184.神獣の爪牙、一体どのような材質なのか\n興味深い……何かに使えるやもしれん、\n:
The divine beast's claws and fangs… I wonder what they're made of.
Might be useful for something, so I'll pick them up while I'm at it.
m900184.鍛冶職人皆の力を合わせて作った鎧と大鎚、\nちょっと重たいけど、王子様だったら\: The armor and massive hammer we forged together are a bit heavy, but I'm sure you'll handle them with ease, Prince!
m900184.（……それにしても、アレほどの巨体、\n一体いつこの地に……降り立ったのであれば: (…Anyway, with a body that massive, when did it even descend onto this land? If it did, we'd have noticed something…)

m910001.――王子、プラクティスクエストへようこそ！: — Prince, welcome to the practice quest!
m910001.あれはご褒美のつもりなので。\n次はもっと倒せるように、がんばってくださいね♪: That was meant as a reward. Next time, try to defeat even more, okay?♪
m910001.あれ？ いつもの「ざこざこ～」っていうの、\n言ってあげないの？: Huh? Aren't you going to say the usual “so weak~”?
m910001.うんうん、がんばりましたねー。: Yeah, yeah, you did your best.
m910001.ここでは、制限時間内に\nどれだけ多くの敵を撃破できるかを試す、\nタイムアタッ: Here you can take on a time-attack, seeing how many foes you can defeat within the limit.
m910001.ここは、味方が放つ範囲攻撃が、\nどこまで効果を及ぼすのかを確認できる演習場です: This area lets you see how far your allies' area attacks reach.
m910001.ここは味方との連携や、\n個人での武技を試すことのできる演習場です。: This is the training grounds where you can test teamwork with allies and practice your individual combat skills.
m910001.ここは味方の耐久力を試す演習場で、\n木人が「物理攻撃」をしてきます。: This area tests your allies' durability; the dummies will use physical attacks.
m910001.ここは味方の耐久力を試す演習場で、\n木人が「防御力」と「魔法耐性」の\n両方を: This area tests your allies' durability; the dummies will use attacks that ignore both defense and magical resistance.
m910001.ここは味方の耐久力を試す演習場で、\n木人が「防御力を無視した攻撃」をしてきます: This area tests your allies' durability; the dummies will use attacks that ignore defense.
m910001.ここは空を飛ぶ敵との\n戦闘を想定した演習場です。: This training ground is set up for battles against airborne enemies.
m910001.すごいすごーい！ 全部倒しちゃった！: Amazing, amazing! I cleared them all!
m910001.また、見通しのよい櫓も用意しました。\n射程が延長されますので、\n癒し手を配置: We've also set up a clear-view tower. Its extended range lets you position healers to keep your team topped up.
m910001.もし途中で演習を中断したくなった場合には、\n私の前に兵を配置し、その旨を伝えて: If you need to pause the drill, just place a soldier in front of me and let me know.
m910001.わぁっ、ざこざこなのに頑張りましたねー♪: Wow, you did great even though they were so weak~♪
m910001.後半になるほど木人や、彫像の強さも増していきます。\nぜひ、１００体すべての撃破: As the battle goes on, the wooden dummies and statues get stronger. Aim to take down all one hundred of them.
m910001.挑戦は何度も受け付けております。\n如何なる戦術、如何なる武技が見られるのか！\: We welcome challenges over and over. What tactics, what techniques will you show? Please enjoy what's ahead!
m910001.攻撃力は看板に書かれていますので、\n試してみたい木人の前に兵を配置してください: Their attack power is listed on the signboards—place your troops in front of the dummy you want to try.
m910001.木人からすれば、\nここで訓練した者は戦友も同然。\n強さを見せれば喜ぶのも道理: From a dummy's perspective, anyone who trains here is practically a comrade. It's only natural they'd be pleased to see strength.
m910001.木人たちも嬉しそうですね。\nぴょんぴょん跳ね回っています。: The wooden dummies look happy too. They're hopping around.
m910001.爆風を伴う攻撃などのチェックに、\nぜひ活用してください。: Feel free to use it to check things like explosions.
m910001.１０分が経過するか、木人を撃破すると、\nこの演習は終了となります。: The exercise ends after ten minutes or when you defeat all the training dummies.

m920029.……あ！ お主らは！ 丁度よい！\n頼む、わしの同胞を止めてくれぬか！？\nもは: …Ah! You there! Perfect timing! Please, stop my kin! My words can't reach them any longer…
m920029.……いえ、お礼には及びません。\nあなた達が安心して暮らせるなら、\n私達はそれ: …No, there's no need to thank us. As long as you can live in peace, that's enough for us.
m920029.……だが、一部の竜人たちはそうもいかぬ。\nあやつらのように共存に反対し、武力を: …However, some drakes won't accept that. There are those who oppose coexistence and try to subjugate us by force.
m920029.……またお前らか！\nお宝があるところに必ず現れやがるんだな。\nさては俺らの宝: …You again! You always show up wherever there's treasure. You're here to steal ours, aren't you?!
m920029.……分かりました。\nあなた方の目は澄んでいます。\n嘘偽りなど無いと信じましょ: I understand. Your eyes are sincere. I'll trust there's no deceit.
m920029.……王子！\n今日は私も前線に立たせてください……！: …Prince! Please let me stand on the front lines today as well…!
m920029.……！ ライバルが来やがったな。\nこりゃネバネバの相手なんてしてる場合じゃねぇ:
…! A rival shows up.
This isn't the time to be dealing with slime.
m920029.……！ 魔物！ こんな時に！\n英霊となった彼らにゆっくり花をたむける事さえ\n: …! Monsters! At a time like this! They won't even let us take a moment to lay flowers for those who became heroes…
m920029.…しかし、なにか小さいようじゃな。\nまぁいい！\n持ち帰るにはちょうど良い大き: …But it looks a bit small. Oh well! It's the perfect size to bring back!
m920029.あ、お前！\n話が違うじゃねーか！\nお宝なんかどこにもなかったぞ！: Hey, you! That's not what happened! There was never any treasure!
m920029.ああ！ 思い出したわ！\nたしか宝探しを手伝ってくれた王子様ご一行ね！\nお陰様: Ah! I remember now! You're the Prince's party that helped with the treasure hunt! Thanks to you, we made a killing back then.
m920029.あいつらもネバネバも倒して\n俺たちゃ大金持ちだ！: If we take down those pirates and the slime, we'll be filthy rich!
m920029.あなたあの時の……！: You... you were there back then!
m920029.あなたにはこっそり教えちゃう。\nその代わりまた手伝ってよね！: I'll tell you in secret, but you'll have to help me out again, okay?
m920029.あなたの代わりはいないのです。\nですがあなたには沢山の仲間がいる。: There's no one who can take your place. But you have many allies.
m920029.あなたは……竜人の大長老！: You're… the Grand Elder of the drakes!
m920029.あなたは……！\nあの時の海賊さんではないですか！: You…! Aren't you that pirate from back then?
m920029.あの時、人間はやっぱり優しいんだ、\n私の思ってた事は間違ってなかったんだって\: Back then, I was convinced that humans are truly kind, that my doubts were wrong.
m920029.あの時王子が助けてくれなかったら、\n人間と竜人は今でもずっと\n戦い続けていた: If the Prince hadn't saved us then, humans and drakes would still be locked in endless war today...
m920029.あの暗く湿った抜け道だけが\n私の最後の希望でした。: That dark, damp secret passage was my last hope.
m920029.あの炎の魔物は……召喚獣……？！\nあれは、召喚士でないと扱う事は出来ないはず！: That fiery monster… a summoned beast?! Only a summoner should be able to control it!
m920029.あの魔物は強力な魔法の力で攻撃してきます！: That monster attacks with powerful magic!
m920029.あら？ あなた達どこかで見た気がするわ。: Oh? I think I've seen you somewhere before.
m920029.あれ、お宝なかったんだ。うーん。\nとりつくされちゃったのかしらね。前に来た時は: Oh, there was no treasure? Huh… Maybe we were possessed. When we came before, nobody knew about this place yet.
m920029.あんな魔物の相手してたら\n命がいくつあっても足りゃしねぇ！\nさっさと王子ども:
Dealing with a monster like that, no matter how many lives you have, ain't enough!
We'll just cut down the Prince and make a run for it…!
m920029.いいえ、お気になさらず。\nこれからも気を付けてくださいね。: No, don't mention it. Please stay safe from now on.
m920029.う、うるせぇな。\nお宝への期待が高まりすぎて\n体がほてってきたって意味だよ！: Shut up! My excitement over the treasure's got my blood heating up!
m920029.うむ。あの時の巫女の行動がなければ\n戦いは続き、数に劣る竜人の敗北に\n終わっ: Indeed. Without the priestess's actions, the war would have continued and the outnumbered drakes would have been crushed.
m920029.え……山賊？\nこんなところになぜ……。\nまわりは海だらけなのに。:
Huh… bandits?
Why here…
The whole area is just sea.
m920029.ええっ……！？\n魔物が人間に助けを求めるなんて……。: What…!? A monster begging humans for help…?
m920029.おいおい……あの炎の魔物がお宝だと……？\nあんなもん一銭にもなりゃしねぇじゃね:
Hey hey… that fiery monster's supposed to be treasure…?
That thing's not worth a damn!
Damn! Got fooled again…!
m920029.おいおい。なんだここは。\nあっついな！: Hey, hey. What the heck is this place? It's blazing hot!
m920029.おお巫女よ。\nわしはこの通り無事じゃ。: Ah, priestess. I'm fine, just as you see.
m920029.おお！あれは……！\nまさしく偉大なる炎の大精霊では！: Oh! That…! It's the great fire spirit itself!
m920029.お久しぶりです。\nあの時は大変お世話になりました。: It's been a while. Thank you for everything back then.
m920029.くそっ。なんだこのネバネバ野郎！\nどんどん出てきやがる……。\nしかも、宝は全:
Damn it. What the hell is this slime-y bastard!
It keeps popping up…
And we haven't found any treasure at all.
m920029.けど、今回無理に前線に立たせてもらって、\n新たな力を得る事ができました。\nこ:
But this time, being forced onto the front lines gave me new strength.
All thanks to you, Prince, and everyone else.
m920029.ここは……。\n道を間違ってしまったのでしょうか……。\n見た事もない場所です。: This place… Did we take a wrong turn? I've never seen it before.
m920029.ここはお宝の匂いがプンプンするぜ！: I can smell the treasure all over this place!
m920029.ここは灼熱の地です。\n兵の体力が奪われてしまいます。\nお気を付けください！: This is a scorching land. Our troops' stamina will drain fast. Please be careful!
m920029.この大穴は、まさか……！: This huge hole… could it be…!
m920029.これからは私も今回の旅で得た力を使って、\n王子、そして皆のサポートをさせていた: From now on, I'll use the power I gained on this trip to support you, Prince, and everyone.
m920029.これからも彼らが敵となる事が\nあるかもしれませんね……。\n王子、これからも充:
We may still run into them as enemies in the future…
Prince, let's stay on our guard.
m920029.これでもう大丈夫です。\n家に帰れますよ。: Now it's safe. You can return home.

m920057.あはは、じゃあね。\n次に会う時は敵同士かもしれないけれど。\nその時は手加減し: Heh, see you later. We might be enemies next time we meet… and I won't hold back.
m920057.いずれ世界は闇に包まれる。\n光では世界は救えぬ、本当に世界を救いたくば、\n闇: Eventually, darkness will engulf everything. Light can't save the world—if you truly want to save it, you'll have to seize the power of darkness.
m920057.いやー、まさか最後の一つがあんな場所に……。\nなんで貴様はあんなところに落とす: Whoa, I never expected the last one to be in that place… Why would you drop it there?
m920057.うむ。\n我輩はちゃんと奥の手を準備しておいたのだ。: Yes. I've got a proper trump card ready for them.
m920057.うるさいのがいなくなったか。\n貴様たちが、どんなにがんばっても\nすでに世界の: So the noisy ones are finally gone. No matter how hard you all try, the world's fate is already sealed.
m920057.うるさい！\nまだお前が落としたものが全部見つからんのだ。\n手分けして探してい: Quiet! I still haven't found everything you dropped. We're searching in teams, so hold on.
m920057.うーん、暗黒騎士団は機動力が乏しいのよねぇ。\n騎兵はいるけど、飛び道具がノロい: Hmm, the Dark Knights are so sluggish. We have cavalry, but our ranged attacks are painfully slow. Oh, I've got a good idea!
m920057.うーん。困ったわね。\nあたし、あんまり美味しくないと思うけどなぁ……。: Hmm, that's a problem. I don't think I'm very tasty, though…
m920057.う～ん。負けちゃったわね。\n作戦は良かったと思うんだけど、\nあたしの力が足り: Huh… we lost. The plan was solid, but my strength wasn't enough… I'm sorry.
m920057.え、ちょっと待ちなさいよ。\nもしかして嘘ついてるの！？: Wait, hold on. Are you lying to me?!
m920057.えっ、本当に？ いいの？\n良かった～。\n早速プレゼントを詰め込まなきゃ！: Really? That's okay? Great! I have to start packing the presents right away!
m920057.えっと……。\nあんたは……。\n人間……、なわけないわよねぇ……。: Um… you're… you're not human, are you?
m920057.おかげで子供たちにプレゼントが\n配れるわけだし。結果的にあんたが\nしたことで: Thanks to you, the kids get their gifts. In the end, because of what you did, they'll be happy.
m920057.お前、我輩との約束を信じているのか？: Do you really trust the promise you made with me?
m920057.ぐぬぅ。仕方ない……。\n暗黒騎士たちよ、\n少しだけ王子の足止めをしておくのだ: Hmph. Fine... Dark Knights, hold the Prince off for a little while.
m920057.この雪山ってあたしよく来るんだけど、\n結構強い吹雪がくるのよね。大丈夫なの？: I come to these snowy mountains a lot, but the blizzards can get pretty fierce. You all okay?
m920057.こんなところにいたか。\nやったぞ、お前が落としたものを全部見つけたぞ！: There you are. Gotcha—I found everything you dropped!
m920057.こんな場所までおびき寄せ、\n罠を張っても倒せぬとは。\nもはやここまでか……。: To think I'd lure you all the way out here, set a trap, and still be unable to defeat you... Is this how it ends?
m920057.さ、次の場所に行こっと。: Let's head to the next spot.
m920057.さすがに強いわね。\nあたしも少しは腕に自信があったのに\nお姉さん、ちょっとシ: You're really strong. I thought I had some skill, but… sister, I'm a bit shocked…
m920057.さて、本題ですがあの人からの伝言を\nお伝えします。: Now, getting to the point, I have a message from that person to deliver.
m920057.じゃあ団長さん、あたしはもう行くね。\nみんながプレゼントを待ってるだろうから。: Well then, Commander, I'm off. Everyone's waiting for their presents.
m920057.そうだな。\n我輩が王子たちを引き付けておくから、\nお前はもう一方から攻めてく: Right. I'll keep the Prince occupied, and you attack from the other side.
m920057.そうねぇ。\n王子がこんなに手強いとは思わなかったわ。\nそろそろあたし達も攻め: Yeah. I never expected the Prince to be this tough. We should start pressing the attack soon.
m920057.そうねぇ。やっぱり日々、\n筋肉を鍛えておく事かしらね。\n弦を引く力が強くない: Well… you've got to keep training your muscles every day. If you can't pull the string strong enough, it's no use.
m920057.そして、そのプレゼントを拾ったのが、\n暗黒騎士団だったらしく……。: And it seems the Dark Knights picked up those presents…
m920057.その事で、彼女から伝言を預かって\nきています。: About that, I have a message from her.
m920057.その団長からプレゼントを返して\n欲しかったら、王子を倒すのを手伝うよう\n約束: Their leader said that if we want the presents back, we have to help him defeat you, the Prince, as promised.
m920057.その間に、我輩がやつらを手なずけておく。: In the meantime, I'll go tame those creatures.
m920057.それならいいのよ。\nでも、あたし一人じゃ、王子たちの相手は無理よ。\n手が空い: That's fine then. But I can't handle the Princes alone. Send a few idle subordinates my way.
m920057.それに、多分あたし一人じゃ\n集めきれなかったと思うわ。\nだから感謝してるのよ: And I doubt I could've collected them all by myself. So, I guess I'm… kind of grateful, anyway.
m920057.それは、あんたへのプレゼントよ。\nあたしからのね！: That's a present for you—from me!
m920057.そろそろ撤退だ！\n次の戦場へやつらを招待してやるぞ。: Time to retreat! I'll invite them to the next battlefield.
m920057.ただどんな攻撃でもそこそこ効くはずなので、\n全員で一気に畳みかければ再生が\n: Still, any attack should do decent damage, so if we all strike together, its regeneration won't keep up and we should be able to take it down.
m920057.だから私たち行商人は、\nトロルに目をつけられないように、なるだけ荷物を\n隠し: That's why we merchants try to hide our cargo as much as possible so a troll won't target us…
m920057.だって約束したじゃない。\nあたし何かおかしな事いったかしら？: But you promised, didn't you? Did I say something weird?
m920057.ちょっと～！\nあなたが王子打倒を手伝えというから\n戦っているのに何であなたは: Hey! You told me to help defeat the Prince, so I'm fighting, but why aren't you fighting yourself!
m920057.でも、あたしが落としたプレゼントを\n手下全員使ってかき集めてくれたしね。: But you did gather up the presents I dropped, using all your minions.
m920057.とりあえず、その話はあとで聞くから\n今は退却しましょ。: Anyway, we'll hear about that later. For now, let's retreat.
m920057.どうして私たちを襲うのですか？\n理由を……。: Why are you attacking us? Give us a reason…
m920057.なかなか切り崩せんな。\n忌々しい奴らよ。: They're not going down easily. Damn cursed fools.
m920057.なかなか難しいですね。\nコツはあるんですか？: That's pretty tough. Is there a trick to it?
m920057.なに、ちょっと雪山にな。\n手なずけられそうな奴らもいるしな。\nさぁ行くぞ。: What, a snowy mountain? There are some folks we can tame there. Come on, let's go.
m920057.なによりそのプレゼントは私が\n手配したものなんです。\nそれが魔物の手に渡って: Besides, I arranged that present myself. I don't want it falling into monsters' hands!
m920057.なら良かったわ。\nもうっ……。びっくりさせないでよね。: Good, then. …Don't try to surprise me again.
m920057.なんだと～！\n全員で探した方が効率が良いのだが……。\n仕方がない何人か連れて: What the—! It's more efficient if we all search together… Fine, take a few with you.
m920057.ねぇ、あなたが魔物と戦っている\n王子さま？: Hey, are you the Prince fighting the monsters?
m920057.ねぇねぇ、それなら二手に分かれて\n攻撃してみない？\nこの場所だったら丁度良さ: Hey, hey, how about we split into two groups and attack? This spot looks perfect for that.
m920057.ふ、ふざけるな！\n我輩がしたことが善い事だったとでもいうのか！\n馬鹿馬鹿しい: Don't you dare! You think what I did was a good thing? Ridiculous!
m920057.ふん。これで終わりと思うなよ。\n忌々しい王子め。: Hmph. Don't think this is the end, you cursed Prince.
m920057.ま、まぁこれくらいで倒せるようなやつらなら、\n苦労はせんよ。\n次は別の作戦を: Well, if they were that easy to defeat, it wouldn't have been a challenge. We'll just come up with a new plan next time.
m920057.まさかあんな派手な格好のままで\n動き回るなんて……。: I can't believe you're wandering around in such flashy clothes…
m920057.も、もちろん貴様がちゃんと役目を\n果たすならな！: Of course, as long as you do your part!
m920057.もっと力を込めて、弦を強く引かないとだめよ。\n遠くまで矢を飛ばせるのが\n弓の: You've got to pull the string harder, put more power into it. That's the whole point of a bow—sending the arrow far.
m920057.やっぱり負けちゃったぁ。\nちょっと悔しいわ。: So I lost after all… That's a bit frustrating.
m920057.ようやく、貴様が落としたものを\n全部見つけてやったぞ。返してほしくば、\n打倒: Finally, I've found everything you dropped. If you want it back, you'll have to help defeat the Prince.
m920057.よしよし、\n王子たちはまんまとついてきているようだな。: Well, well, it looks like the Prince and his friends have fallen right into our trap.
m920057.わかっているわよ。\nようやく、あなたたちも戦うってことね。: I know. So you're finally willing to fight, huh.
m920057.わかっておる。\n暗黒騎士団の名にかけて絶対に見つけてやる。: Understood. In the name of the Dark Knights, I'll definitely find them.
m920057.イエティよ！ あの人間どもが貴様らの\n住処を襲おうとしているぞ！: Yeti! Those humans are trying to invade your home!
m920057.クンクン……。\n人間の肉の匂い……。: Sniff… the scent of human flesh…
m920057.トロルは興味がある物への執着心が\n強いんです。宝石とか……高価な宝物が\n大好: Trolls are obsessed with things they fancy—jewels, precious treasures—they love those, and they especially adore humans.
m920057.ニンゲン、許サナイ！！\nニンゲン、タオス！: Humans, we won't forgive you! Humans, die!
m920057.フフフ、嘘か真かわかりませんが\n良い子にしていないとプレゼントがもらえないと\: Heh heh, I can't tell if it's true or not, but I've been threatened by my parents every time I misbehave, saying I won't get presents unless I'm good.
m920057.プレゼントは返してやる。\n勝手に持って行くがいい。: I'll return the presents. Take them back however you like.
m920057.プレゼントを待っている子供たちって……\nいったい何を言っているんですか？: Children waiting for presents… What on earth are you talking about?
m920057.事情はトトノさんに伺っています。\nご無事でよかった……。: I've heard the details from Totono. I'm relieved you're all right…
m920057.分かりました。ありがとうございます！\nでは王子、今のことに注意していきましょう: Understood—thanks! Then, Prince, let's stay on guard about what just happened.
m920057.喰いたい……。その肉……。\nその袋の中身も、全部……！: I want to eat… that meat… everything in that sack!
m920057.団長！\n王子たちの行軍が思ったより早く、\nすぐ後ろに迫っています！: Commander! The Prince's march is faster than we expected— they're closing in from behind!
m920057.困ったわね。\nこのままじゃ、プレゼントを\nみんなに渡せなくなるわ。: This is troublesome. If we keep going like this, we won't be able to deliver the presents to everyone.
m920057.当たり前じゃない。\nあ、団長さん、王子たちが来たみたいよ。: Of course I will. Oh, Leader, it looks like the Prince and his men have arrived.
m920057.彼女はこの間、うちから沢山のプレゼントを\n仕入れてくれたのですが、その後、\n: She recently got a lot of presents from us, but then she apparently dropped them by accident.
m920057.悪いけど悠長に話している時間が\nないのよね～。\nさっそく行かせてもらうわ♪: Sorry, but we don't have time to chat leisurely~. Let's get going right away♪
m920057.我々暗黒騎士は、肉体はとうに滅んでいます。\n筋肉がないんですが、どうしましょう: We Dark Knights have long since lost our bodies. We've got no muscles… what should we do?
m920057.改めまして、私の名はトトノ。\n各地にある珍しい物とかを仕入れて\n売ってる行商: Nice to meet you—my name's Totono. I'm a traveling merchant who buys rare goods from all over and sells them.
m920057.敵だったあたしを助けてくれて、\n本当にありがとう。感謝しているわ。: Thank you for rescuing me, even though we were enemies. I'm truly grateful.
m920057.案ずるな。\nこの雪山に慣れているやつらを\nてなずける予定だ。: Don't worry. I've got plans to tame the locals who are used to these mountains.
m920057.次はもう少し作戦を練ってくるわね。\nじゃあ、またね～♪: Next time I'll come up with a better plan. See you~♪
m920057.気をつけてください。あいつは傷を負っても\nすぐに回復します。: Be careful. Even if it gets wounded, it heals instantly.
m920057.王子、ごぞんじですか。冬の季節になると、\n子供たちが寝ている間にプレゼントを\: Prince, did you know? They say that during winter, someone distributes presents to children while they're sleeping.
m920057.王子、サラサさんが……！\n助けないと！: Prince, Sarasa's in trouble! We have to help her!
m920057.王子さまも、これからは是非うちを\nひいきにしてください。: Prince, please make sure to favor my shop from now on.
m920057.王子たちは雪山の戦いに慣れてないから、\nすぐに決着がつくだろう。: Since the Prince and his friends aren't used to fighting here, the battle will end quickly.
m920057.王子！ 暗黒騎士団がいました！\nさきほどの女性も一緒みたいです。\n助けましょ: Prince! The Dark Knights are here! It looks like that woman from earlier is with them too. Let's help!
m920057.王子！ 暗黒騎士団が撤退していきます。\nどういう事でしょうか。\nあとを追いま: Prince! The Dark Knights are retreating. What does that mean? We should give chase.
m920057.王子！ 魔物が現れたようです！\n戦闘のご準備を！: Prince! Monsters seem to have shown up! Prepare for battle!
m920057.私としても、せっかくのごひいきさんが\n危ない状況なのは頂けません。: I can't stand seeing my favored customer in danger.
m920057.私の名前はトトノ。行商人です。: My name is Totono. I'm a traveling merchant.
m920057.私はこれから商品を\nお得意さんに運ばなきゃいけないので\nここでお別れです。そ: I have to deliver goods to my regular customers now, so this is goodbye. Farewell.
m920057.私は信じていましたよ。魔物が復活した今でも、\n子供たちに夢と希望を届けていてく: I believed it. Even now that monsters have returned, I can't help hoping they'll still bring dreams and hope to children.
m920057.話によるとどうやらあの人、\n脅されているらしくて……。: Apparently, that person is being threatened…
m920057.頼りになるじゃない。\n次はどこに行くのかしら？: You're reliable, aren't you? I wonder where we'll go next.
m920057.（愚かな女だな。\n我輩が約束を守ると、\n信じ切っているのだろうか……。）: (What a foolish woman... Does she really believe I'll keep my promise?)
m920057.（真面目に探してくれるのは良いのだけど……。\nこの人たち王子を倒すという本来の: (It's good they're searching seriously, but… haven't they forgotten their original goal of defeating the Prince?)

m920060.――ぁぁ…ぁ…メトゥス様……有り難うございます。\n……お泣きになることは……な:
—Ah… Metus… thank you.
…There's no need for you to weep…
You already have… so many… comrades…
m920060.――ぅっ……。\nどうやら私はこれまでのようです……\nメトゥス様を……お頼みし:
—Ugh…
It seems I'm just as I've always been…
Lord Metus… I entrust this to you…
m920060.――ッ！？ \n……ククク、バカを言わないでちょうだい。\n私に怖いものなんて―:
――!?
...Heh heh, don't be absurd.
There's nothing that scares me—.
m920060.――ッ！？ 何を……言ってるの？\n私よ！ メトゥスよ！ あなたのマスター！\n: —! What are you… saying? It's me! Metus! Your master! …Seriously, you don't remember?
m920060.――フフフ、悩む必要などありませんよ。: —Heh, there's no need to worry at all.
m920060.――私ハ魔神ビフロンス様ノ忠実ナル僕……。\nサァ、ビフロンス様ニ仕エシ死霊タチ:
I am a loyal servant of the demon Bifrons.
Now, Bifrons' undead minions and I will… strike down the Prince…
m920060.……い、嫌よ。私は筋肉よりは骨が好きだし。\nそれにあなた。なんだか長生きしそう: …N-no. I prefer bones over muscle. And you… you look like you'll live forever. Ahh, if this keeps up, it'll end up just the two of us!
m920060.……うそよ。\nだって、あなたは私の死霊で。\n私はあなたのマスターで……こんな: …That's a lie. Because you're my death spirit. I'm your master… This can't be.
m920060.……えーと。\nも、もしかして、死霊術師のメトゥスさんの\n助手のリッチさんでし: “Um… Could it be… the assistant Lich of necromancer Metus?”
m920060.……え？ そんな言い方はないだろって？\nわ、分かってるわよ。今回は亡き父上の\: “…Huh? You think that's a weird way to put it? I get it. This time I'll restore my late father's reputation.”
m920060.……このリッチはね、私のネクロマンシーで\n最初にこの世に生み出した不死者なの。: …This lich was the first immortal I created with my necromancy.
m920060.……そう、ですか。\n貴方は、随分と変わられたようですね。: …Is that so? You've changed quite a bit, it seems.
m920060.……そうね。あなたの言うとおりだわ。\nこんな顔してたら、私を救ってくれた王子に: …Indeed. You're right. With a face like this, I'd be rude to the Prince who saved me. Thank you, Memento.
m920060.……なんか眼がいやらしいから遠慮しておく。\nあッ王子ぃ！ ちょっとちょっとぉ！: …Your eyes are a bit… unsettling, so I'll pass. Ah, Prince! Wait, wait! About that thing from before—…
m920060.……なんでもない。過去は変えられないもんね。\nでもねメトゥス、これからメトゥス: …Never mind. You can't change the past. But, Metus, I believe the way you live from now on can paint those memories any color you want.
m920060.……め、トゥス、さま……？\nメトゥス様ではないですか……ぅッ、ぐぐ……。: …M-Metus, sir…? Isn't this… Metus-sama… ugh, gag…
m920060.……も、申しわけありませんでした。\n先刻は、魔神ビフロンスに\n操られてしまっ:
…I… I'm sorry.
It seems I was being controlled by the demon Bifrons just a moment ago…
m920060.……コロス……ち、ちがう……めとぅす……。\n……ビフロンスサマ、今、貴方様ノ下: …Kill… no, that's not it… Metus… Lord Bifrons, now returns beneath you… Again, a fresh corpse for me…
m920060.……人間に、戻る……戻らないと……、\n私が、私でなくなってしまうわ……。\nで: …to become human again… if I don't… I'll cease to be myself… But… becoming human again…
m920060.……大丈夫よ。\nさあ、先に進みましょう。\nもう後ろを向くのには、些か疲れまし:
…It'll be fine.
Come on, let's move forward.
I'm a little tired of looking back now.
m920060.……怖いわ……こんな感情があるなんて。\n私、知らない……未知は……こわいの……: …I'm scared… to have these feelings. I don't know… the unknown… it's frightening.
m920060.……死体？ なによ失礼ねー……。\nふわぁ。よく寝た。\n――ってあれ？ ここは:
…A corpse? How rude.
Phew. That was a good nap.
—Wait, where am I?
m920060.……汝を造りし、主メトゥスが命ずる！\n汝、骸なれば骸に還るべきなり！\nはぁあ:
…I, Metus, who forged you, command you!
You, being a corpse, shall return to the corpse!
Haa…!
m920060.……神は罪を赦す存在でもあります。\n私たちは、常に主と共にあります。\nですが: …The gods are also beings who forgive sins. We're always with the Lord. But for now, we'll take our leave.
m920060.……行ってしまわれましたね。\n心の整理にはまだ時間が必要ですね。: …He's gone. It'll take more time to sort out our feelings.
m920060.「反魂の至宝」っていってもカケラじゃない。\n蘇ってもせいぜい一度きりよ。\nダ:
Even if it's the Treasure of Reversed Souls, it's not just pieces.
Even if they come back, it's only once.
Darling, now's my chance to shine. Give me what you've got.

If the legend's true, then even if we slay those monsters,
they'll revive.
m920060.「癒しの至宝」という宝玉が\n封印された迷宮があります。: There is a labyrinth sealed with a jewel called the “Treasure of Healing”.
m920060.『生死は問わぬ』とね。\n我が主ながら実にユーモアがある。\n不死者に生死を問わ: “Life and death are irrelevant,” he said. My master has quite the sense of humor. Not caring about life or death for the undead… heh heh.
m920060.あのヌルヌルって骨もないし、\n死霊にしたって、全然役立たずだわ！\nさ、先へ進: That slime's got no bones, and even as a necromantic thing it's completely useless! Come on, let's move forward, darling?
m920060.あの助手リッチが持ってきたみたいだな。\nもしや依頼料としてお宝でも持ってきたの:
Looks like that assistant Ritch brought it.

Let's see what's inside…Whoa! A woman's corpse!
m920060.あら、懐かしいわね。もちろん覚えてるわよ。\nあの時のダーリンの強さっていったら: Ah, those were the days. Of course I remember. Darling, your strength back then was… I was absolutely dazzled.

Why are you hanging out over there all by yourself?

m920060.あんなのはね、魂を取り返せば\n私のネクロマンシーですぐに\n元通りになるんだか: “Well, once I retrieve my soul, my necromancy will bring me back to normal instantly. No need to worry.”
m920060.あーんもう！\n気になって戦いに集中できなかったじゃない！: Ugh, seriously! You kept me distracted so I couldn't focus on the fight!

m920060.いくぞ野郎共！ 山賊の戦いを見せてやれ！: Let's go, you bastards! Show us a bandit fight!
m920060.う、動かなくなったわ。\n死んじゃったのかしら？:

m920060.うぅ……自分の回復力が恨めしいです……。: Ugh… I'm jealous of my own healing power…

m920060.うん！ また兄さんの弟に生まれるよ！\n兄さんの……おとうと……に……。: Yeah! I'll be born as your brother again! Your… little brother…

Huh? Oh my, what's this?
I feel an incredibly pure magical energy…
Could this be a very rare item?
m920060.お、弟よぉぉおおおおッ！\n待っていろ、山賊め……骨よりも強い筋肉など\nありは: O—oh, little brother!!! Wait, you bandits… there is no muscle stronger than bone… it… doesn't exist…!
m920060.おお、弟よ……。\n野盗には真似のできぬ絆の力を今こそ――ッ？: Ah, my little brother… Now is the time to unleash a bond that thieves can't imitate—?

Oh?

Looks like something's been devoured.
m920060.お気になさらず。もしかしたら\nメトゥスさんだけでなく、世界に役立てる事が\nで: No worries. Perhaps, not only you, Metus, but the world itself could benefit from this.

I'm sure this will be useful.

m920060.きゃっ――。\nそんな、急に襲ってくるなんて……。:
Kyaa—!

I'll just erase myself completely right here.
I refuse to become a demon's minion.
If I have to become that, I'd rather choose nothingness.
m920060.このあたりから、\n配下の声が聞こえたのだが……。\n駆けつけるのが遅かったか。: I heard my subordinates' voices from around here… Were we too late to rush in?

m920060.ご明察です。\n私はメトゥス様の助手のリッチです。\nじ、実は皆さまに頼みたいこ:
You're absolutely right.

Actually, there's something I'd like to ask of you...
m920060.さあ、ひと思いにやっちゃってよ！: Come on, do it in one swift move!

m920060.そ、そんな改めてお礼を言われると、\nなんだか照れちゃうよ……にはは。: Being thanked like that all over again… makes me blush… heh heh.
m920060.そう……。\n敵であるあなたたちに頼むなんてね。\nそんなことができるわけないの:
I see…

m920060.そうね。\nこれは私が人間として生きる為の通過儀礼……\nそして過去と未来を肯定: Yes. This is a rite of passage for me to live as a human… and a fight to affirm both past and future.
m920060.そこまでです、死霊術師メトゥス！\n死者の身体を弄ぶ、貴方を断罪します！\nさあ: That's enough, necromancer Metus! I condemn you for tampering with the dead! Now, are you ready to receive divine punishment?
m920060.その最奥に「反魂の至宝」が封印されており、\nこの「至宝のカケラ」がもっとあるは: At its deepest core lies the “Treasure of Reversed Souls”, and there should be more fragments of that treasure.
m920060.その清算は人間に戻ってから考えましょう。\nいったん城に戻り、\nこれからのこと: We'll deal with that after you're human again. Let's return to the castle and discuss what comes next.

m920060.それって、不死者にはマネの出来ない、\nとっても素敵なことだと思わない？: Don't you think that's something an undead could never achieve—a truly wonderful thing?

And Metus, why do you bow to us?
Bifrons will grant you eternal pleasure and peace.
m920060.それは――ッぅぐ……はぁ、はぁ……。\nですが、このままではメトゥス様が魔神に…:
That… uh… *pant* *pant*.
But if this continues, Lord Metus will be… controlled by the demon… and… end up…
m920060.それはね、完全に人間の女性となって、\n限りある人生を余すことなくダーリンに捧げ: I want to become a completely human woman, devote my fleeting life entirely to my darling, and stay by his side until we die.
m920060.それよりもメトゥスさん、失礼ですが\nあなたは一体、何を恐れているのですか？:
More importantly, Metus, if I may ask,
what on earth are you afraid of?
m920060.それを防ぐ為に人間に戻す？\nそんな面倒なことするよりも、\nもっと簡単な方法が:

Instead of that hassle, there's a much simpler way.

m920060.ただ嬉しかった……父上も母上もいない、\n孤独な不死者となった私にとって、\nこ:

and this… was more than family to me.
m920060.だいたいダーリン達は、\n何でそんなに神妙な顔してるのよ？\nん？ 助手のリッチ: “Honestly, why are you darlings making such solemn faces? Huh? Assistant Lich?”
m920060.だから、メトゥスさんを信じましょう。\n王子もメトゥスさんの事をよろしくお願いし: So let's trust Metus. Prince, please look after her as well.
m920060.だからあんたは戦ってないじゃないの！\n……じゃなくて！\nほらほらーさっそくあ: That's why you weren't fighting! …No, I mean—come on, come on, teach me that magic already!
m920060.だからこそ日記に記された、死霊さえも\n蘇る至宝が眠るとされる「魂呼びの迷宮」に: “That's why I'm heading to the ‘Labyrinth of Soul Calls,' where the legendary treasure that can even revive the dead is said to lie, as written in the diary.”
m920060.だけど一つ感謝してるわ。\nだって、新しい夢ができたんですもの。: Still, I'm grateful for one thing—it gave me a new dream.
m920060.だって、ダーリンを不死者にして\n永久のアバンチュールを、っていう\n計画を台無: Because you ruined my plan to make my darling immortal and give us an endless adventure!
m920060.だって私はもう、不死者ではないですもの。\n貴方と同じく、不可避の死を内包する者: Because I'm no longer an immortal. Like you, I now carry inevitable death within me. If I'm going to die someday anyway, there's no point in taking yours.

Prince, if it comes to this we have no choice but to fight!
m920060.ちょっと、そんなのどう相手するのよ！？: Seriously, how are we supposed to handle that!?

m920060.ったく、不死者の価値観って恐ろしいわ。\nはー疲れた。しばらくは頑張らないからね:
Ugh, the undead mindset is terrifying.
I'm exhausted. I won't be trying hard for a while.
m920060.って、そうよね。魂が残っていれば\n何度だって蘇るのが不死者ですもの。\nあぁ、: Right, right. As long as a soul remains, an undead can rise again and again. Ah, I was being so naive—
m920060.ですが、その力はあまりに強大で……。: But that power is overwhelmingly strong…
m920060.ですが、父上の命を犠牲にして、\nこうしておめおめと生きているなんて、\nさぞ無: But sacrificing Father's command and living this carefree life must make Him think I'm a disgrace...
m920060.でも……だからこそ、私なのよね……。\nあなたを完全に消滅させるのは、\n他の誰:
But… that's exactly why it has to be me…

m920060.でも、ダーリンが先に死んでしまって、\nずっとここに一人で閉じ込められるのは\n: But darling died first, and I'd absolutely hate to be stuck here alone forever!

m920060.と、いうことでー。\n一緒に「至宝のカケラ」を集めましょうね。\nこれから短い間: “So, let's gather the ‘Treasure Fragments' together. It'll be brief, but looking forward to it, darlings♪”

m920060.なぜ、とどめを刺さないのですか？: Why won't you deliver the final blow?

m920060.は――はッ、ハッブショッ！ ……うう。\nしっかし、冷えるなここは。\n死体の化: H—ha! …Ugh. It's so cold here. Is it because a corpse monster is nearby?

m920060.ふっふっふ、王子に悪戯するためよ。\nそれにしてもメトゥスも大胆よねぇ。\nあー: Heh heh heh, to prank the Prince, of course. And you're bold, Metus—sending a message dressed like that.

m920060.まぁ何だかんだ言って、\n元気なメトゥスの方がいいわね……って、\n待ちなさいよ: Well, despite everything, a lively Metus is better… Wait, hold on, I'm coming with the Prince too!

Just as I thought they'd show up.
Everyone, stay on guard.
Prince, get ready for the fight!

m920060.わっ、リッチが話しかけてきた！: “Wow, the Lich is talking to us!”

Ugh... we finally got our hands on the Treasure of Reversed Souls,
and now a wolf's gonna eat it... 
This is awful...

m920060.チームっていいもんだな……兄さん！: Being in a team is great… brother!

Hu-human!?
The treasure won't be shared! It's mine!

I had a bad feeling ever since I heard Bifrons' name, and sure enough, here it is…
But I'm not even a bit scared of dying!
m920060.ビフロンスの下に還ったら伝えてくださる？\n「私は２度と貴方のいいなりにならない: When you return to Bifrons, could you tell him? “I will never obey you again.”
m920060.フフ、ビフロンス様より与えられた\nこの強大な力をもって、\n貴方達を殺し尽くし: Heh, with this overwhelming power granted by Lord Bifrons, I'll wipe the lot of you out.
m920060.ボク、メトゥスのお父さんは、メトゥスが\n人間になって良かったって喜んでると思う: I think Metus's dad would be happy that Metus became human again… And for that—…
m920060.メトゥス……。\nボクはメトゥスの味方だからね。\n傍にいること、忘れないでよ？: Metus… I'm on your side. Don't forget I'm right here with you.
m920060.メトゥス、やっぱり元気ないね……。\nそりゃあそうよね。自分が操られたんだもの。: Metus, you really seem down… Well, of course—you were being controlled. I want to help, but there's nothing I can do.
m920060.メトゥスさん……。\nあまり時間はありませんが、\n少しの休憩後、進軍を再開しま: Metus… We don't have much time, but after a short break, let's resume the march.
m920060.メトゥスさん、すっかり人間らしくなられましたね。\n私の癒しの力も届きましたし、: Metus, you've become completely human. My healing reached you, and the “Treasure of Reversed Souls” proved useful.
m920060.メトゥスさんがいままで行った罪を\n今はまだ許すことはできません。: We can't forgive the sins Metus has committed up to now.
m920060.メトゥスよ、聡明なおぬしなら残った手段は、\nもう理解しておるのじゃろう……。: Metus, you wise one, you must already understand the remaining option…
m920060.不死者の時もそうでしたが、\n人間に戻ってもメトゥスさんに関しては、\n気苦労が: It was the same when you were undead, and now that you're human, Metus, it seems worries never cease about you…
m920060.久しいな人間どもよ……。\nビフロンスの手により蘇った我の新たな力で、\n貴様ら:
It's been a while, humans…
With the new power revived by Bifrons, I'll devour your flesh and blood completely.
m920060.久しぶりですね。\n私のことを覚えておいでですか？: “It's been a while. Do you remember me?”
m920060.人に戻ったからといって、\n全ての罪が許されるわけでは\nありませんのよ……。: Just because you've become human again doesn't mean all your sins are forgiven…
m920060.今日はおごるぜ山賊王！\n朝日を拝むまでしこたま飲もう！\nガッハッハッハッハ！: I'll treat you today, Bandit King! Let's drink till sunrise! Hahaha!
m920060.仕方ありませんね……。\n我が主は私にこうも言っていました。: It can't be helped… My master told me the same.
m920060.伝令ッ！ \n敵影を確認！\nど、ドラコリッチです！:
Messenger!
Enemy sighted!
It's… a Dracolich!
m920060.伝令！ \n斥候が魔物の襲来を確認した模様！: Messenger! Scouts have spotted a monster invasion!
m920060.伝令！ \n神殿前に死霊の軍団が出現！\n上位死霊のリッチの姿もあります！: “Messenger! A legion of undead has appeared in front of the temple! There's even a high-ranking Lich!”
m920060.何故あんな所に王子様たちが……？: Why are the Prince and his companions in a place like that...?
m920060.便利ね、の間違いでしょ？\nって、無駄話できる感じじゃないわね。\nあーもうッ！:
Convenient, huh? That's not the time for small talk.
Ugh, enough! Prince, I'm going!
m920060.信じないわ！\n私のネクロマンシーは、完璧なの、にっ……。\nなんでよ……私は最:
I don't believe it!
My necromancy is perfect, ha…
Why… I'm supposed to be the strongest necromancer!?
m920060.個々の死生観は千差万別じゃ。強要ができん。\nわしにしても同門のサイラスとは延命: Everyone's view on life and death varies wildly. You can't force it. Even I had a huge argument with my fellow disciple Cyrus over using prolonging magic.
m920060.全く。こんな面倒なことになるなんてねー。\nま、ダーリン達とこうして一緒に行動す: “Seriously. Who would've thought this would get so messy? Still, teaming up with you darlings could be fun. Heh heh.”
m920060.出やがったな、リッチどもめ！\n墓場までブッ飛ばしてやるぜ！ オラァッ！: You showed up, you Liches! I'll blast you to the graveyard! Take that!
m920060.分かっていますわ。仲間、ですものね！ \nいつか皆にも仲間だと思ってもらえると、: I know. We're comrades, after all! I believe someday everyone will see me as a friend too. …Then, let's return to the castle where everyone is.
m920060.前に読んだけど、すっかり忘れてたわ。\nえ？ だってこの身体を気に入ってるもの。: “I read it before, but I'd completely forgotten. Huh? Because I like this body. There's no need to remember such a method.”
m920060.助けてくださいって……。\nあんた達が今までしたこと、\n忘れたわけじゃないわよ:
Help us, you say…
You haven't forgotten everything you've done, have you?
m920060.助けるにしても、\nどうやって助けるのよ？:
Even if we're to help him,
how exactly are we supposed to do it?
m920060.助手から聞いたでしょ？\nこれから私は魔神ビフロンスの\n手下になってしまうの。:
You heard it from the assistant, right?
From now on, I'll become a minion of the demon god Bifrons.
m920060.助手のリッチさんが、連れてきたのです。\nあなたを人間に戻してほしいと。:
Assistant Ritch brought her.
He wants you to turn her back into a human.
m920060.勉強熱心のようですな。\n投影魔術なら私も少し心得があります。\nお教えしましょ: You're quite the diligent student. I have a bit of knowledge about projection magic myself. Shall I teach you?
m920060.単刀直入に言います。\nメトゥス様を助けてください！:
To get straight to the point.
Please help Lord Metus!
m920060.呆気ないわねー。さすがは私の仲間達♪\nでも唯一の欠点は、\n死んだら死んじゃう:
How dull. As expected of my comrades♪
But their one flaw—
when they die, they just die.
m920060.図々しいのを承知でお願いさせて頂きます。\nどうか、メトゥス様を助けてください。:
I know it's bold, but I beg of you.
Please, help Lord Metus.
m920060.失言でしたね。ただ、人間になる事を……、\nいえ、自分が人間であったことに、\n:
That was a misstep. It just seemed like you were
...well, frightened by the fact that I was once human.
m920060.威圧感が増しよったわい……。\n気をつけることじゃ。\nあやつ、ただのリッチでは: The intimidation's getting stronger… Be careful. He doesn't seem to be just an ordinary lich.
m920060.安らぎ……ね。不死者は死なないし、\n強い主に従属すれば不安も何もないものね。\:
Peace… huh. Undead don't die, and if you serve a strong master you have nothing to worry about.
…It does sound tempting.
m920060.弱いも何も、もともと死んでるからな。: Weak or not, they're already dead anyway.
m920060.当たり前でしょ？ 死霊化に値しない\n雑魚を何で相手しなくちゃいけないのよ？\n:
Obviously. Why waste my time on low-life fodder that doesn't even merit necromancy?
Come on, you know the drill. Heh, comrades are wonderful.
m920060.彼女の償いも残っています……。\nですが、きっと王子なら\n清濁併せ、すべて包み: She still has redemption to earn… But I'm sure, Prince, you'll embrace both the pure and the tainted and accept everything.
m920060.待っていなさい！ \nすぐに私が魂への支配を上書きしてあげるわ！\nはぁぁあッ―: Hold on! I'll overwrite your control over the soul right now! Haa—!
m920060.怪我してもアナタの自慢の回復力なら安心\nでしょ？ いいから早く来なさい。別に本: Even if you get hurt, your prized healing ability will keep you safe, right? Just hurry up. I'm not really going to turn you into a corpse.
m920060.恐れている？ 私が……？ \n何を適当なこと言ってるのかしら。:
Afraid? Me...? 
What nonsense are you spouting?
m920060.恐怖……私が、ビフロンスを、恐れている？\nこわい……こわいの……ねえ、どうした: Fear… am I afraid of Bifrons? It's scary… so scary… Tell me, what should I do… What can I do…?
m920060.悩むことも時には重要。\n思索なくして、決意は生まれ得ぬものよ……。\n今はただ: Sometimes wrestling with doubts is important. Without contemplation, you can't forge resolve… For now, all we can do is watch.
m920060.愚問ですね。\n私は人として王子の傍に在りたいのです。:
What a foolish question.
I want to stay by the Prince's side as a human.
m920060.扉が開いていきます……。\nどうやら罠の危機は脱したようですね。: The door's opening… Looks like we've gotten past the trap.
m920060.手軽とは失礼ね。私だからこその芸当なのよ。\n……いいわ。実際に見せてあげましょ: “Easy” is an insult. Only I can pull off a feat like this. …Fine. I'll show you. You there, come over here.
m920060.本当だわ。\nそれに、私だけずっとあそこでヌルヌルと一緒に\n過ごす羽目になると: It really was. And I was about to be stuck there forever, wallowing in slime.
m920060.案内役ご苦労様。\nまさか、あなたの一族に、\n「反魂の至宝」の伝承が残っていた:
Thanks for the tour.
I never imagined your clan still had the legend of the Treasure of Reversed Souls.
m920060.止めなくてよろしいですわ、アンナ。\nあの方々の怒りは、私が過去に犯した\n罪の: There's no need to stop, Anna. Their anger is just the lingering ember of the sins I committed in the past.
m920060.死霊なのじゃから元より死んでおるわい。\nさてこれからどうしたものかのう。\nお:
It's a corpse, so it's been dead all along.
Now, what shall we do about it?
Hey, what's this burlap sack?
m920060.残していくこともできんだろうに……。\nチャンスはまた来る。汚名はそこでそそげ。: We couldn't have left them behind… The chance will come again. Let the disgrace be buried there.
m920060.残念ながら、私はもう「不死者」とは言えないのよ。\n体も温かくなってきたし、人間: Unfortunately, I can't call myself an “undead” any longer. My body's warming up; I'm becoming more human.
m920060.永久に生きることは醜いけど、\n限りある命を生きることは、きっと綺麗だよ。: Living forever is ugly, but living a limited life is surely beautiful.
m920060.泣くな弟よ。我が主ビフロンス様が、\nすぐに新しい身体をくださるはずだ。\nその: Don't cry, little brother. Our master, Lord Bifrons, will grant us new bodies soon. Then we'll get our revenge on those muscles!
m920060.父上……あなたの悲願は達せられましたわ。\n私はこうして、人間に戻ることができま: Father… your lifelong wish has been fulfilled. I have finally become human again.
m920060.父上も愚かよね。かつて魔物に殺された私を\n生き返らせようとして、まずは魂だけを: “Father was foolish, too. He tried to resurrect me after being killed by monsters, first turning me into an undead just to preserve my soul…”
m920060.王子のおかげだよね、きっと。\nうん、それならすごく納得できるもん。: It's thanks to you, Prince, isn't it? Yeah, that makes perfect sense.
m920060.王子を引きずるようにして\n勝手に先に進んでますけど、\nいいんですか？: We're dragging the Prince ahead of ourselves… Is that okay?
m920060.現実を見るのじゃッ！ おぬしの我が儘で、\nあやつを永遠に苦しめるつもりか？\n:
Face reality!
Do you intend to torment that creature forever with your selfishness?
Only you can save it!
m920060.皆、下がるがよい。\n不死者の創造主のみが行使できる、\n滅びの術を使う気じゃ…:
Everyone, fall back.
I'll use the ruinous art that only the creator of the undead can wield…
m920060.皆さん……。\nそれでは、メトゥスさんを仲間として、\n受け入れていただけますで: Everyone… Then, could we accept Metus as one of our own?
m920060.皆さん、おしゃべりはそこまでですわ！\n戦闘態勢に即時移行しなさい！\n王子、行: Everyone, enough chatter! Switch to combat stance immediately! Prince, let's move!
m920060.皆さん、これは聖戦です！\n今こそ聖なる力を解放して敵を討ち、\n王子達を神の御: Everyone, this is a holy war! Now is the time to unleash our sacred power, strike down the enemy, and return the Princes to the gods!
m920060.皆さん聞いて下さい！\nもうメトゥスさんは私たちの――。: Everyone, listen! Metus is no longer ours—
m920060.私が完全に支配されるのも時間の問題です。\nそして、私だけではなくメトゥス様もま:
It's only a matter of time before I'm completely under his control.
And it won't be just me—Lord Metus won't be able to resist Bifrons either.
m920060.私にもやり方教えて！: Teach me how to do it!
m920060.私の優しい眼差しにそのような\n言いがかりをつけるとは……。\n私はこれでも王国: To think you'd lodge such an accusation against my gentle gaze… I am, after all, the kingdom's mage…
m920060.私はビフロンス様の忠実なる配下の一人、\nリッチロード。主の命によりメトゥス様を: I am a faithful subordinate of Lord Bifrons, the Lich Lord. By my master's command, I have come to escort Metus.
m920060.私達の一族が語り継いできた「癒しの至宝」\nと同じく「反魂の至宝」は『癒し』の力: Just as our clan's "Treasure of Healing" was passed down, the Treasure of Reversed Souls is said to be the power of "healing" pushed to its ultimate limit and condensed.
m920060.私達の一族は誰の目にもふれないようにと\n至宝を粉々にしてこの迷宮に封印したと\: Our ancestors are said to have shattered the treasure into pieces and sealed them here so no one would ever find it.
m920060.耳障りな台詞を並べ立てないでもらえるかしら？\nお喋りなリッチってキライなの……: Could you stop spouting those obnoxious lines? I hate chatty liches… If you want my soul, go ahead and take it.
m920060.臆するでない弟よ！ 頭と骨を使うのだ！\n自惚れの力自慢達など我らの敵ではないわ: Don't hesitate, little brother! Use your head and bones! Boastful show-offs aren't our enemies!
m920060.苦悩、煩い、恐怖……あなたを取り巻く\n負の楔は、ビフロンス様への忠誠ひとつで、: Suffering, turmoil, fear… The negative wedge that surrounds you will be removed entirely by a single thing—loyalty to Lord Bifrons.
m920060.落ち着け、お嬢さん。\n俺らだってついてるじゃねぇか。: Calm down, miss. We've got you covered, too.
m920060.覚えているかっていわれても\nあんた達死霊の見分けなんて\n同じ顔というか、頭蓋: “Even if you ask if I remember, all undead look the same to me—just a face, or a skull.”
m920060.解せんな……なぜ抗う？\nビフロンスは着々と不死者の配下を増やし、\n世界を支配:
I don't get it… why resist?
Bifrons is steadily increasing his ranks of the undead, and it's only a matter of time before he dominates the world.
m920060.訳ノ分カラヌ事ヲ……。\n出来損ナイメ……コロシテヤル。\n役立タズノ不死者ナド: Things beyond comprehension… You're a failed… I'll kill you. We have no need for useless undead…
m920060.話を聞けよ。……まったく。\nこういう場所には必ず罠を解除する\n仕掛けってのが: Listen up. …Seriously. Places like this always have some kind of trap-disarming mechanism.
m920060.誰も頼んでなんかなかったのにね……。\n自分の魂を代償に魔神ビフロンスと契約まで: “No one asked for it… He even made a pact with the demon Bifrons, using his own soul as payment… and then died. What a hassle.”
m920060.誰ダ、貴様ハ？\n死霊ガ……ナゼ人間に与スル？: Who are you? Why does a death spirit give itself to a human?
m920060.追っ手を差し向けてまで魂を求めるなんてね。\nビフロンスも見る眼はあるようじゃな: Sending pursuers after me just to claim my soul, huh? Bifrons certainly has an eye for things. But my soul isn't that cheap.
m920060.退屈ねー。\n誰か死霊になりたいって人はいないの？: Bored, huh? Anyone want to become a necromancer?
m920060.駄目じゃな……。\n助手の魂がビフロンスの下に還ろうとしておる。\nこれほどまで: That's no good… The assistant's soul is trying to return beneath Bifrons. His power is truly immense.
m920060.（人間に戻る……それは、死を内包した存在\nにも戻るってことよね？ 支配を恐れる: (Turning back into a human… that means even a being that embodies death, right? Fear of control, fear of death… What am I…?)

m920095.――……オークの英雄、アナトリア。\n一度戦ってみたいと足を運んだが……どうせな:
…Ogre hero, Anatolia.
I came hoping to spar with you… If that's the case, after reforging my blade I'd love to fight at full strength.
m920095.――……凄まじい熱気です。皆さん、\n会場の空気に飲まれないよう気を付けて下さい: ——…The heat is intense. Everyone, be careful not to get swallowed up by the atmosphere of the venue.
m920095.――……魔王親衛隊たちは去ったようだね。\n今世の強者達との純粋な戦いを期待して: ——…Looks like the Demon King's personal guard have left. I was hoping for a pure clash with this era's strongest, but… well, what's done is done. I'll go too.
m920095.――く、くそっ、ぬかったか……。\nこの傷では満足に戦えぬ、\n一度退き態勢を整: —Damn, I missed… With these wounds I can't fight properly. I'll retreat and regroup…
m920095.――こ、ここは……？ \n確か、王子の目の前に急にゲートが出現して……。:
…W-What is this place?
If I recall, a gate suddenly appeared right in front of the Prince…
m920095.――ここが魔界の森だ。\n……既に参加者達も集まってるみたいだな。:
――This is the Demon Realm Forest.
…Looks like the participants have already gathered.
m920095.――それじゃ、コイツをよろしく頼むよ。\n気付けば随分とボロボロになっていたから:
…Well then, take care of this one.
It's gotten pretty beat up, after all.
We should be able to gather some materials here.
m920095.――ったく、そこまでにしときな。\n敗者は大人しく勝者に従うもんだ。: —Honestly, that's enough. The loser should just bow to the winner.
m920095.――よし、魔界へのゲートが開いたようじゃな。\n早速向かうとするぞ。:
――All right, the gate to the Demon Realm seems to have opened.
Let's head over right away.
m920095.――アレが人間の代表か……。\n甘い事だな。: ???: ――So that's the human representative… How naïve.
m920095.――下がっていろ、グレーターデーモン。\nこの大会はお前ごときが仕切るような格で:
???: ――Step aside, Greater Demon.
This tournament isn't something someone like you can run.
I'll give the briefing myself, as the organizer.
m920095.――不殺で行く、って言うのかい？\n戦場で手加減するなんて、随分な余裕じゃないか: ――You're saying you'll go without killing? Holding back on the battlefield—that's a lot of confidence.
m920095.――何やら人の気配がするようですが。\nあれは、アナトリアさん！！: —It seems there's someone nearby. That's… Anatolia!!
m920095.――勝負あり、竜族、牛頭チーム代表の絶命を確認。\nよって、二名を殺害した者に\: —The battle is decided; the dragon-race and ox-head team representative have been confirmed dead. Thus, the two who killed them each receive 1,800 victory medals… declared winners!
m920095.……いや、戦うにはまだ早いね。\nそれより、不殺なんて本気で考えているのかい？\: …No, it's still too early to fight. Besides, are you seriously thinking about not killing? You're just putting yourselves in danger.
m920095.……いよいよだね。こんなに\nワクワクするのは、随分久しぶりだよ。: …It's finally time. It's been a long time since I've felt this excited.
m920095.……お見通し、って顔してるね、王子。\nまぁその通りだと思うけどさ。\nあたしも: ...You look like you can see right through me, Prince. Well, I think that's accurate. How about joining us as an ally?
m920095.……ここにいてはお邪魔になりそうですね。\n王子、我々は退散致しましょうか。:
…Staying here would just get in the way.
Prince, shall we make our exit?
m920095.……この場でアナトリアさんと\n相対するのは二度目ですね。: …This is the second time I've faced Anatolia here.
m920095.……だめダ。コリャ当分目覚めそうにネェナ。: …No way. She's not waking up any time soon.
m920095.……ったく、\n一体どこから湧いてきたんだい。\n邪魔だよ、さっさと散りな！: …Good grief, where the heck did you pop out of? You're in the way—just disappear already!
m920095.……ったく別チーム同士で手を組むなんて、\nセコい事考えるもんだね。あんた等それ: …Seriously, teaming up with the other team is such a cheap trick. Are you even men? Admit defeat and come back properly!
m920095.……で、そんな強い王子に\n嬉しいお知らせを持ってきたんだよ。\n話もあるし、場:
…So, I've brought some good news for a prince as strong as you.
We've got business to discuss—let's change the venue, shall we?
m920095.……とかなんとか言ってるお前も、\n今にも飛び出しそうじゃねーか。\n疼いてしょ: ...You keep saying that, but you're about to jump in yourself. You can't help that you're itching, huh?
m920095.……はい！ 全力でぶつからせて頂きます！\n王子、必ずやアナトリアさんに勝利し、: …Yes! I'll give it my all! Prince, let's defeat Anatolia and aim for victory!!
m920095.……ふぅん、そうかい。ま、あんたらのやり方に\nとやかく言う筋合いはあたしにはな: …Hmm, I see. Well, I've got no right to criticize your methods. I'm looking forward to you making it to the end, Prince.
m920095.……ふっ。さすが王子。\n血がたぎってきたような顔をしているな。\nほらよ、これ: …Heh. As expected of you, Prince. You've got that look like your blood's boiling. Here—this is the invitation.
m920095.……ま、観客がいてこその闘技場か。\n久しぶりにこんな舞台で戦うのも悪くないかも: …Well, an arena only makes sense with spectators. Fighting on a stage like this after a while isn't so bad. Now… they've arrived!
m920095.……む？ シャディア。\n剣をとりだしてどうするつもりだ。\nここは退いたほうが: …Hm? Shadia, drawing your sword—what're you thinking? You'd be better off withdrawing.
