So it was the monsters who built the "Candy Factory"
and occupied the town.
m920138.やはり愛と日頃の感謝を伝えるなら、\n原材料の入手からと思いましたが、\nチョコ:
I thought that if we wanted to express love and gratitude,
we should start from sourcing the raw materials,
but making chocolate is far more grueling than I imagined.
m920138.よ、よくない、うわさ……？\nそれはいったい……？:
A, a bad reputation……?

What do you mean……?
m920138.よぉし、寄り道しちゃいましたが、\n早く工場内の捜索に戻りましょう！:
Alright, we've taken quite a detour,
so let's get back to searching the factory!
m920138.よぉし、王子様！\n一緒に『お菓子工場』を目指しますよー！:
Alright then, Prince!
Let's head to the "Candy Factory" together!
m920138.よりコクの出るチョコレートの材料はないものか。\n我らお菓子工場職員は、新材料を:
“Is there no material that yields a richer chocolate?
Our Candy Factory staff headed deep into the jungle
in search of new materials――”
m920138.わ、わわー！？\n王子様！ チョコがどんどん大きくなっていきますー！:
W-Wah?!
Prince! The chocolate is getting bigger and bigger!
m920138.わ、わー！！ 恋……恋って、アリスさーんっ！？\n王子様！ 何も聞いてませんよね:
W-waaah!! In love…… you mean in love, Alice-san!?
Prince! You didn't hear anything, right? Right!?
m920138.わっ、わわっ、アリスさん！\n分かってて言ってますよねー！？:
W-Waah, Anna!
You're saying that on purpose, aren't you!?
m920138.わっ、わわー！？\n危うくど真ん中に突撃するところでした……。:
W-Wha-!?
I nearly charged straight into the middle of them……
m920138.わっ、甘い香りがしますね！\nチョコレートに、お砂糖に、果物の香りも！:
Oh, it smells so sweet!
Chocolate, sugar, and even fruit!
m920138.わわ……そんなすごいものじゃないですよぉ……。\n褒められると照れちゃいます……:
W-wah... It's not that amazing...
I get all shy when you praise me...
m920138.んん？ シャルキーさんどうかしましたか？\n――って、あれれれ？:
Hm? Is something wrong, Sharqi?
……Wait, what is that?
m920138.アリスに聞いた話だと、\nこんな感じの形の実の中に、\nチョコの原料になる種が入:
According to what Alice told us,
the seeds that make chocolate
are supposed to be inside fruits that look like this.
m920138.オレは……いったい何を……。\nくっ……偽りの筋肉に踊らされるとは、\n戦士とし:
What…… what have I done…….
Tch…… to be manipulated by false muscles……
A warrior's eternal shame…….
m920138.ギャギャ チョコオイシイ！\nトロトロアマアマ！:
Gya-gya! Chocolate is yummy!
Soft and sweet!
m920138.ギャギャ デモ ボウソウシテタ！: Gya-gya! The Demon Chef was going berserk!
m920138.ギャギャ！ オウジタチ！ キタ！\nセントウジュンビ！ ジュンビー！！:
Gya-gya! The Princes!
They're here!
Prepare for battle! Ready!!
m920138.ギャギャ！ テッタイ！ テッタイ！\nデーモンシェフ ホウコク！！:
Gya-gya! Retreat! Retreat!
Reporting to Chef Demon!!
m920138.ギャギャ！ デーモンシェフ！\n王子タチ！ スグソコ！ アブナイ！:
Gya-gya! Demon Chef!
The Prince and his party! They're right there! It's dangerous!
m920138.ギャギャ！ 工場長！\n王子タチ！ キタ！ 王子！ キタ！！:
Gya-gya! Factory Manager!
The Prince and his party! They're here! The Prince! He's here!!
m920138.ギャギャ？ 工場長 ナニカイテル？: Gya-gya? Factory Chief, what's going on?
m920138.クッ……まさかこんなに早く王子達に\n我らの秘密のお菓子工場が知られてしまうとは:
Tch…… I never imagined our secret candy factory would be discovered by the Prince and his party so quickly.
I must report this to the Demon Chef at once……
m920138.グォォォオオオオオオッ！！\n戦士タチヨォ！！ 我が筋肉に集えェェェッ！！:
GWAHOOOOOOO!!
WARRIORS!! Gather to my muscles!!!
m920138.グッ、グォォォッ！？\n何をっ、何を食わせたッ！！\n身体が大きくッ、力がッ、グ:
Ghh, GWAH?!
What…… what did you feed me to?!
My body is growing…… my strength…… GWAHAAAAH?!
m920138.コレほどの大きさのチョコマイコニド、\n打たれ強そうだし、何よりチョコ胞子を\n:
A chocolate Myconid of this size……
It looks incredibly durable, and its ability to scatter chocolate spores
seems far beyond normal…….
m920138.コンベアで流れてくお菓子は美味しそうなのに、\n仕事中は食べちゃダメなんて酷いよ:
The candies flowing down the conveyor look delicious,
but it's so cruel that I'm not allowed to eat them on the job……
m920138.シャルキーさんの応援もあって、\n準備も順調に進みましたからね。:
With Sharqi's support,
the preparations went smoothly, too.
m920138.シャルキーちゃん、気をつけてください！\nいつの間にか周囲にチョコトレントが！:
Sharqi-chan, be careful!
Chocolate Treants have appeared all around us!
m920138.シャルキー待って待って。\nこんな魔物だらけの街を\nひとりで走っていったら危険:
Sharqi, wait!
It's too dangerous to run off alone in a town crawling with monsters.
m920138.チョコが動き出した時には\n本当にどうしようかと思いましたが、\n王子様のおかげ:
When the chocolate started moving,
I really didn't know what to do,
but thanks to the Prince, we managed to hold the event safely!
m920138.チョコが動くなんて誰も思いませんよねぇ。\nそれで、工場の場所は分かりますか！？:
Who would've thought chocolates could move, right?

So, do you know where the factory is located?!
m920138.チョコが魔物になるという情報から推測するなら、\n既に街は『お菓子工場』の魔物に:
Judging from the reports that the chocolates are turning into monsters,

it's reasonable to assume the town has already been

occupied by the "Candy Factory's" creatures.
m920138.チョコを悪事に使うし、材料をこぼして\n魔界アリまで呼び寄せちゃうし、\nデーモ:
Using chocolate for evil deeds, spilling ingredients,
and even luring in Demon Ants……
I absolutely will not forgive the Demon Chef!
m920138.チョコ菓子に魔法をかけるお菓子工場とは、\nこれはどうにもきな臭いですな。:
A candy factory that casts spells on chocolate treats……
This is certainly suspicious.
m920138.デーモンシェフの捜索を続けるためにも、\nまずはチョコトレントを排除しましょうか:
To continue our search for Demon Chef,
we should clear out these Chocolate Treants first.
Prince, please take command!
m920138.デーモンシェフも、次は普通の\n事業を立ち上げてくれたら良いのですが……。:
I do hope the Demon Chef
starts a legitimate business next time…….
m920138.トレントが相手とは、ちょっと厄介だね。\nんー？ どうやらあのトレントたちは\n:
Treants are a bit troublesome to deal with.
Hm? It looks like those Treants
are using long-range attacks infused with magical power.
m920138.バレンタインの祝祭を邪魔するなんて、\nぜーったいに許さないんですからー！:
To interfere with the Valentine's Festival……
I absolutely will not forgive them!
m920138.マイコニド型やトレント型のチョコが動くのですから、\nデーモン型が動いても不思議:
If the Myconid and Treant chocolates are moving,
it's only natural that the Demon ones would move too……
m920138.人をやる気にさせるその応援、\n私も極意を学んでみたいものです。:
That way of cheering people on...
I'd love to learn the secret to it myself.
m920138.仕方ない、他の子達に応援を頼もう。\nあんなオークの群れ、私達だけじゃしのぎきれ:
There's no choice. We'll have to call for backup.
We can't hold off an Orc horde like that on our own.
m920138.住人全員が退去させられたそうですからね。\n噂では工場の職員のしわざとのことでし:
Apparently, all the residents have been evacuated.
Rumors say the factory staff were responsible,
but it's likely that――
m920138.何しろ配下のデーモン達は、\nチョコレートコーティングが\n既に完了しているのだ:
After all, my subordinates' Demons
have already finished
their chocolate coating!!
m920138.何と巨大な肉体だ！\nあれほどの筋肉を育てるには、\nさぞかし多くの死線をくぐり:
What a massive physique!
To grow muscles like that,
he must have survived countless brushes with death!
m920138.原因であるお菓子工場をどうにかしないと、\nまた魔界アリが集まってくる可能性もあ:
If we don't deal with the candy factory, the source of the problem,
there's a chance more Demon Ants will gather.
m920138.取り扱い自体は西方の国のお菓子会社ですけど、\n確か原材料を作ったのは、最近創業:
The company handling them is a confectionery firm from the Western Kingdom,
but I believe they said the raw materials were made
by a newly established "Candy Factory"……
m920138.夢と愛情いっぱいのチョコを悪用するなんて、\n絶対に許しませんよー！:
To abuse chocolates filled with dreams and love……
I absolutely won't allow it!
m920138.妙な商品……もしかして、\nマイコニド型のチョコのことですか？:
Sketchy products…… Could it be

those Myconid-shaped chocolates?
m920138.子供扱い……なるほど……。\nあの子の家出の原因は、\n私にあるのかもしれません:
Treated like a child…… I see……
Perhaps the reason she ran away
has something to do with me……
m920138.工場長――もといデーモンシェフが、\n私達を足止めするために魔界アリを放ったので:
Perhaps the Factory Director――I mean, the Demon Chef――
released the Demon Ants to hold us back?
m920138.工場長ではない、おしゃれで素敵なデーモンシェフだ！\nこれは我らが物質界を支配す:
It is not “Factory Chief,” it is the stylish and wonderful Demon Chef!
This is an exploration journal meant to leave a record
of our path to dominating the material world for the future.
m920138.幾度も蘇生する力と同時に、蘇生を重ねる毎に\n魔力を強大化する秘技を備えていたは:
She possesses the power to revive repeatedly, and a secret technique that amplifies her magical power with each revival.
Let's not let our guard down just because we've defeated her.
--- scene: Demon Prawn's Friends (battle, end) ---
m920138.念には念を入れ、\n新たに配属した職員を送り込むとしよう……。:
Just to be safe,
let us deploy the newly assigned staff……
m920138.情報が早いですぽん♪\nシャルキーちゃんは良いたぬきになれますぽーん♪:
You're quick on the uptake, pon♪

You're a good little tanuki, Sharqi-chan, po~n♪
m920138.懐いてないし！\nあんなヘナチョコよわよわ王子！\n全然懐いてなんかいないから！:
I haven't!
That useless, wimpy Prince!
I'm not falling for him at all!!
m920138.戦士の匂いがするぞ！ 近くに戦の気配がッ！！\n戦えッ！ オレと戦えェェェェッ！:
I smell warriors! The scent of battle is near!!
Fight! Fight me!!!
m920138.早く倒さないと、\nどんどん体を蝕まれちゃいそうです……。:
If we don't take it down quickly,
it looks like it's going to erode our bodies…….
m920138.殺すなどもったいない……。\nお前は我らの物質界征服の礎となるのだ！\nさぁ美味:
Killing you would be a waste…….
You shall become the cornerstone of our conquest of the material world!
Now, eat up! These are fresh, delicious nuts.
m920138.物音がしなくなりましたね……。\nどうやら、大半の魔界アリは駆除できたようです。:
The sounds have stopped……
It seems we've managed to exterminate most of the Demon Ants.
m920138.王子、工場の奥には\nチョコの魔物がさらに多くいるはずです。\nこの先も慎重に進:
Prince, there are likely even more chocolate monsters
deeper inside the factory.
Let's proceed with caution.
m920138.王子、魔界アリは群れで向かってくるかと思います。\n慎重な指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, the Demon Ants seem to be approaching in a swarm.
Please command with caution!
m920138.王子タチ ジャマスル チョコモラエル！\nデーモンシェフ ヤサシイ！:
Princes are here!
We get chocolate!
Chef Demon is kind!
m920138.王子様、この道を抜けないと、\n『お菓子工場』にはたどり着けません。\nずばばっ:
Prince, we can't reach the "Candy Factory"
without clearing this road.
Let's take them all down in one go!
m920138.王子様、絶対の絶対に\n『お菓子工場』の陰謀を阻止しましょう！:
Your Highness, absolutely, positively,

we must stop the "Candy Factory's" scheme!
m920138.王子様がそう言うなら……。\nともかく、これで事件も一段落、\n安心してチョコ作:
If the Prince says so…….
Anyway, that settles this incident.
We can make chocolate with peace of mind now♪
m920138.王子様ー！ こっちですー！！\nデーモンシェフを発見しましたー！！:
Prince! This way!!
We've spotted the Demon Chef!!
m920138.相手はお菓子のような見た目ではありますが、\n正真正銘、本物の魔物です。\n王子:
They may look like sweets,
but they are genuine monsters.
Prince, please command with caution!
m920138.確かに、そのとおりです。\n魔王との決戦から復興の最中である以上、\n物質界で調:
You're right.
With the kingdom still rebuilding after the final battle with the Demon King,
our royal army is the only force available to investigate the material world.
m920138.確かにその可能性も――っと、\nおやや？ すんすん、この甘い香りは……。:
That is certainly a possibility――oh, wait.
Sniff, sniff…… What is this sweet scent?
m920138.背に腹はかえられない、ということですね。\nこれも未来の大事業のため……！！:
I suppose we have no other choice.
This is for the sake of our future great enterprise……!!
m920138.警戒なんて無駄無駄だよ♪\nあたし達ふたりの前じゃ、人間なんて\nざこざこのよわ:
Staying alert is a waste of time♪
In front of the two of us,
humans are just weak little ants♪
m920138.連中、また『デーモンシェフ』って\n名前をつぶやいてたな……。\nいったい何者な:
Those guys were whispering the name "Demon Chef" again……
Who on earth is the Demon Chef……
m920138.黙れ！ 一流シェフへの道は長いのだ！\nさぁ次の食材を試しに行くぞ！:
Silence! The road to becoming a master chef is a long one!
Now, let's go test out the next ingredient!
m920138.（なるほどなぁ……これが王国、そして王子。\nボクの大事な友達を取られた気分だっ:
(I see…… So this is the kingdom, and this is the Prince.
I felt like my precious friend was being taken away,
but honestly, this is starting to pique my interest)
m920138.（はいっ、あの子の気持ち、分かる気がします。\n年下だからって助けられるばかりだ:
(Yes! I think I understand how she feels.
Just because I'm younger doesn't mean I should always be the one helped.
I want to outgrow that kind of thing soon, too!)
m920138.（ふふん、そんなのは、\n大人になってから考えればいいんだよ♪ でも――）:
(Hehe, you can worry about that
once you're actually an adult♪ But――)
m920138.（ボクも物質界で生きていくしかないですし、\nまじめに働くのも飽きてきましたし、:
(Since I have no choice but to live in the Material World,
and I'm getting tired of working seriously,
maybe it's time I started learning about humans……)
--- scene: The Giant Chocolate of Conspiracy (battle, start) ---

m920146.――あっ、きたきた！\nバリケードの設置完了してますよー！:
――Ah, here they come!
The barricade is all set up!
m920146.――いや、おぬしは攻める方だぞ？\n王国が守備、帝国が攻撃側じゃ。:
――No, you're on the attacking side, you know?
The Kingdom is defending, and the Empire is attacking.
m920146.――えぇ、正当な開戦事由だと思いますとも！\nさぁ王子殿下、そちらの準備は万端で:
—Yes, I think that is a perfectly valid reason to declare war!
Now then, Your Highness, are you fully prepared over there?!
m920146.――おや？ ちょっと待ってください。\n沖から何かが近付いてきていないですか？:
――Oh? Hold on a moment.
Isn't something approaching from out at sea?
m920146.――さすがは剣聖様。\n海の恵みに感謝し、ここで食べるといたしましょう。: ――As expected of the Sword Saint. Let us give thanks for the bounty of the sea and eat here.
m920146.――それじゃあ、本日最後の模擬戦ね。\n見てのとおり、村の防衛を意識した戦場よぉ:
――Well then, here's our final mock battle for the day.
As you can see, this battlefield is designed with village defense in mind.
m920146.――となれば元帥殿、ここは兵のためにも、\n息抜きが必要なのではありませんか？: If that is the case, Supreme Commander, should we not allow the troops a brief respite?
m920146.――ふぃー。\n訓練のつもりが実戦になっちゃったけど、\n無事に港に帰ってこられ:
――Phew.
I intended this to be a training exercise, but it turned into a real battle.
Still, we managed to make it back to port safely.
m920146.――まったく、村の漁師さんたちが呆れていましたよ？\nもうすぐ夜なんですから、\: ――Honestly, the village fishermen were dumbfounded. It's almost night, so please be quiet?
m920146.――むにゃむにゃ……ぷかぷか……。\nスイ？ ここはいったいどこスイ……？:
――Mmm-mmm……float, float…….
Watermelon? Where is this place, Watermelon……?
m920146.――否、待たれよ。溺れる民の子らよ、\nサラタンをけしかけたのは我らではない。:
――No, hold on. You, children of the drowning people,
we did not unleash the Saratan upon you.
m920146.――夕暮れの海、潮騒の音、優しい風。: ――The evening sea, the sound of the surf, a gentle breeze.
m920146.――大変！ 大変です！ カニが！！\nカニとカニがこっちに向かってます！:
――Oh no! It's an emergency! Crabs!! 
Crabs and crabs are heading this way!
m920146.――王子よ、まずは恩義を返す前から、\nこうして戦いに巻き込んでしまったことを詫: ――Prince, before I repay my debt, I must apologize for dragging you into this battle.
m920146.――船上訓練の合間に、\nまさかこんな優雅な休憩時間を過ごせるとはな。:
――To think we'd be enjoying such a leisurely break
in the middle of our on-board training.
m920146.――見覚えのある船だと思えば、\nやはり王国と、帝国の者達だったか。:
So it was a familiar ship. 
I see. They are indeed from the Kingdom and the Empire.
m920146.…………。\n妾、今だけ王国民ということにならんかの？:
…………
Could I just be a Kingdom citizen for a moment?
m920146.…………！！\nわ、私も泳ぐわ！ 一緒に泳ぎましょう、姉さま！:
…………!!
I'm going swimming too! Let's swim together, Sister!
m920146.……ああ。\n王子、この通路はお前に任せた。\nレオラ、俺達は反対側の魔物に対処: …Yes. Prince, I'll leave this passage to you. Leora, we'll handle the monsters on the opposite side.
m920146.……いえ、見た覚えはありませんね。\nそれよりもあの無人島、\n動いている気がし:
……No, I don't recall seeing one.
More importantly, doesn't that island
seem to be moving?
m920146.……いや、その格好で言われても、\nちょっと説得力が足りないかなぁ？:
……I mean, with that outfit, 
it's hard to take your words seriously, isn't it?
m920146.……くっ。だがこういった場所には、\nやはりふさわしい格好というものがあるだろう:
……Tch. But in a place like this, 
there are certain outfits that are simply more appropriate, aren't there!?
m920146.……こうして仲良く模擬戦をして、\n仲良く水浴びをして、そんな時間が過ごせるのも:
……To be able to spend time like this,
sparring amicably and splashing in the water together,
perhaps it is nothing more than a fleeting miracle.
m920146.……ですが、漁師さんたちも笑ってましたね。\n孫がいっぱい増えたみたいだって。: ……But the fishermen were smiling, too. They said it was like they had a lot of new grandchildren.
m920146.……ところでさ、あんな所に、\n無人島なんてあったっけ？:
……By the way, was there really an
uninhabited island out there?
m920146.……どうやら、まだ騒がしい時間は続きそうですね。\n王子、私たちもお魚をいただき:
……It seems the lively atmosphere is going to last a while longer.
Prince, shall we go get some fish to eat?
m920146.……どうやら、海水浴はまだお預けみたいねぇ。\n陛下、王子ちゃん、接敵までまだ少:
……Looks like the beach trip is on hold for now.
Your Majesty, Prince, we still have a little time before they reach us,
so let's hurry and get our defenses in order.
m920146.……ふむ、となれば、傷む前に食べたいところだな。\nせっかくの浜辺だ、ここで焼い: ……Hmm, in that case, I'd like to eat them before they spoil. Since we're at the beach, we could grill them right here――
m920146.……ほんとだ、スイカが浮いてる。\nでもボクたち、スイカなんて持ってきてないよね:
……You're right, there's a watermelon floating there.
But we didn't bring any watermelons with us, did we?
m920146.……まさかスイカの魔物が、\nこんな外海にまで現れるとは。:
……To think a Watermelon Monster would appear
out in the open sea like this.
m920146.……む？ では何故こんなところにスイカが……？\nふむ、まぁ良い。次の訓練を始め:
……Hm? Then why is there a watermelon here……?
Well, never mind that. Let's begin the next drill.

m920146.何……？\nいや、昔から私は何も変わっていないぞ。:
What……?
No, I haven't changed at all. Not in the slightest.
m920146.何だか難しい話をしてる気がします……。\nさぁ元帥様！ 次を始めましょう！\n早:
That sounds a bit complicated...
Come on, Commander! Let's start the next one!
We need to hurry before the sun sets!
m920146.先程より大きくなった……いや、\nむしろ浮上した、ということか……？:
It has grown larger since we first saw it…… no,
it's surfacing, isn't it……?
m920146.司教殿がそこまで言うなら……そうねぇ……。\n陛下、王子ちゃん、どうしようかしら:
If the Bishop says so... I suppose...
Your Majesty, Prince, what do you think?
m920146.地の利はあちらにある上、こちらはこの狭さで、\n軍としての機能を発揮できていませ:
The advantage of the terrain is on their side, and with this narrow space, 
we cannot function as an army. 
I believe our priority should be to evacuate the cave.
m920146.地上に生きる者には縁遠い場所なれば、\n説明が必要になるというものだろう。\n王:
It is a place far removed from the lives of those who dwell on land,
so an explanation is in order, I suppose.
Prince, would you grant me a moment of your time?
m920146.大きすぎると味は落ちるものですが……。\nでも、ちょっと興味がありますね……。:
The flavor tends to suffer when the meat is that big, but…….
I am a little curious, though…….
m920146.太陽の下で、氷菓子を食べるのも格別です。: Eating ice treats under the sun is a real treat, too.
m920146.実戦があろうと無かろうと、\n毎日同じ鍛錬を反復し続けるのが大事なんだ。:
Whether there is real combat or not,
the key is to keep repeating the same drills every day.
m920146.島と間違えるっていうのも納得ねぇ……。\n王子ちゃん、そっちの部隊に向かって動き:
I can see why it would be mistaken for an island…….
Prince, it's heading toward your squad!
Be careful not to get swept away!
m920146.帝国側がやけに騒がしいな……。\n私がいた頃には、\nあんな楽しそうな軍では無か:
The Imperial side is unusually lively…
Back when I was here,
their army was never this cheerful.
m920146.当然よ。ご褒美があるから人は戦えるんだもの。\nそれが平和だろうと、海水浴だろう:
Of course. People fight better when there's a reward.
Whether it's peace or a swim,
you need a goal, after all.
m920146.当然よぉ？\nだって遊びに来たわけじゃないもの♪\n今日は帝国、王国の合同訓練な:
Well, of course. We didn't come here to play, did we?
Today is the joint training exercise between the Empire and the Kingdom.
m920146.思ったより……多かったですね……。: There were more of them than I expected…
m920146.成長すればちょっとした\n島くらいの大きさになるという、\n外洋に棲息する巨大カ:
The name of a giant crab that inhabits the open ocean,
and is said to grow to the size of a small island
once it reaches maturity?
m920146.我が国は、新たなる物質界の王とも言うべき男、\nそして彼の英雄王の名を継ぐ者を支:
Our nation shall support the man who is said to be the new King of the Material World,
and the one who inherits the name of his Hero King.
m920146.昨日からずっと海を楽しみにしていたらしいからな。\nリーザは泳ぎに行かなくて良い:
Apparently, she's been looking forward to the beach since yesterday.
Liza, aren't you going swimming?
m920146.昼間はちょっと騒々しかったですけど、\nこういう海が、やっぱり好きですね……。: It was a bit rowdy during the day, but I really do love the sea like this……
m920146.次から次へときりがないわ。\n海から出てくるから、\n敵の規模もわからないし……:
They just keep coming, one after another. 
Since they're emerging from the sea, 
we can't even gauge the scale of the enemy…….
m920146.此度の争いは、我らの国と\n我らに刃を向ける者達によるものだった。\n奴らめ、ま:
This conflict is between our nation and those who have turned their blades against us.
Those wretches, to think they would desecrate the habitat of the Saratan…….
m920146.氷菓子とな。\n妾も相伴にあずかるとしようかのう♪:
Shaved ice, is it.
I shall join you in that, shall I? ♪
m920146.泡か……攻撃の手が鈍るのは困るな……。\n王子、接近戦に持ち込んで、\n泡を放つ:
Foam, huh… That'll slow down our attacks…
Prince, we should force it into close combat
so it doesn't get a chance to release the foam.
m920146.浮上……無人島……巨大な……。\nはっ、もしかして、あの島の正体って……！？:
Surfacing…… an island…… something massive…….
Oh! Could it be that the island is actually……!?
m920146.海の上でぷかぷか浮かんだり……。: Like floating around in the water...
m920146.海の底まで従えちゃうなんてねぇ……。\nって、あら？ 王子ちゃん嬉しそうよぉ？:
So they'll follow all the way to the bottom of the sea, huh…….
Oh? You look rather pleased, Prince.
m920146.海底の民を御しきれなかった、我の不徳だ。\n王子には借りばかり作ってしまうな……:
We failed to keep the people of the seabed in check. It is our failing.
I seem to be piling debt upon debt on you, Prince…….
m920146.準備ばっちりね♪\n――模擬戦、開始よ！:
Ready as can be♪
――Sparring match, begin!
m920146.無礼はお前だ。この男は――\n英雄王を継ぐこの王子は、我の命を救った恩人だぞ。:
No, you are the one being rude. This man—
this Prince, who will inherit the Hero King's legacy, is the one who saved my life.
m920146.然り。地上に生きる者達が地上に国を作るように、\n我らも海底に国を作るのだ。: That is correct. Just as those who live on land build nations there, we have built ours in the depths.
m920146.然リ。戦果トハ、\n日頃の訓練なくしテ得られないのだからナ。: Indeed. One cannot achieve victory in battle without daily training.
m920146.王子、エレオノーラさんが兵を回復しているようです。\n足止めして詠唱を妨害しまし:
Prince, Eleonora appears to be healing the troops.
Hold them back and disrupt her casting!
m920146.王子、帝国側の準備ができたようです。\nそれでは第二回戦を始めましょう！:
Prince, the Empire's side seems to be ready.
Shall we begin the second round?
m920146.王子が見逃さなければ、\n今この場に、我は存在しないのだからな。:
Had the Prince not spared me,
I would not be standing here right now.
m920146.王子よ、溺れる者達――人類を導く者よ、\n本当にすまなかった。どうやら此度は、\:
Prince, you who guide the drowning—mankind—
I am truly sorry. It seems I have
dragged you into a dispute within my own nation.
m920146.確か、川で冷えてたスイカに憑依したあと、\nぽかぽか陽気が気持ちよくてうとうとし:
I remember possessing a watermelon that was cooling off in the river,
and then the warm sun got to me and I dozed off…….
Wait, did I drift all the way out here, Watermelon!?
m920146.確かに、こんなお天気が良いのですから、\nちょっと遊びたくなっちゃいますよね。:
It's true. With weather this lovely,
it's hard not to want to have a little fun, isn't it?
m920146.私も、落日の水平線が好きなんです。\n琥珀色に染まっていく水面、\n少しずつ訪れ: I, too, am fond of the setting sun on the horizon. The water turning amber, the indigo that slowly creeps in……
m920146.第二回戦、そこまで！\nあらあら、さっきより白熱していたんじゃないかしら？:
Second round, that's a wrap!
Oh my, wasn't that more intense than the last one?
m920146.見ておれよ王子！\nそんなバリケードちょちょいのちょいじゃ！:
Watch this, Prince!
I'll tear through that barricade in a snap!
m920146.貴様！ 深海の王に無礼だぞ！: You dare! You are being rude to the King of the Deep!
m920146.逃げてきた……ですか……？\nそういえば、向こうの方がやけに騒がしいような。: Escape……? Come to think of it, it does sound unusually loud over there.
m920146.連中はこの先の洞窟へ向かうらしい。\nサラタンの棲息地を荒らし、\nけしかけてや: They seem headed for the cave ahead. Let's raid the Saratan's habitat and cause some trouble…
m920146.食欲もいいけど、まずは討伐が先決よ。\n魚人の群れにサラタンの幼体、\nその両方:
Save your appetite for later. We need to take it down first.
We've got a swarm of merfolk and a juvenile saratan to deal with!
m920146.馬が花火でびっくりしちゃったみたいですね……。\nって、あっ、こっちに来ますよ！: It seems the horse got startled by the fireworks…… Wait, it's coming this way!?

m920171.……あすもちゃんが言うには、\n外から連れて来るでもしない限り、\nドラコリザー:
……As Asumo says,
unless they were brought in from outside,
there's no way Draco Lizards would naturally be in this region.
m920171.……お待ちを、副デーモンシェフ。\nあれだけの騒ぎがあって貴方は本当に、\n今の:
…Hold on, Deputy Demon Chef.
After all that commotion, you really didn't notice
anything until just now?
m920171.……こちらにも事情があるのです。: …There are circumstances on our side as well.
m920171.……これ以上の業務遂行は不可能だね。\nそもそも王子の相手は契約に含まれていない:
……I can't continue this task any further.
Dealing with the Prince wasn't part of the contract to begin with.
I'll be taking my leave here.
m920171.……そうですね、\n落ち込んでる暇なんてありません！:
…You're right.
There's no time to dwell on this!
m920171.……なるほど、温泉にドラコリザードが。\n了解しました、我らも避難を開始します。:
…I see. A Draco Lizard in the hot spring.
Understood. We'll begin evacuating as well.
m920171.……はい！ みんなで温泉街を守りましょう！: …Yes! Let's protect the hot-spring town together!
m920171.……もう怒ったわ、\n何としても連れ帰ります。\n覚悟しなさい、国主代理！:
...I'm furious.
I'm bringing you back, no matter what.
Prepare yourself, Acting Lord!
m920171.……デモシェフ商会が海に進出するに当たり、\n我らの商船の護衛を担ってくれていた:
……When the Demon Chef Trading Company expanded its operations to the sea, we had a friend who guarded our merchant vessels.
She was the mother of these Draco Sea Sauruses.
m920171.……副デーモンシェフさん、どういうことですか。: …Deputy Demon Chef, what is going on?
m920171.……結果はこの有様だがな。\nこの償いには、商会総出で取り組ませてもらいたい。\:
……The results are as you see.
We intend to make this amends with the full resources of the company.
We have caused too much trouble to too many people, including you.
m920171.……背後に隠すそのひときわ大きな卵は、\nドラコシーサウルスのものとお見受けしま:
……That unusually large egg you're hiding behind you
appears to be a Draco Cisauros egg.
m920171.……詳しい事情は知りません。ですが、\n死にゆく命を見過ごせないという気持ちは、:
……I don't know the full details. But as someone
who lives by the sea, I can understand the feeling
of not being able to look away from a life on the brink of death.
m920171.……追い出されちゃった、シズカのせいで。: ...I got kicked out. All Shizuka's fault.
m920171.──これより、陸海合同演習を執り行う。: —We shall now commence the joint land-and-sea exercise.
m920171.──っ、皆さん臨戦態勢を！ 魔物が出現しました！: ──Everyone, take defensive positions! Monsters have appeared!
m920171.──っ！ もう追い付かれたか……！: —! So you've caught up to me…!
m920171.──ふむ、お客人かい？\n残念ながらこの宿は現在貸し切り中──と、\nなんだい、:
──Hmm, guests, are we?
Unfortunately, this inn is currently under exclusive lease──
Oh my, what an unusual visitor you are.
m920171.──制圧完了です、デーモンシェフさん。\nこれでようやく、事情を話してくれますね:
……It's over, Demon Chef.
Now you can tell us what's really going on, right?
m920171.『クラールフ、貴様ァ……！\n冬の海での演習後に無駄話とは、\n我が娘が風邪を引:
"Klaarf, you...!
Holding a casual chat after a winter sea exercise...
What will you do if my daughter catches a cold...?!"
m920171.ああ、さすがは有名な温泉街だ。\n温泉の数も種類も豊富で素晴らしいが……\nそれ:
Ah, this is truly a famous hot spring town.
The number and variety of springs are impressive, but…
It's a pity that some of them are currently reserved for private use.
m920171.ああ、彼女には大きな借りがあったからな。\nしかし、卵の孵化には繊細な温度管理が:
Yes. She owed us a great debt.
However, hatching the egg requires precise temperature control.
It turned out that the egg would die before we could set up the necessary equipment.
m920171.ああ、数匹逃げてしまっていたのかい。\nその点については謝罪し、損害を補填しよう:
Ah, so a few have already escaped.
I apologize for that and will make up for the damages.
m920171.あっ、あれはドラコリザード……！\nこんな場所にいるはずはないのに……！:
Ah, those are Draco Lizards…!
There's no reason they should be in a place like this…!
m920171.あとで温泉の掃除もしないとですね、\nたくさん散らかしちゃいましたから……。:
We'll also need to clean up the hot spring later,
since we made quite a mess…
m920171.あのお二方が側にいる以上は、\n代わりの護衛も必要ないでしょう！\n私はゆっくり:
With those two around,
we don't need backup guards!
I'm going to enjoy the hot spring in peace~♪
m920171.あらゆる戦況に適応する思考と肉体、\nその両方を鍛え上げていただきたいのです。\:
I want you to train both your minds to adapt to any combat situation
and your bodies to match.
So, let us begin with the land combat!
m920171.あれはデーモンシェフさん！？\nそれに運んでいるのはドラコリザードの……\nいえ:
That's the Demon Chef!?
And what he's carrying is a Draco Lizard's…
No, it's an even larger monster's egg!!
m920171.いえ、その……温泉に入っていたもので……。: Well, I mean… I was in the bath…
m920171.いつか焼いてくれたおいしいステーキも！\nあれも全部……偽物だったと言うのですか:
Even that delicious steak you once cooked for me!
You're telling me that was all… a lie?
m920171.うぅ……温泉に入りに来たはずが、\n何故こんな事態になったのでしょう……。:
Ugh… I just came here for a hot spring bath,
so why has it turned into this mess…?
m920171.ええ、次は総力戦です。\n各自、気を引き締めてください。:
Yes, next is an all-out battle.
Everyone, stay sharp.
m920171.おっ、出番？ さあ、どこかなどこかな～♪\nどこに隠れてるのかな～♪ おや、ここ:
Oh, my turn? Well then, where could it be~♪
Where is it hiding~♪ Oh, is it here~?
m920171.おや、少々温度が高かったようですね。\nフィーヌさん、あちらの湯に行ってみましょ:
My, it seems the temperature was a bit too high.
Fine-san, let's try the bath over there.
The areas farther from the source are usually easier to bear.
m920171.お仕事を休んで入る温泉は最高ですねぇ……。: Taking a day off work to soak in a hot spring is the best…
m920171.お姫さまが私を置いて行くからよ、\n私も温泉に入ってみたかったのに。:
You left me behind, Princess.
I wanted to try the hot spring, too.
m920171.げっ、シズカじゃん、やっば。\nなんでこんなところにいるのさ。\n行き先誰にも知:
Gah, it's Shizuka. This is bad.
Why are you even here?
I didn't tell anyone where I was going.
m920171.こここ、こっちに来ないでくださーーい！！: Please, please, stay away from meee!!
m920171.こっ、今度は何事よ！？: W-What is going on this time?!
m920171.この時期の海は冷えますからね。\n毛布が必要な方は遠慮せず言ってください。\nお:
The sea is quite cold at this time of year.
If anyone needs a blanket, please don't hesitate to ask.
I've also prepared some warm soup with meat!
m920171.この温泉宿、とっても広いんですね。\n全部を見回るだけでもすごい時間が……。:
This hot spring resort is really big.
Just walking around to see everything would take forever...
m920171.この温泉街を滅茶苦茶にするつもりですね！？\nそんなことはさせません！ まだ入っ:
You're going to wreck this hot spring town, aren't you!?
I won't let you! I haven't even gone in yet!
m920171.これからも互いの国の発展のため──: Going forward, for the continued development of our respective nations—
m920171.これで、これでようやく温泉に……きゅう。: Now, now that this is over, we can finally enjoy the hot spring……kyuu.
m920171.さあコマちゃん、やっちゃってください！\nいつもの狛犬パンチでノックダウンですよ:
Come on, Koma-chan! Get 'em!
A nice Komainu Punch to knock her out!
m920171.さあ構えろ、誇り高き王国の戦士たちよ。\nクラールフ様の手前、無様な姿も見せられ:
Now then, take your positions, proud warriors of the Kingdom.
For Lord Klaarf's sake, we cannot afford to look foolish.
I shall challenge you with the full might of my people.
m920171.さて……事故か事件か。\n一般人の安全を確保次第、\n本格的な調査を始めましょう:
Well… whether it's an accident or a crime.
Once we've secured the safety of the civilians,
let's begin a full-scale investigation.
m920171.しかし、彼女らには今しばらくの間、\n純粋に温泉を楽しんでもらいましょうか。:
Still, I think we should let them enjoy the hot springs
in peace for a little while longer.
m920171.すまぬがフィーヌ嬢、それはできん。\nもしここでそちらが引いてくれるのであれば、:
I'm sorry, Miss Fine, but I cannot.
If you will withdraw now, I promise we will cause no further damage to the hot spring town.
m920171.ぜーはーっ！ ぜーはーっ！\nなっ、なんだったんですか今の……！？:
P-Phew…! P-Phew…!
W-What was all that about…!?
m920171.そういうこと、観念しなさい。\nさあ帰るわよヨシノ、チヨメもね。:
Accept your fate.
Come on, Yoshino. Chiyome, too. We're going home.
m920171.そうだ！ 深海のみなさんも一緒に、\nこれから温泉でお疲れ様会しませんか！？:
That's it! Why don't we all go to a hot spring together,
including everyone from the deep sea, to celebrate the end of our hard work?
m920171.そして、ここにいる我らも本物だ。\n悪いが私にも譲れないものがあってね。\nそれ:
And the ones here are the real deal, too.
I'm sorry, but there are things I can't give up.
That final promise I made to my late friend.
m920171.そっ、それでは早速──熱っっっっづ！？: T-Then, let's just dive right in— H-HOT?!
m920171.その上で、人々を守るのが私の使命。\n全力で、あなたを止めさせてもらいます！:
That said, protecting people is my duty.
I'll do everything I can to stop you!
m920171.その件については宿の者らと話すべきでしょう。\n我らとしては、王子に罰する気がな:
We should speak with the innkeepers about that matter.
As for us, we have no objections if the Prince does not wish to punish you.
m920171.そもそもフジムラサキは私の刀じゃん。\nなんで普通に裏切ってシズカの方にいたの。:
Besides, Fujimurasaki is *my* sword.
Why were you just standing on Shizuka's side like it was normal?
m920171.それが、我が子を救ってほしい……と？: She wanted us to save her child……?
m920171.それで、温泉を貸し切ったんですね。\nドラコシーサウルスの体温に、\nもっとも近:
So you rented out the hot spring.
To create an environment closest to the Draco Sea Sauruses' body temperature.
m920171.それではみなさん！\n少しの休憩を挟みまして、\n演習を続けて行きましょー！:
Now then, everyone!
After a short break,
let's continue the exercise!
--- scene: First Hot Spring Trip (battle, start) ---
m920171.それならそれで好都合です、\n私たちは黒幕の捜索に戻りましょう。:
Well, that's convenient.
Let's return to searching for the mastermind.
m920171.それも死体の傷口を見るに、\n同族に殺された可能性が高いと。:
Judging by the wounds on the bodies,
it's highly likely they were killed by their own kind.
m920171.そんな貴女にチヨメさんが颯爽登場！: Chiyome is here to save the day, just for you!
m920171.だが、世界の命運を懸けた戦いを前に、\nこれ以上海の中で傍観するだけなど御免だ。:
But with the fate of the world hanging in the balance,
I refuse to merely watch from the water any longer.
We must prove that we can fight on land, too.
m920171.だが、孵化の中断は無理な相談だ。\nそういう契約でね、それにほら──:
However, interrupting the hatching is out of the question.
That's the nature of the contract, and besides, look──
m920171.ちょ、ちょっと待ってください！！\nあなたが黒幕ではないのですか！？:
W-wait a moment!!
Aren't you the mastermind behind all this!?
m920171.つまり誰かのペットってこと？\n何の目的で温泉にあんな魔物を！:
So it's someone's pet?
What on earth is the point of releasing monsters into the hot springs!
m920171.でっ、では！ 僭越ながら私が！\n深海を代表して視察して参ります！:
T-Then! I humbly volunteer!
I will go inspect it on behalf of the deep sea!
m920171.でっかいのがこっちに向かってくるわよ！？: A big one's heading our way!
m920171.ではさらばだ、王子諸君。\n賠償金については雇用主に請求してくれたまえ。\n間違:
Farewell, Prince and company.
Please direct any compensation claims to the employer.
Do not send them to me, under any circumstances.
m920171.ではその雇用主とは誰なんですか！？\n私の！ 温泉旅行を！ 台無しにした犯人は！:
Then who is that employer!?
The one who ruined my! Hot spring trip!
m920171.なっ！ あいついくら払ったと──しまった！？: Wh- How much did they pay that creature, I w-wait!
m920171.はあ……やっぱり温泉は気持ち良いですねぇ。: Ahh… Hot springs really are the best.
m920171.ははぁ、ありがたき幸せ。\nそれでお姫様、お代の方は──:
Haha, your kindness is appreciated.
Now then, Princess, about the payment—
m920171.ははは、あれは純王国産高級牛肉を使った、\n正真正銘本物のステーキだともフィーヌ:
Hahaha, Miss Fine, that was a genuine steak
made with premium Pure Kingdom beef!
m920171.ひゅー！ うちのお姫様は最高だぜぇ！\nコマちゃん！ 今日のご飯は大盛ですよ！:
Whoo! Our Princess is the best!
Koma! Make it a big portion for dinner today!
m920171.ふふっ……フィーヌさんもようやく、\n温泉を楽しめているようでなによりです。:
Pfft… I'm glad you're finally
enjoying the hot springs, Fine.
m920171.ふふっ、お互い良い刺激になっているみたいですね。: Hehe, it seems we're all inspiring one another.
m920171.ふふっ、どうやら決まりのようですね。\nそれでは温泉旅行の計画を立てましょう。:
Hehe, it seems it's settled, then.
Well then, let's start planning our hot spring trip.
m920171.ふわわぁ……体がポッカポカですぅ……。\nあとは温泉にでも入れたら最高なんですが:
Fwaaah... my body is all warm and cozy...
It would be perfect if we could soak in a hot spring next.
m920171.ほう、気合が入っているじゃないか。\nであれば、こちらも全力で迎え撃とう。:
Hm, you certainly have some spirit.
In that case, we shall meet your challenge with everything we have.
m920171.ほわぁぁぁっ！ 温泉卵おいしいですぅぅぅっ！？: Mmm~! These hot spring eggs are so delicious~!
m920171.まあこちらも地上での戦いで、\n魚人に負けては立つ瀬がないからな。\nだが、凄ま:
Well, we couldn't afford to lose to the fish-folk in a land battle.
But I could feel a tremendous intensity coming from them.
m920171.まさかコウメちゃんの実家に、\nこんな秘湯が隠されてたなんてね。\nいやぁ、持つ:
I never imagined Koume's family home
hid such a secret spring.
Well, it pays to have a talented commoner.
m920171.まさかコマちゃんの縄張りを荒らしておいて、\nただで帰れるなんて思っちゃってるの:
You trampled all over Koma-chan's turf,
and you actually think you can just walk away?
m920171.まさかデーモンシェフさんが犯人だったなんて……。: I never would have guessed the Demon Chef was the culprit…
m920171.まさに孵化しようという頃合いだ。\n今更止められるようなものではないよ。:
The moment of hatching is nigh.
It's far too late to stop them now.
m920171.ますます怪しいわね……って、\nみんな！ あそこに誰かいるわよ！:
It's getting more and more suspicious… Wait,
everyone! There's someone over there!
m920171.まだ調べていない場所と言えば、\nこの貸し切りになっている宿ですが……。:
The only place we haven't checked yet is
this inn that's been rented out exclusively…
m920171.みなさん、素晴らしい向上心ですねぇ……\nうちのお姫さんにも見習ってほしいぐらい:
Everyone, what wonderful drive you all have…
I wish my princess would take a page from your book.
m920171.みなさん注意してください！\nドラコシーサウルスは水中を移動できます！\n奇襲に:
Everyone, be careful!
The Draco Seisaurs can move underwater!
Watch your positions so you don't get ambushed!
m920171.むぅ、見つかったからには仕方ありません。\nですが、コマちゃんがそれを許すでしょ:
Hmph. Now that we've been found, there's no choice.
But will Koma-chan allow that?
m920171.やはりそう簡単には行かぬか……。: So it wasn't going to be that easy, was it…
m920171.ゆえに我らには契約を遂行する義務がある。\nたとえそれが、正しくない行いだったと:
That is why we are bound to fulfill our contract.
Even if it means doing the wrong thing.
We cannot abandon the orphan of our friend.
m920171.よくぞやってくれた、社員諸君。\nこれでやっと、我が友との約束を守れる。:
Well done, my employees.
Now, at last, I can keep my promise to my friend.
m920171.よくも……よくも私の初めての温泉旅行をー！！: How dare you… how dare you ruin my first hot spring trip—!!
m920171.よーし、ヨシノお姉さん。\nこの村の年貢免除しちゃうぞー。:
Alright, Sister Yoshino
is waiving this village's taxes!
m920171.わあ！ すっごく楽しそうです！\n行ってもよいですか、クラールフ様！:
Oh! That sounds so much fun!
May we go, Lord Klaarf?
m920171.わわっ、あすもちゃん！？ \n私なら全然大丈夫ですから！:
W-Waa, Asmo-chan?!
I'm perfectly fine, so please don't worry!
m920171.んー、まあ温泉は入ったし。\nそろそろ帰って仕事するかー。:
Well, I did get to soak in the spring.
Time to head back and get to work, I guess.
m920171.エマさんの勘が大当たりみたいですね。\n世界各地の漁村で魔物の死体の発見報告が、:
It seems your instincts were right on the mark.
Reports of monster carcasses washing up in fishing villages
around the world have been increasing rapidly lately.
m920171.オーベッド……ああ、そうだ、その通りだ。\n魚人の誇りに懸け、このままでは終わら:
Obed… Ah, yes, you are right.
I swear on the pride of my people, this is not the end.
m920171.グレーターデーモンは全て喋りましたよ？: The Greater Demon told us everything, didn't it?
m920171.グレーターデーモン！？\nあなたがドラコリザードを、\n温泉街に放った黒幕なので:
A Greater Demon!?
You're the one who released the Draco Lizards
into the hot spring town, aren't you!!
m920171.コマちゃんが困ってるでしょうが！！: Koma-chan looks like she's in trouble!!
m920171.シェフ逃げてください！ ここは私が！: Chef, run! I'll hold them off!
m920171.シェフ！ ドラコシーサウルス、\n孵化の準備段階にまで入りました！:
Chef! The Draco Cisauros
has entered the final stage of hatching!
m920171.ダメです！ 煮魚になってしまいます！: I'm done for! I'm going to turn into a boiled fish!
m920171.チヨメさんはお姫さんと違って、\nちゃんと休暇を申請してるのでー。:
Unlike the Princess,
I properly filed a vacation request, you see.
m920171.デモシェフ商会の福利厚生の一環として、\n社員一同で温泉旅行に来ているのですが…:
We're on a company hot spring trip, as part of the Demon Chef Trading Company's employee benefits program…
But you seem quite flustered. What's the matter?
m920171.デーモンシェフさんは、\n商会の内部留保が全部消えたって、\n寂しそうに呟いてま:
The Demon Chef said that
the company's entire reserve fund was gone,
and he looked rather lonely as he muttered it…
m920171.デーモンシェフさん！\nあなたは本当に裏切ったのですか！\n裏では私たちを笑って:
Demon Chef!
Did you really betray us?
Were you laughing at us behind our backs all along?
m920171.デーモンシェフさん！\nもうこんなことはやめてください！:
Demon Chef!
Please stop this madness!
m920171.ドラコリザードを外に逃がした挙句、\n王子を呼び寄せておきながら逃走とは。: He let the Draco Lizard escape, and after luring the Prince here, he just ran off.
m920171.フィーヌさん、もはや言葉は不要でしょう。\n皆さん戦闘準備を、ここで彼らを止めま:
Fine, words are unnecessary now.
Everyone, get ready for battle. We stop them here.
m920171.フィーヌさーん！ 入らないんですかー！？: Fine-san! Are you not going to get in?!
m920171.フィーヌさーん！ 温泉卵作りませんかー！: Fine-san~! Want to make hot spring eggs~?
m920171.ワシは業務を委託されただけで、\n今回ばかりはただの雇われ悪魔だよ。\nドラコリ:
I was merely commissioned for the work.
In this case, I'm just a hired demon.
Hatching the Draco Lizards was the employer's wish.
m920171.交渉は不成立か……社員たちよ！\nドラコシーサウルスの孵化は近い！\nそれまで、: Negotiations have failed… Employees! The draco-saurus will hatch soon! Until then, we must guard that egg with our lives!
m920171.他のお客さんが襲われたら大変ですもんね、\n私が番台さんに報告して避難誘導してき:
It would be terrible if the other guests got attacked,
so I'll report to the front desk and guide everyone to safety!
m920171.他の宿の方に聞き込みしたところ、\n経営者一家は現在遠方に旅行中だとか。\nかな:
I asked the other inns, and it seems the owner's family
is currently traveling far away.
They appear to have rented out the entire inn for a considerable sum.
m920171.何か隠された事情があるはずです。\nそれを聞き出すためにも、彼らを止めなくては。:
There must be some hidden reason.
We need to stop them to find out what it is.
m920171.何と戦ってるのよ……。: What are you two even fighting about...
m920171.副デーモンシェフさん！？\nそちらこそどうしてここに！？:
Deputy Demon Chef!?
What are you doing here, of all places!?
m920171.双方準備はよろしいですね！\nそれではいざ！ 開戦でーす！:
Are both sides ready?
Then let's do this! Battle, begin!
--- scene: Midwinter Land-and-Sea Joint Exercise (battle, end) ---
m920171.周りにあるのは卵……ですね。\n温泉の熱で孵化させるつもりでしょうか。\n即刻、:
Those are eggs… aren't they?
Are you trying to hatch them using the heat of the springs?
I demand you cease this dangerous activity immediately.
m920171.変ですね……従業員の方もいません。: That's strange… there's no staff around either.
m920171.天界との戦いを控える中で、\n今度は海にも新たな異常の兆しとは。\n国へ帰還した:
With the war against the Celestial Realm looming, this is the latest sign of trouble in the sea.
Things are going to be hectic once we get back to the kingdom…
m920171.守秘義務の関係上、言えないね。\nなに、これだけの騒ぎを起こしたんだ、\nすぐに:
I'm bound by confidentiality, so I can't say.
But given the commotion, they'll find out soon enough.
m920171.尻尾を出しましたね。\nリズリーさん、お願いします。:
There's a tail sticking out.
Risley, please.
m920171.当館での行き過ぎた乱暴狼藉。\nいくら領主さまとて許せませぬ。\n恐れながら出禁:
The excessive violence and disorder in my establishment...
Even if you are the Lord, I cannot allow it.
I'm afraid I must ban you from the premises.
m920171.彼らは海の暴れん坊。深海の民として、\nそのようなものを街中で孵化させようとする:
They are the rascals of the sea. As a people of the deep,
we cannot stand by while you attempt to hatch such a creature
in the middle of town!
m920171.後悔は全部が終わってからよ。\nドラコシーサウルスが何か知らないけど、\n危ない:
Save your regrets for when this is all over.
I don't know what a Draco Cisauros is,
but if it's a dangerous monster, we have to stop it here.
m920171.恩に着るぞ、王子よ。そして子どもたちの\n命を奪わずにいてくれたこと、深く感謝す: I am grateful, Prince. And I deeply thank you for sparing the children's lives.
m920171.我らは、この卵を母親から託された。\n今際の際に、どうか我が子を救ってくれと。:
We were entrusted with this egg by its mother.
On her deathbed, she begged us to save her child.
m920171.戦闘終了……だけど、\n肝心のデーモンシェフたちには、\nどさくさで逃げられちゃ:
Battle over… but in the confusion,
the Demon Chefs managed to slip away.
m920171.推理は後です、まずはフィーヌさんの救出を。\nドラコリザードは水上を走ることがで:
We can deduce later. First, we need to rescue Fine-san.
Draco Lizards can run across the water's surface, so
be mindful of the terrain and your distance while fighting.
m920171.本合同演習の趣旨は、\n今後さらなる激化が予想される戦いに備え、\n各陣営の苦手:
The purpose of this joint exercise is to prepare for the battles
that are expected to intensify further in the future,
by overcoming the weaknesses of each camp.
m920171.本来は凶暴な魔物だが彼女は温厚な性格でな、\n人間とも上手に折り合いつけて共存し:
By nature, they are fierce monsters, but she had a gentle disposition.
It seems she managed to coexist peacefully with humans.
Then, the other day, she was found collapsed on the beach.
m920171.気づいたときには、もう手遅れだった。\n瀕死の状態でありながら大事に卵を抱えて、:
By the time we realized what had happened, it was already too late.
She was on the verge of death, yet she clutched her egg protectively.
As we rushed to her side, she pleaded with us through her eyes.
m920171.海だから動けない、陸だから戦えない。\nそんな言い訳も戦場には通用しません。:
"We can't move because it's the sea," or "We can't fight because it's land."
Such excuses will not be tolerated on the battlefield.
m920171.海底にも熱水の湧く場所があるだろう。\n乾いた地の民はあの熱い水を一か所に溜めて:
There are places where hot water springs up on the ocean floor.
I hear the people of the Dry Lands collect that hot water in one place
and build entertainment facilities called "hot springs" to heal their body and mind.
m920171.温泉街に魔物の卵を持ち込んだ犯人。\nグレーターデーモンはすぐに会えるって\n言:
The culprit who brought the monster's egg to the hot spring town.
The Greater Demon said we'd meet it soon,
but where on earth is it?
m920171.然り。同胞よ、敗北を嘆く必要はない。\nこれを糧として、次に活かせば良いだけの話:
Indeed. My kin, there is no need to mourn this defeat.
We simply use it as fuel for our next battle.
The day when we can lend our strength to the dry land is surely coming.
m920171.王国軍よ、フィーヌはああ言っているが、\n海中でも十分に戦えている貴殿らに比べて:
Army of the Kingdom, Fine says that, but
compared to you all, who can fight just fine in the sea,
we are unable to perform at our best outside of the water.
m920171.現状では何とも言えませんが、\nあれだけの数です、まだ他に隠れているやも。\n今:
It's hard to say for certain right now, but
given that number, there may be more hiding around.
We should evacuate the guests in the hot spring town immediately.
m920171.申し訳ありませんシェフ、\nあまり時間を稼ぐことができず……。:
I apologize, Chef.
I couldn't hold them off for very long…
m920171.疲れを癒しに来たはずが、\n余計に疲れている気がします……。:
I came here to relax,
but I feel even more exhausted than before…
m920171.皆、此度の演習ご苦労であった。\n乾いた地の民よ、協力に深く感謝しよう。\n実に:
Well done, everyone. You have worked hard on this exercise.
To the people of the Dry Lands, my deepest thanks for your cooperation.
I am confident this was a truly productive session.
m920171.皆さんドラコリザードの卵には注意を。\n衝撃を与えればそれだけ孵化も早まります、:
Everyone, be careful with the Draco Lizard eggs.
Shocking them only hastens the hatching.
If they all hatch at once, it will be difficult to repel them.
m920171.私が教えたの、残念だったわねお姫様。: I told her. How unfortunate for you, Princess.
m920171.私の人選ミスです。\n火急の案件だったとはいえ、\nもっと他の者を雇うべきでした:
It was my mistake in hiring.
Even if it was an urgent matter, I should have hired someone else.
m920171.私も想定以上に迫られたから、\n焦って何発か砲弾を外しちゃったわ。\n気を引き締:
I was pushed harder than I expected, too.
I got flustered and missed a few shots with my cannon.
I really need to tighten up my focus.
m920171.色々と大変だったものね。\nまあ辛うじて人的被害はなかったようだし、\n温泉街が:
It's been quite a ordeal.
Fortunately, there were no casualties,
and the hot spring town was able to reopen right away.
m920171.裏切られた、という気持ちはあるでしょう。\nしかし彼は、極めて理性的なデーモンで:
You must feel betrayed.
But he is an extremely rational demon.
I can't believe he would act so impulsively now.
m920171.許可しよう。ただし温泉なる文化が、\n我ら深海の民の肌に合うかはまだ分からぬ。\:
I grant you permission. However, it is still unknown whether the culture of hot springs
will suit the skin of us deep-sea folk.
Let us first gather volunteers and try it out with a small group.
m920171.謝るな、元はと言えば私の責任だ。\nそれにしてもグレーターデーモンめ、\n適当な:
Don't apologize. In the end, this is my responsibility.
Besides, that Greater Demon truly did a sloppy job.
m920171.通るわけないでしょ！ そんなこと！\nよくも私に仕事を押し付けてくれたわね！:
There's no way I'd let that slide!
How dare you dump your work on me!
m920171.過ぎたことはもういい。\n奴のやり方とはソリが合わぬ、\nそれが分かっただけでも:
Let the past be.
His methods never suited me, anyway.
At least now I know that much.
m920171.選択したのは自分だ、後悔はしてないだろうさ。: He made his own choice. He probably doesn't regret it.
m920171.錆びないわ、私の方が強いし。: I don't rust. I'm stronger than rust.
m920171.魔神アスモデウスか……\nずいぶんと変わった姿をしているな。\n過保護は分かるが:
The Demon Lord Asmodeus, I see...
You have taken quite a different form.
I understand your overprotectiveness, but please calm down first.
m920171.（事件は解決しましたが、\nデーモンシェフの話が引っ掛かる。\nなにやら嫌な予感:
(The incident is resolved, but
the Demon Chef's words are still on my mind.
I have a bad feeling about this…)

m920184.――ああ。\n行くぞ、魔界の戦士たちよ！:
――Aye.
March forth, warriors of the Demon Realm!
m920184.――あの御方を救出できる可能性が高い、か。\nならば、華々しく散るのもまた、\n: But we can serve as the foundation. Rather than the Dark Elves and Orcs bowing to the Lesser God Dias, it would be better if the Prince used us as pawns to challenge the gods—
m920184.――おぉ、そういうことか。\n妹が、見つかったのだな？:
――Ah, I see.
So you've found your sister?
m920184.――ここに、儀式は成った。\n神とは如何なるものか、\nその現実を目に焼き付ける:
—The ritual is complete.
Witness the reality of what a god truly is.
m920184.――さすがは我が娘です。\nこれくらいで心折れてしまっては、\nこの後の戦いを任: I couldn't entrust her with the battles to come.
m920184.――されど、あれは亜神の言葉です。\n神とは誰よりも傲慢ですが、\n同時に、己に:
—Yet, those were the words of a Lesser God.
The gods are the most arrogant of all,
but they never break the laws they set for themselves.
m920184.――そも、神器とは如何なるものか。: —To begin with, what is a Divine Artifact?
m920184.――それで、戦況はどうなっている。\n私が迷惑をかけてしまったようだが。:
――So, what is the state of the war?
I must have caused quite a bit of trouble.
m920184.――それでは、一気に仲間も増えたことですし、\n歓迎会の準備、進めておきますね♪: — Well then, since we've gained a bunch of allies at once, I'll get the welcome party preparations started♪
m920184.――だが、その程度の実力では、\nオリュンポスの頂に至ることもできまい。:
――But with power of that magnitude,
you will never reach the peak of Olympus.
m920184.――と言いつつ、セフィーレたちが危険だ、\nとかなんとか言って、\n後先考えずに:
—I say, while you were all going on about how

dangerous it would be for Sephire and the others,

who was it that rushed off without thinking twice?
m920184.――なぁ、ゴローザエモン様、\nルキファってのはどんな奴なんだ？:
――Hey, Gorozaemon-sama,
what kind of guy is Lukifer?
m920184.――ほう、大半は消滅するかと思ったが、\n腕のいい召喚術師がいるようだな。:
—Hmph. I thought most of you would be annihilated,
but it seems there are some skilled summoners among you.
m920184.――ほう、見違えるようではないか。\nこの短い時間で、これ程の実力を身に着けると:
—Hm. You are a sight to behold.
To acquire such power in so short a time…
m920184.――や、やばっ、やばいやつです！\n王子さま、みんな、離れないで――ッ！！:
—T-This is bad, this is really bad!
Prince, everyone, don't let go of me—!!
--- scene: Those Who Challenge the Gods ---
m920184.――やはり、その手は届かなかったか。\n貴様ならばもしやと思ったが。:
――So, your hand did not reach it, after all.
I wondered if perhaps you might have succeeded.
m920184.――セフィーレ様、落ち着いてください。\n怒りは正常な判断を奪うのですよ？:
—Sephire, please calm down.

Anger only clouds one's judgment, you know?
m920184.――ルキファは無事に、解放されたようですね。\n時間稼ぎをした甲斐が……あったと:
――It seems Lukifa has been safely freed.
The effort to buy time… paid off, I suppose.
m920184.――ルキファ様が、倒れた。\n……今だ、今しかない！\n王子、頼む、ルキファ様の:
――Lukifer-sama has fallen.
…Now is the time! Now is the only chance!
Prince, please, break the mental domination over Lukifer-sama!
m920184.――ルキファ様に触れるな！\n……ご無事ですか、ルキファ様。:
—Do not touch Lord Lukifer!

…Are you safe, Lord Lukifer?
m920184.――久しいな、この魔力。\n長らく翼をもがれていたかのようだ。:
—Long have I felt this power.
It seems my wings were long since torn from me.
m920184.――失うには、惜しい男だ。\n人の身で余に刃を届かせてみせるとは。:
――What a pity. You are a man too valuable to lose.
To actually manage to land a blade on me while still in a human body.

This is a teleportation spell!?
No! There's no time to counter it…!!
m920184.これは慈悲である。\n我が甘言が、オリュンポスへ至れという誘いが、\nその実力を:
Consider this an act of mercy.
My sweet words, my invitation to reach Olympus,
must have led you to misjudge your own strength.
m920184.さぁて、覚悟しろよルキファ。\nこういう精神支配ってぇのは、\n頭をどついてやれ:
Alright, brace yourself, Lukifer.

This kind of mind control

usually clears up if you just bonk the head a bit—
m920184.さぁみんな、このまま儀式の間へ。\nそれから、亜神イルドナ様、\nあなたも回復し:
Now then, everyone, let's head to the ritual chamber.
And, Demi-God Ildona,
please follow us as soon as you have recovered.
m920184.さぁ王子よ、此度の人類への罰、\n貴様らを死地へ向かわせた、\n愚かな扇動者たる:
Now, Prince. Let us show the foolish agitators,
the Three Goddesses who drove you to this death,
the punishment for humanity!
m920184.さて……誰か、状況を説明してくれまいか。\nどうやら、随分と大きな借りを作ってし: Now… someone explain the situation. Looks like we've racked up quite a debt.
m920184.さらばだ、我が唯一の友よ。\n安寧と停滞の世界で、\nただ余のみが、貴様を覚えて:
Farewell, my only friend.
In a world of peace and stagnation,
I alone will remember you.
m920184.されど、神殺しを成した王子という存在に、\n神たる力を重ねたなら、そこに可能性も:
Yet, if the power of a god were layered upon
the existence of the Prince, who has slain gods,
then a possibility might emerge.
m920184.しかし、余も人類に感化されたか……。\n王子がここへ至ったことに、\n少々心躍っ:
Perhaps I have been influenced by humanity as well……
The fact that I feel a certain thrill
at the Prince's arrival here is no lie.
m920184.しばらくは絶対安静、ですわね。\n一週間ほどは執務も休んでもらわないと。:
He needs absolute rest for the time being.
I'd say he should be off from his duties for at least a week.
m920184.すみません、軽率でした。\n数多の伝説を残す彼が、\nそう簡単に負けるはずもあり:
I'm sorry, that was careless of me.
He's a man who has left behind countless legends.
He wouldn't fall so easily.
m920184.そ、そうです！\n戦わなかったら、世界は滅んでいたんですから！:
T-that's right!
If we hadn't fought, the world would have been destroyed!
m920184.そういうのは隠すとろくなことにならないんだぜ？\nともあれ、あっちは千年戦争を戦:
Hiding things like that never ends well, you know?

Anyway, they've brought out a legendary Fallen Angel

who fought in the Millennium War.
m920184.そうして最後は、\nこれからよろしく頼む、でしょうか。:
And finally, he'll probably say,
"I look forward to working with you."
m920184.そうしなければ、この世界はなかった。\nガリウスを倒していなければ、\n今の物質:
Without it, this world would not exist.
If we hadn't defeated Garius,
the Material Plane would have long since been reduced to ashes.
m920184.そうは言っても――って、\nなっ、リヴンどうして……こほんっ、\nリヴン様、どう:
I know, but—wait,

Wh—Riven, why are you… cough,

Lord Riven, why are you here…!?
m920184.そしてこれこそが、真なる神の雷霆である。: And this is the true divine thunder.
m920184.そのディアスは、現在魔王城内で、\n大規模な儀式を行使しているようです。\nルキ:
That Dias is currently performing a large-scale ritual
inside the Demon King's Castle.
Lukifer, do you have any idea what it might be?
m920184.その上、可愛い臣下までできて。\n今度こそ、絶対に、助けないといけないわね。:
On top of that, he's gained a cute retainer.
This time, absolutely, we must save him.
m920184.その彼が、英雄王の子孫たる王子だ。\n……よく、無事に戻ってきてくれたな、ルキフ:
That man is the Prince, descendant of the Hero King.
...Good that you returned safely, Lukifer.
m920184.その答えは、千年前に既に出ていたというのに、\n私はそれを信じきれませんでした。:
The answer had been given a thousand years ago,
yet I could not bring myself to fully believe it.
m920184.それが正しいとすると、なんですけどぉ……。: If that theory is correct, then...
m920184.それで、今にも倒れてしまいそうなのに、\n私たちの肩まで借りて、\nこうしてここ:
And yet, on the verge of collapse,
he leaned on our shoulders
and made it this far.
m920184.それでもなお、\nあえて人類の相手をしたのはなぜだ。\nただの滅びが、目的ではな:
And yet, why did he still choose to engage with humanity?
It must be because mere annihilation was not his goal, no?
m920184.それとも、人類と仲良くしようって、\n宗旨替えでもしたのかしら。:
Or did you have a change of heart and decide
to get along with humanity?
m920184.それにしても、お前たちに成長の時間を与え、\nオリュンポスの頂に至るまで\n待っ:
And yet, I told you that I would grant you time to grow,
and wait until you reached the peak of Olympus.
m920184.それにしても、亜神ディアスの最後の言葉、\n信用していいのでしょうか……。:
Still, Dias's final words…
Can we really trust them?
m920184.それを容易く人に授けるなど、\nその行いが世界にどれだけの影響を与えるのか、\n:
To so casually bestow such power upon humans…
I truly doubt you understand
the impact such an act has on the world.
m920184.それを救ってくれたのが、為政者たるアスバール様と、\n正義の執行者たるルキファ様:
Those who saved us were Lord Asval, our ruler,
and Lukifer, the executor of justice.
m920184.それを浅慮だと言うのだ。\nガリウスは、本当に世界を滅ぼそうとしていたのか？:
I call that shallow thinking.
Did Garius truly intend to destroy the world?
m920184.そんなすごい人を、\n支配されっぱなしになんてできないよね。\nさぁ、最後の術式:
I can't let someone that amazing
stay under someone else's control.
Alright, I'm going to shatter the final formation!
m920184.ただの被造物たる人類に、そんな力はない。\n運命に翻弄され、偶然に一喜一憂し、\:
Humanity, mere creations, possess no such power.
To be tossed about by fate, to rejoice and grieve over chance,
and to march toward a predetermined death—that is what humanity is.
m920184.だから、私はただ、\nこの約束を守ると己に誓ったのですよ。: So I merely swore to myself that I would keep that promise.
m920184.だが……そうだな、こんな感覚は初めてだ。\n素晴らしい、これが人の可能性というも:
But…… yes, this is a sensation I have never felt before.
Magnificent. So this is the potential of humanity.
m920184.だが、ここまでだ。\nもはやその身体で、儀式を止めることはできまい。:
But this is where it ends.
That body of yours can no longer stop the ritual.
m920184.だが、人という不確定な存在を、\n貴様が導き続けられると証明するのなら、\n我が:
But if you can prove that you are capable
of continuing to guide such an uncertain species as humans,
I will admit that my answer was a mistake.
m920184.だが、礎となれるはずだ。\nダークエルフとオークが亜神ディアスに弓引くよりも、\: This is... what we're doing must be a betrayal of them.
m920184.だろうな……。\n残念だ、我が隣に立つに値する男だというのに。:
I suppose so…
What a pity. You were a man worthy of standing at my side.
m920184.ちっ……アルヴァ！\n王子を連れてどこかに転移しろ！！\nこいつだけでも生き延び:
Tch… Alva!
Teleport the Prince somewhere, now!!
If he alone survives—
m920184.ちょっとだけ、\n人間の勉強が足りていなかったみたいね？\n――さぁみんな、急い:
It seems you have a bit of a gap
in your understanding of humans, don't you?
—Come on, everyone, hurry!
m920184.てめぇが不甲斐ないから、\n子供が立派に育ったんだよ。:
It's because you were such a failure
that they grew up to be such fine people.
m920184.で、でも、それってまずいですわよ……？\n精神支配されたままでありながら、\n本:
B-but that's troublesome, isn't it...?
It means that even while under mental domination,
you can still unleash your full power.
m920184.でも、その凶行を止める力も、人は持っている。\nその片鱗を感じたからこそ、\nあ:
But humans possess the power to stop such atrocities, too.
It was because you sensed that glimmer
that you decided to wait for the Prince. Am I wrong?
m920184.となれば、こっちも同じく英傑の出番、だろ？\nルキファ、なぁおい！ ひっさしぶり:
Which means it's time for our own heroes to step up, right?

Lukifer, hey there! Long time no see, huh!
m920184.なっ……イルドナが分身したぁ！？: Wha… Ildona has split into multiple copies!
m920184.なっ……ザエモン！ それは秘密だと言っただろう！: Wh—Gorozaemon! I told you that was a secret!
m920184.なっ……ルキファ、さま？\nなぜここに……！？:
Wha... Lukifer?
Why are you here...!?
m920184.なっ、リヴンに言われたくないぞ。\n……はぁ。待っているからな、イルドナ。\n光:
Hah, I don't need a lecture from you, Riven.
……Sigh. I'll be waiting, Ildona.
Act like the Demi-God of Light you claim to be,
and play the hero properly!
m920184.ならば、それが過ちだと証明してやろう。\n貴様らの愛した女神アイギスの前で、な。: Then I'll prove that's a mistake—in front of the goddess Aegis you adore.
m920184.ならば、なぜ奴はかつて人類と戦いを続けたのだ。\n魔物に蹂躙され、文明を退行させ:
If so, why did he continue to wage war against humanity in the past?
He could have crushed those who were trampled by monsters
and caused civilization to regress far more easily than he did.
m920184.ならば、力ずくで取り戻せば良い。\n王子よ、これより先は我らも助力するぞ。:
Then you need only take it back by force.
Prince, from here on we will lend you our aid as well.
m920184.なるほど、ようやく理解できました。\nでは、その共に戦う仲間として、\nひとつ頼:
I see. I finally understand.
Then, as one of those companions in battle,
may I ask you for a small favor?
m920184.なんとも、生き急ぐものだ。\nアスバール、貴様がついていてなお、\nか弱き人類た:
How hasty of you to be alive.
Asbaal, even with you at his side,
you would send the frail human Prince to his death……
m920184.はぁっ……はぁっ……。\nどれだけ、魔力を持っていくの……。\n魔剣に呼びかける:
Haa… haa…
How much magic are you taking…
I was told it would only be a call to the magic sword…

Haa… haa…
How much magic are you taking…
I was told it would only be a call to the magic sword…
m920184.はっ、いえ、妹は随分と昔に、\n物質界へ逃げ延びさせたので……。\nこんな所で会:
Hah, no, I sent my sister
to the Material World a long time ago…
I never imagined we'd meet in a place like this――
m920184.はっ、えっ？ どの子？\nグレーテルちゃんのこと？:
Hah, what? Which one?
You mean Gretel?
m920184.はっ、急ぎますわよ！\nメーリス、あなたも手伝ってくださいな！:
Hah, I'm on it!
Maelis, help me out!
m920184.ふざけたことを。\n我が願いはこの世界の未来である。:
Don't be ridiculous.
My wish is the future of this world.
m920184.ふふ、あれは契約などという、\n大仰なものではありませんよ。: Heh, it was hardly the sort of grand affair you'd call a contract.
m920184.ふふ、また悪行をなしてしまったな。\n兄妹を再会させてしまうとは。:
Fufu, I've committed another misdeed.
Reuniting a brother and sister.
m920184.ふふっ。\n――あっ、ところで、\n王子が彼の謝罪を受けたら、なんと返すと思いま:
Fufu.
—Ah, by the way,
do you think the Prince will accept his apology?
m920184.まさか人類が、\n魔物に抗する力を維持し続けたとでも？\nあの英雄王の誕生まで、:
Surely you don't believe that humanity
managed to maintain the strength to resist the monsters?
That they continued to protect the world until the birth of that Hero King?
m920184.まさか貴様ほどの亜神が、\nその身を犠牲に時間稼ぎとはな……。: I can't believe a demi-god of your stature would sacrifice your own body to buy time.
m920184.まずは、敵を蹴散らすとしましょうか。\nルキファを救おうにも、\n足止めされてい:
Let's scatter the enemy first, then.
If we're held up,
we won't be able to save Lukifer.
m920184.まったく、無理しやがって。\nほーぅ、亜神でも脂汗はかくんだなぁ？:
Honestly, why do you push yourself so hard?
Hmph, so even Lesser Gods break into a cold sweat, huh?
m920184.まったくだ。\n今度呑みにでも誘ってみるかねェ。:
Indeed.
Perhaps we should invite him out for a drink sometime.
m920184.もう十分に戦った。\nだが、ああ、もし叶うのならば……。:
We have fought enough.
But, ah, if it were possible to...
m920184.もったいぶるな、アンブローズ。\n悪い癖だぞ？:
Stop beating around the bush, Ambrose.
That's a bad habit of yours.
m920184.や、ヤメロっ！ ナゼそんな笑顔で！\nアァ、マッタク……！！:
S-stop it! Why are you smiling like that!
Ah, for goodness' sake…!!
m920184.やり方が乱暴なのだ、お前は。\n王子よ、王国軍に精神支配解除の専門家はいるだろう:
Your method is rather crude, Gorozaemon.

Prince, does the Kingdom's army have any specialists in lifting mind control?
m920184.やるな……。\nさすがは王子、魔界武術大会の覇者だ……！:
Not bad...
Truly the Prince, the conqueror of the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament...!
m920184.ゆえに、亜神イルドナの力も受け継がず、\n余を滅ぼす力も身に着けず、\nここに立:
Therefore, your rashness and reckless courage—
standing here without inheriting the power of the Lesser God Ildona,
nor acquiring the strength to destroy me—
deserve punishment.
m920184.ゆえに、貴様らに許されし唯一の感情は諦めなのだ。\n自由意志を手放し、安寧と停滞:
Therefore, the only emotion permitted to you is resignation.
To surrender your free will, and to end your life as a cog
within a state of peace and stagnation—that is the righteous path.
m920184.ようやく力を取り戻してきたというのに、\n声もかけてくれぬとは、遠慮し過ぎなので:
After finally regaining your strength,

and not even bothering to give us a heads-up? You are being far too modest, aren't you?
m920184.よくやってくれました、グリムさん。\nあんな滅茶苦茶な魔力の流れだったのに、\n:
You did well, Grimm.
With that chaotic flow of mana,
it's a miracle no one got separated.
m920184.よし、王子！ このまま突っ切るぜ！: Alright, Prince! Let's push right through!
m920184.わっ、わかった！\n即席で解呪の魔法を組み立てて……。:
W-What? Got it!
I'll throw together a hasty dispelling spell…
m920184.わっ、パパ連れてくる場所間違えちゃった？\nよーし、医務室行くよ！ 医務室！:
Waa! Did we bring Papa to the wrong place?
Alright, let's go to the infirmary! To the infirmary!
m920184.ん……少し待て、覚えがある……。\n確か奴は、三女神の力の痕跡と、\nレヴィアタ:
Hm... wait, I remember something...
I believe he was attempting to connect the traces of the Three Goddesses' power
to Leviathan.
m920184.んっふっふ、パパはねぇ、\nみんなに謝りたいらしいよ？: Nfu-fu, Papa says he wants to apologize to everyone.
m920184.アトにぃともよくぶつかってた。\nふたりとも強情だから、全然会話が噛み合わなくて:
I also clashed with Atna a lot.
You two are both so stubborn that you never seemed to get along.
m920184.アンブローズが、生き延びた仲間たちと、\n王国そのものを託されたように。: And Ambrose was entrusted with the surviving comrades and the kingdom itself.
m920184.イ、イルドナ……？\nいったい、どうやってここに……？:
I, Ildona…?
How did you get here…?
m920184.イルドナ、もう大丈夫なのか？\n魔界から転送門も無しに直接転移するだなんて、\n:
Ildona, are you alright?
Teleporting directly from the Demon Realm without a gate…
That must have drained an amount of mana that could have erased you from existence.
m920184.イルドナは昔から、勝手に行動しては、\n勝手に戦果を上げてくる困った男だったから:
Ildona has always been a troublesome man who acts on his own
and racks up victories on his own.
He's causing us trouble again this time.
m920184.イルドナ様、私たちの先祖に、\nフラガラッハを託してくださった偉大なるお方。:
Ildona-sama, our ancestors were entrusted with Flagarah
by a great being.
m920184.イルドナ！ 無事だったか。\n済まなかったな、私が操られていなければ、\nもっと:
Ildona! You're unharmed.
I'm sorry. If I hadn't been under control,
I could have rushed to your side much sooner…
m920184.オッホン！\nサ、サァゴブリン軍団ヨ！\nさっそく訓練に移るノダ！！:
Cough!
N-now then, Goblin Legion!
We're moving straight into training!!
m920184.オリュンポスで待つ、ね……。\n本当なら信じたくはないけれど――:
He said he'd be waiting at Olympus…
I wish I didn't have to believe it, but—
m920184.オークの誇りまで、曲げさせてしまったな。\n後悔は、していないか？:
We have even been forced to bend the pride of the Orcs.
Do you have no regrets?
m920184.キミにも言い分はあるだろうけど！\nそんなに民に慕われてるキミを、\n苦しませた:
I know you have your reasons!
But I can't just leave you, who is so beloved by the people,
suffering like this!!
m920184.ギャギャ！ クンレン！ クンレン！\nイザススメー！！:
Gya-gya! Training! Training!
Let's get to it!!
m920184.ケラウノスよ、その力は貴様のものではない。\n天界に君臨しながらも、人類に倒され:
Keraunos, that power does not belong to you.
Though you ruled the heavens, you were felled by humanity
because you did not know how to wield lightning.
m920184.ケラウノス様が――ぐぅッ……ディ、アス様が……。\n私たちを、正しき形に作り直し:
Keraunos-sama—grrrk……Dias-sama……
will remake us into our proper form.
m920184.コレは個人的ナ話デアルが……。\n今後ハ、トモとして、お前に接しても……。:
This is a personal matter, but…
From now on, if I were to treat you as a friend…
m920184.ゴブリン軍団ニモ、王国軍ニモ、\n複雑な心境の者タチはイルことダロウ……。:
There are probably some with complicated feelings,
whether on the Goblin Legion side or the Kingdom side…
m920184.サァ諸君、このパレードはタダの行進ではナイ！\n未来へ続く進軍にナルと、\nワタ:
Now then, everyone! This parade is no mere procession!
I believe it will become an advance toward the future!!
m920184.サレド！ 王子は敵でアル我らにも、\nその手を差し伸べ続けてくれてイル。: And yet! Even to us, who are your enemies, the Prince has continued to extend his hand.
m920184.ザエモン……。\nくっ……なんだ、この記憶は……。\n私は、神の剣……ディアス様:
Gorozaemon…

Ugh… what is this memory…

I am the Sword of God… Lord Dias's…
m920184.ソシテ！ ツイニ！ コノ記念すべき日、\nゴブリン軍団と、王国との合同パレードが:
And! Finally! On this momentous day,
a joint parade between the Goblin Legion and the Kingdom has become a reality!!
m920184.ソラスが未来の英雄――今の王子たちへの\n助力を任せられたように。: Just as Solas was entrusted with aiding the heroes of the future—our current Princes—
m920184.ディアス、つまりそれは、\n世界の書き換えをやめるということかしら？:
Dias, does that mean you're
going to stop rewriting the world?
m920184.ディアス、様……。\nああ、そうだな、そのとおりだ。\n――全軍剣をとれ、王国軍:
Dias-sama……
Ah, yes. That is correct.
——All units, draw your blades. We will meet the Kingdom's army.
m920184.ナラバ、我らもその手を握り返し、\n敵ではアレド、滅すべき敵ではナク、\n好敵手: So perhaps we should take that hand in return, and, though we remain foes, walk forward not as enemies to be destroyed, but as worthy rivals!
m920184.ヘンゼルさん……。\n王子、今は先を急ぎましょう。\nこのまま魔王城へ突入します:
Hansel…….
Prince, we should press on now.
Let's charge straight into the Demon King's Castle!
m920184.ヘンゼルさんに頼まれてしまいましたし、\n必ず、彼女を亜神ディアスから解放しまし: Ah... that sounds exactly like something Lord Lukifer would say.
m920184.ヘンゼルさんは、\n以前魔界での戦いを助けてくれたんです。\nしかし、どうして亜:
Hansel helped us
in a previous battle in the Demon Realm.
But why is he on the side of the Lesser God Dias……?
m920184.メカゴブリンクイーン様、\nそして盟友タル王子の友誼ガ、永遠たらんコトヲ！！:
May the friendship of Mecha Goblin Queen-sama
and our ally, the Prince, last forever!!
m920184.ラーワル……いえ、それには語弊が……。: Rawal… No, that's not quite the right way to put it.
m920184.リヴンだよ。\nあの戦いの後に、姿を変えたんだそうだ。:
That's Riven.
Apparently, she changed her appearance after that battle.
m920184.ルキファ、あなた、\n操られていてもなお、自分の意識が……。:
Lukifer, even though you are under control,
your own will is still...
m920184.ルキファ、僕らは、キミを取り戻す。\nこの後には亜神ディアスが待ってるんだ。\n:
Lukifer, we're going to get you back.
The Lesser God Dias is waiting for us after this.
No matter how much you resist, you'll fight with us as a comrade.
m920184.ルキファ、千年戦争の時には、いっぱい喧嘩したよね。\nキミはどう見ても正義の味方:
Lukifer, we fought a lot during the Millennium War, right?
Even though you were clearly on the side of justice,
you kept stubbornly insisting that you were evil.
m920184.ルキファか……。\nなんつーのか、人間以上のお人好しっていうか、\n他人のことし:
Lukifer, huh…….
How should I put it, he's a good soul beyond human measure,
or maybe just a fool who only thinks of others?
m920184.ルキファ様、よかった……！\nありがとう、王子、シャルロットさん、メーリスさん…:
Lukifer-sama, thank goodness…!
Thank you, Prince, Charlotte, Mehlis…
m920184.ルキファ様、王国軍が進軍を開始しました。\n迎撃の指揮をお願いします。:
Lukifer-sama, the Kingdom's army has begun its advance.
Please take command of the interception.
m920184.レヴィアタンが物質界から離れたことで、\n運良く魔界に落ちることができたのかもし:
Perhaps he was lucky enough to fall into the Demon Realm
when Leviathan departed the Material World.
m920184.世界の未来と、亜神一柱の命……。\n簡単な選択でしょう。:
The future of the world, and the life of a single Demi-God…
It is a simple choice.
m920184.主の御言葉こそが正義なれば、\n全てを救わんとする我が行いこそ悪である。\nそし:
If the Master's word is justice,
then my actions to save all are evil.
And to defy the gods is, without a doubt, the truest form of evil.
m920184.互いに解決スベキことは残されてイルが、\nされど、この行事がヒトツの節目となるハ:
There are still things we need to resolve between us,
but this event should serve as a milestone.
m920184.亜神イルドナが、時間を稼いでくれています。\n王子、彼のためにも、魔界の民のため:
The Demigod Ildona is buying us time.
Prince, for his sake, and for the sake of the demon race,
let us crush the Demigod Dias's scheme.
m920184.亜神イルドナの助力があったと言っても、\n力を取り戻した亜神ディアスの、\nあの: Even with Ildona's help, he still took that lightning bolt head-on…
m920184.亜神ディアスは、天使を支配する、\n何らかの装置を所持しています。\nその影響下:
The Lesser God Dias possesses some kind of device
that allows him to dominate the angels.
Since you were under its influence, there is nothing to be done about it.
m920184.人の持つ最も強い力は、\n絶対に諦めないという、その誓いだ。:
The strongest power that humans possess
is the vow to never, ever give up.
m920184.人の自由意志に任せていれば、\n物質界は容易く滅びるだろう。\nそれくらい、貴様:
Left to the free will of humans,
the material world would perish easily.
I thought you understood that much.
m920184.人を助けてまわっているのに、悪、ですか？: Justice, huh? I suppose he is a hero of justice. He always said he was walking the path of evil, though.
m920184.人類が神に届くかもしれないと、\nそう期待したがゆえに、誤解させたのなら――:
If I led you to misunderstand
because I hoped humanity might reach the gods—
m920184.人類が神に届くかもしれないと、\nそう期待したがゆえに、誤解させてしまったか……:
I allowed myself to hope that humanity might reach the gods,
and in doing so, I let you misunderstand…
m920184.今の物質界連合軍の力では、\n亜神ディアスに、未だ及びません。:
The current strength of the Material World Coalition
is still not enough to match the Demi-God Dias.
m920184.仕方ないですよ。\n王国にも、ゴブリン軍団にも、\n互いに禍根は色々と残ったまま:
I suppose that's only to be expected.
There are still plenty of lingering grievances on both the Kingdom's and the Goblin Legion's side.
m920184.以前の魔王決戦の時には及びませんが、\n兵の力を高めることができますよ！: It may not be as potent as during the last war against the Demon King, but it should be enough to boost our troops' strength!
m920184.仮説どころかただの空想ですけど……。\n敵は亜神ですから、そういう技術も持ってい:
It's more of a fantasy than a hypothesis, but...
The enemy is a Lesser God, so perhaps they do possess such technology...
m920184.任せておけ、汝らに、ひとりも犠牲は出さぬ。: Leave it to me. I will not let a single one of you fall.
m920184.何だかんだ言って、正義の味方なんだから。\nよし王子、ディアスのところまで駆け抜: No matter what they say, I'm still on the side of justice. Alright, Prince, let's dash all the way to Dius!
m920184.何故、泣いている……。\n汝は……妹と再会するまで、泣かぬと言っていただろう。:
Why are you weeping…?
You swore you wouldn't shed a tear until you reunited with your sister.
m920184.余が敵、だと？\n戦神はやはり、世界の維持には向かぬ存在だな。:
I, your enemy?
So the War God is indeed unfit for maintaining the world.
m920184.儀式の段階が進んだ――いえ、\n亜神イルドナが時間を稼いでいてくれたのですから、:
The ritual has progressed—no,
since the demi-god Ildona bought us time,
he must already be…
m920184.其は神の力、即ち命を分けた、\n神そのものとも言うべきものである。:
It is the power of a god, a fragment of their life force,
and thus, a part of the god themselves.
m920184.創造神よ、見ているか。\n貴様の愚行により奪われし力、\n今この手に戻ってきたぞ:
Creator God, do you watch?
The power stolen by your folly
has returned to my hand.
m920184.否定はせぬ。\nだが、それに任せていれば、\nこの世界が滅びる方が早かろう。:
I do not deny it.
But if we leave it to that,
this world will perish sooner.
m920184.堕天使から意思を奪い、\nむりやり天使に戻すとは、さすがは亜神か。:
To strip the will from a fallen angel
and forcibly restore them to an angel... truly befitting a Lesser God.
m920184.天使は間違えることなどありません。\n意思などという、不要な装置を我々は持ちませ:
Angels do not err.
We do not possess such an unnecessary mechanism as “will.”
Once this battle is over, let us go in for maintenance.
m920184.女神アイギスの神官か……？\nよかろう、この盾の本来の力を見せてやろう。:
A priestess of the goddess Aigis, are you……?
Very well. I'll show you the true power of this shield.
m920184.奴はルキファ様に、何か思い入れがあるみたいだ。\n時間をかけて魔力を注ぎ、天使に:
He seems to have some kind of attachment to Lord Lukifer.
He spent time pouring his magic into him,
turning him back into an angel.
m920184.嫌だね！ 僕は正義の味方なんだ！\n正義は自分勝手で、誰より傲慢で、\n問答無用: I don't want this! I'm on the side of justice! Justice is selfish, arrogant, and must save everything without question!!
m920184.実に惜しい、その身が人ではなく、\n神であれば我が同志となれたであろうに。:
Truly a shame. Had that body been divine rather than human,
you might have become one of my comrades.
m920184.幸いなことに、三女神の力の残滓が\nこの辺りにも存在します。: Fortunately, traces of the Three Goddesses' power still linger in this area.
m920184.思い出す必要はありません、ルキファ様。\nあのような裏切り者の言葉に、耳を傾けて:
There is no need to recall such things, Lord Lukifer.

You must not lend an ear to the words of a traitor like that.
m920184.我が剣を受け継ぎし姫君に、\nひとつ頼み事をしただけですよ。\n本当に必要なとき:
I merely asked the princess who inherited my blade for one small favor.
I asked her to call for me when she truly needed me.
m920184.我らの子を、愛する者を、戦いから救った王子と、\nルキファ様に、我らの最後の戦い:
Let us dedicate our final battle to the Prince, who saved our children and loved ones from war,
and to Lukifer.
m920184.我ラはカツテ、宿敵同士でアッタ！\nソシテ今も、物質界連合を成し遂げたガ、\n種:
We were once sworn enemies!
And even now, though we've achieved the Material World Alliance,
that doesn't mean all the misunderstandings between our races have vanished.
m920184.擬似的に、三女神の力が、\nそれも女神の所有していない純粋な状態で手に入る、と？:
You mean it would allow one to obtain the power of the Three Goddesses,
in a pure state not even the goddesses possess?
m920184.敵対しようとしてるから、じゃないです？\n最後の仕上げって、いったい何をするつも:
Because he's acting hostile, isn't it?
What is he planning to do for this "final stage"?!
m920184.昔の仲間まで忘れるたぁ、\n亜神ディアスの精神支配装置ってのは\n随分と高性能み:
Forgetting even your old comrades, huh.

Demigod Dias's mind control device

seems pretty high-tech, doesn't it.
m920184.正義、なるほど、確かに正義の味方だな。\nあやつはいつも、自分は悪を行くと言って: Then it's up to us to save him!
m920184.残念だ、少しは期待させてくれるかと思ったが。\nその程度の実力では、\nオリュン:
What a pity. I thought you might have given me a little hope.
With power of that magnitude,
you will never reach the peak of Olympus.
m920184.民を救うのが――ぐっ……くぁ……っ！\n亜神、ディアス様の儀式完遂まで、\n魔王:
Saving the people is—gah... kua...!
Defending the Demon King's Castle until the Lesser God Dias
completes his ritual... that is... our duty...
m920184.永遠のチャンプ、アナトリア様、\n現チャンプ、王子の戦いを、もう一度見てから死に:
To see the battle between the Eternal Champion, Lord Anatolia,
and the current Champion, the Prince, one more time before I die—
m920184.浄化を受け入れよ。\n穢れた大地は、焼き払わねばならぬ。:
Accept purification.
The defiled earth must be burned away.
m920184.無力なる人類よ、これは罰だ。\n我が力を奪いし三女神と、道を過ち続ける人類への。:
You powerless humans, this is your punishment.
For the Three Goddesses who stole my power,
and for humanity, which continues to walk the wrong path.
m920184.王国を訪ねてみれば、\n王子たちは魔界へ向かったというではないか。:
I heard that after visiting the Kingdom,

the Princes were heading toward the Demon Realm.
m920184.王子、このまま上層へ抜けます！\nおそらく敵の待ち伏せがあるはずです。\nいつで: Since Hansel asked me to, I will definitely free her from the Lesser God Dias.
m920184.王子、敵の戦線が崩れました。\n上層へ向かうならば、今が好機です。: Prince, the enemy line has broken. If we're heading to the upper floors, now is our chance.
m920184.王子が、あらゆる生命の敵であるあなたと、\n友だちになんてなると思う？:
You expect the Prince to be friends with you?
You're the enemy of all life!
m920184.王子くんが、そんな道を選ぶはずがありません。\n何も変わらぬ停滞の世界など、決し:
There is no way the Prince would choose such a path.
A world of stagnation where nothing ever changes… never.
m920184.王子と戦ったという、この事実だけで、\n末代までの武勇伝とできるだろうな。:
The mere fact that we fought the Prince
would make for a legendary tale to be told for generations.
m920184.王子にはちょうどいい休暇かもしれません。\n今のうちに、兵にも交代で休暇をとって:
It might be a welcome break for the Prince.
We should arrange for the soldiers to take shifts off while he's recovering.
m920184.王子みたいな存在は、きっとどの時代にだっている。\nなんなら、困ってるやつを見捨:
There's always someone like the Prince in every age.
In fact, there are plenty of good-natured fools
around who can't leave people in trouble behind.
m920184.王子殿下、先程魔王城内部に、\n高出力の魔力の揺らぎを感知しました。\nおそらく:
Your Highness, I detected a high-power magical fluctuation
inside the Demon King's Castle just now.
It is likely from the Demigod Dias.
m920184.目覚めの時ですわよ、堕天使さま。\nあなたの逸話は本で何度も読みましたわ。:
It's time to wake up, Fallen Angel.
I've read your legends in books so many times.
m920184.直撃を受けたら、たとえ亜神でも、\n欠片すら残らないわね……。\nソラス、サナラ:
If that hits us directly, even a demigod wouldn't have a single fragment left…
Solais, Sanara, I'm sorry. Please, lend me your strength.
m920184.神の被造物たる人類を、\n安寧と諦観の内に生き長らえさせ、\nこの世界を永続させ:
To let humanity, the creation of the gods,
live on in peace and resignation,
and to preserve this world eternally—that is my mission.
m920184.神の言葉こそ正義、ならばそれに背き、\n独自に行動する自分は悪である、だったか？: Saving people all over the place, and calling it evil?
m920184.神獣と魔神が、元は共通の存在だという説ですか？\n一部はそれが事実だと判明してい:
The theory that divine beasts and demon gods
were originally the same existence?
It has been proven that part of that is true,
but a Leviathan of this scale, the very Demon Realm itself?
m920184.神自らが紡いだ、強大な魔力の結晶であるレヴィアタン。\nその魔力を、三女神の力の:
Leviathan, a crystal of immense magical power
woven by the gods themselves.
If that power were channeled into the remnants of the Three Goddesses' power...
m920184.私たちの命と魔力を束ねれば、\n王子くんひとりくらいなら守れるかもしれません。:
If we combine our lives and magic,
we might just be able to protect the Prince.
m920184.私はただ、この世界を継続させ続けることを、\nそしてそれを見守ることを、\n英雄: I simply promised the Hero King that I would keep this world going, and watch over it.
m920184.約束……約束か……！\nそんな他愛もない口約束のために、\n貴様はこの千年、暗躍:
A promise… just a promise!
For such a trivial, off-the-cuff pledge, you've been scheming in the shadows for a thousand years?!
m920184.膨大すぎる魔力が、空間を破壊しています。\nあれは雷の魔法ではありません。\n空:
The massive amount of magic power is destroying space itself.
That is not a lightning spell.
I judge that space is undergoing a chain reaction of ruptures.
m920184.英傑も、今の時代に生きる民も、\n王子にとっては等しく、\n共に戦う仲間で、守る:
Whether they are heroes of old or the people of this age,
to the Prince, they are all equal—
companions in battle and people to be protected.
m920184.英雄王との契約か。\n確か、世界の味方をせよ、だったか？\nそのために命すら投げ:
A contract with the Hero King, was it?
I recall the terms being something like “side with the world.”
To throw away your very life for that…
m920184.英雄王の子孫たちが、私の子供たちが、\nそして、彼らと共に戦うことを決意した\n:
The descendants of the Hero King, my children,
and the oaths of the countless warriors who have resolved to fight alongside them—
m920184.英雄王の意志と名を継ぐ者、人類種の英雄、\n魔王を討ちし神殺しにして、世界を担う:
You who inherit the will and name of the Hero King, hero of the human race,
god-slayer who slew the Demon King, and bearer of the world's weight,
show me your true strength in my final battle!
m920184.英雄王ほどの傑物が、\nこの先の未来にも存在するとは思えなかった、のだろう？:
You couldn't believe that a figure as extraordinary as the Hero King
would exist in the future, could you?
m920184.謝る必要はない、かしら。: I suppose he'll say there's no need to apologize.
m920184.貴様が人ではなく、神であったなら、\n良き友となれたやもしれぬな。:
Had you been a god rather than a human,
you might have made a fine friend.
m920184.迷える人々のために、翼を黒く染めた最初の天使。\n施すだけでなく、共に立ち上がる:
The first angel to dye her wings black for the sake of the lost.
A righteous soul who doesn't just bestow aid, but gives others the strength to rise with her.
Lukifer, the hero who heralds the dawn.
m920184.長らく、神に挑もうなどという者はいなかった。\nあのガリウスすら、もはや神とは呼:
For a long time, no one dared to challenge the gods.
Even that Garius, having lost the right to be called a god,
finally brought his story to an end.
m920184.魔力の揺らぎ方から、\n何らかの儀式が進行していることは間違いありません。:
Judging by the nature of the magical fluctuation,
it is certain that some kind of ritual is underway.
m920184.魔王との決戦で、民を守るために\n自分を犠牲に結界を張ったんだよ、あいつ。\nそ:
In the decisive battle with the Demon King, he sacrificed himself
to raise a barrier to protect the people.
That's what caused him to be pushed outside the Material World…….
m920184.魔王に蹂躙されし、無実の民を救うためです！\nそのためにあなたは堕天し、己の意思:
It was to save the innocent people crushed by the Demon King!

That is why you fell from the heavens, to claim your own will!
m920184.魔界と物質界の往来が絶たれた後、\n王子たちの目の届かぬこの地は、\n再び動乱の:
After the passage between the Demon Realm and the Material World was cut off,
this land, beyond the Prince's reach,
was on the verge of descending into chaos once more.
m920184.黙りなさいッ！\n亜神ディアス、まさかルキファ様にまで精神支配を――:
Silence!

Demigod Dias, so you have even subjected Lord Lukifer to mind control—
m920184.黙れ。我が翼は、我が力は、\n罪なき者たちのために振るわれる。:
Silence. My wings, my power,
shall be wielded for the sake of the innocent.
m920184.（――汝、正義たれ、善き行いをせよ。\n正しさとは主の御言葉にほかならぬ）:
（――Be just, and do good.
Righteousness is nothing but the Word of the Lord.）
m920184.（おい、もう少し緊張感ってやつをだな……。\nいや、だが確かに、見覚えが――）: (Besides, doesn't Hansel remind me of someone? I feel like I've seen a similar face in the Royal Army before...)
m920184.（それにしても、ヘンゼルさんって誰かに似てません？\n王国軍で、似た子を見たこと: Prince, let's make our way to the upper floors! There's likely an ambush waiting for us. Please have everyone ready for battle!
m920184.（ならば私は、何のために堕天を――\n否、違う、私は堕ちてなど……）:
(Then why did I fall from grace—
No, that's not it. I did not fall…)
m920184.（本当に、そうだっただろうか。\nこの身を満たす歓びは、確かにあの頃にどこか似て:
（Was it really so?
The joy filling this body certainly resembles that of a bygone era.
Yet, something is fundamentally different.）
m920184.（私の使命とは、魔界の民を守護すること――\n否、違う、亜神ディアス様を守護する:
(My mission is to protect the people of the Demon Realm—
No, that's not it. It is to protect the Lesser God Dias.)
m920184.（私は主の剣、主の槍、あらゆる審判の代行者。\n神に従い、その意を物質界に伝える:
（I am the Lord's sword, the Lord's spear, the executor of all judgment.
To obey the divine will and convey it to the material world—
that alone is my mission, my reason for existing……）

m950001.うふふ、やる気満々のようね。\nでも、いつも通りに戦えるとは限らないよ。\n魔女: Hehe, you look so eager. But you can't be sure you'll fight as usual. You'll come to know a witch's power.
m950001.ここが忌々しい女神アイギスの神殿だね。\nふふ、すぐにボロボロにしてやるよ。\n: This is the cursed shrine of the goddess Aigis. Heh, I'll tear it to pieces soon. Come on, you all, head out.
m950001.この前はよくもやってくれたね！\n今回はもっとすごいの連れてきたよ。\nさあ、ぶ: You did well last time! This time I've brought something even more impressive. Come on, let's feed you something hefty!
m950001.この女神様の神殿がどうしても邪魔な\nようですね。\n絶対に守り抜きましょう。: It seems this goddess's shrine is just in the way. We'll protect it no matter what.
m950001.この数の魔物を倒すなんて\n案外やるもんだ。\n英雄の子孫ってのもまんざらじゃな: Defeating this many monsters is surprisingly doable. Being a descendant of heroes isn't so bad after all.
m950001.どうやら私の手には負えないみたいだね。\nならば、あのお方に直接戦ってもらおうか: Looks like I can't handle this myself. Then I'll have that one fight directly… Come on, chase them!
m950001.ふふふ、しつこい奴らだね。\nもしかして私が欲しいのかい……\n私に勝てたら考え: Heh heh, you're persistent, aren't you? Could it be you want me… If you can beat me, I'll think about it.
m950001.森に住む者たちがこの周囲で\n逃げていく魔女を見たという話ですが…\nあの小屋が: The forest dwellers say they saw a witch fleeing around here… Could that cabin be her hideout?
m950001.気を付けてください。\nこの神殿を覆っている霧は\n癒しの力を妨げています。: Please be careful. The mist covering this shrine is hindering healing power.
m950001.王子、魔女はあの穴に逃げ込んだようです。\n何が潜んでいるかわかりません。\nお: Prince, the witch has fled into that hole. We don't know what's lurking there. Please be careful.
m950001.王子、魔物たちの襲撃です。\n女神様の神殿を狙っているようです。\n迎え撃ちまし: Prince, the monsters are attacking. They seem to be targeting the goddess's shrine. Let's meet them head-on.
